flavour.AbyssPinnacleKeySearching__: His grasp, severed from his spark...
flavour.AbyssPinnacleNodeFlavour:
The dormant carrier lies
still as death.
flavour.AbyssScarab: They search forever for more souls to drag to the dark.
flavour.AbyssScarabOfDescending: They invite you to meet them; to join them.
flavour.AbyssScarabOfEdifice_: Their borrowed power swirls within ghastly crystals.
flavour.AbyssScarabOfEmptiness: They stare back, with hollow hypnotising eyes.
flavour.AbyssScarabOfMultitudes: The Well hungers ceaselessly, even as it overflows.
flavour.AbyssScarabofProfoundDepth: They defend the depths at their Lords' command.
flavour.AfflictionFragment: How do you defeat that which dwells within you?
flavour.AmbushScarab: Is it still an ambush if you're expecting it?
flavour.AmbushScarabOfDiscernment: A keen eye sorts the worthy from the chaff.
flavour.AmbushScarabOfHiddenCompartments: Beneath the obvious lies the real treasure...
flavour.AmbushScarabOfPotency: The locksmith dreams of building a better box.
flavour.Amulet13:
"A bit short in the arm, are you? 
Then you'll be short of a head soon enough."
- Daresso the Daring
flavour.Amulet14:
"We are the soldiers of Faith, armoured in devotion.
Let the sinners come, for we - the Pure - shall endure!"
- Voll of Thebrus, at the Battle of the Bridge
flavour.Amulet15:
"Grind your words into sharp thoughts.
Grind your thoughts into the sharpest of deeds."
- Victario, the People's Poet
flavour.AnarchyScarab: On Wraeclast, it's kill or be killed.
flavour.AnarchyScarabOfGigantification: The consumption of sulphite can cause strange growth.
flavour.AnarchyScarabOfPartnership: Among exiles, alliances shift and change constantly.
flavour.AnarchyScarabOfTheExceptional: Among many, one stands above the rest.
flavour.AnarchysPrice: Born of relentless fury and abhorrence, warped by turmoil and anguish, tainted through desire and carnality, I thirst for bloodshed once more.
flavour.ArchivesResearch:
These Archives were among the first constructed by the Templars.
There are more books here than I could read in a lifetime...
flavour.AssassinsFavor:
By the time their eyes meet, 
the dark deal has long since been made, 
and his fate long since sealed.
flavour.AtziriAtlasNodeFlavour:
In a realm of crimson madness,
the Queen lives on.
flavour.AtziriFragment1_1: Look to our Queen, for she will lead us into the light.
flavour.AtziriFragment1_2: Only those who aspire can dare to hope.
flavour.AtziriFragment1_3: The light without pales in comparison to the light within.
flavour.AtziriFragment1_4: The Vaal shall never fear the setting of our sun.
flavour.AtziriFragment2_1: We are but dogs, howling at an uncaring moon.
flavour.AtziriFragment2_2: Look to our Queen, for she will lead us from the darkness.
flavour.AtziriFragment2_3: It is only the blind who can live in darkness.
flavour.AtziriFragment2_4: When we prostrate ourselves to the night, we worship mortality.
flavour.AtzirisArsenal: In the prison of all sins, will you grasp godhood or sorrow? Only hope lies under the shadows.
flavour.AtzirisVessel: Eternal life is within our grasp. Do not let it go.
flavour.AtzoatlNodeFlavour:
A monument to hubris,
in more ways than one.
flavour.Audacity:
A jolt, and it moves. Or smolders.
A current, and it lives. Or dies.
A surge, and it transcends.
Or... not.
Only one way to find out.
flavour.BeautyThroughDeath:
Her beauty did not fade 
her humanity did not survive.
flavour.Belt5: As long as the soul is unfettered, so is the body.
flavour.BenevolenceKeyFlavourText: Simple kindness makes the most powerful of memories.
flavour.BestiaryScarabOfDuplicating: "What's better than one captured beast, exile?"
flavour.BestiaryScarabOfTheBlackMorrigan: The Nameless begin to slip their bonds of nonexistence...
flavour.BestiaryScarabOfTheHerd: The First Ones ran rampant and free in the forests of old.
flavour.BetrayalScarab: The Syndicate must pay for what they have done.
flavour.BetrayalScarabOfIntelligence: Those that can never die fear only pain.
flavour.BetrayalScarabOfUnbreaking: Dying over and over builds a tolerance to pain.
flavour.BirthOfTheThree: A small token of Her affliction.
flavour.BlessingofGod: When the darkness weighs upon you, grow light from within.
flavour.BlightScarabOfBlooming: Once a century, the Blight spills forth...
flavour.BlightScarabOfBounty: A ghastly fruit, but twice as sweet.
flavour.BlightScarabOfVeryBigChest: The core grows larger with each cycle, doomed to spill forth...
flavour.BlightScarabofInvigoration: Reversing the polarity of the compression modulator seems to have intriguing effects...
flavour.BlightedLands:
The ancient will of the Blightheart
festers and spreads...
flavour.BlindVenture:
"It's risky not knowing where your wares come from. That's why I source my own."
- Klayver, the Antiquarian
flavour.BloodCrucibleFlavourText:
The gateway of flesh, horror unbound,
requires a key of madness and pain.
flavour.BoonOfTheFirstOnes:
Wreathed in the skin and bones
of the beasts she slew, 
her gift came from what she lost: 
her humanity.
flavour.BoundlessRealms: Boundless is the distance between where we start and where we start again.
flavour.BowyersDream: If this is my dream, I don't wish to wake.
flavour.BreachScarabOfResonantCascade: Reality weakens with each new wound.
flavour.CallToTheFirstOnes: The Ezomyte, desperate for aid, cried out to the gods.
flavour.CartographersDelight:
A map is similar
to a pair of eyes,
without one you stumble
around, unable to find your way.
flavour.CartographyScarabOfRisk: What we see in the mirror can only be our own reflection.
flavour.CartographyScarabOfSingularity: Some regions of the Atlas never change.
flavour.CartographyScarabOfUberPacks: There is no end, no horizon.
flavour.CartographyScarabofEscalation: Opportunity thrives where dreams are most perilous.
flavour.CathedralResearch:
This was the first cathedral that Innocence ever built,
made to honour himself. It is gilded with stolen wealth.
flavour.CelestialVaultKey:
An heirloom of the champions of Wraeclast
Lies forgotten in an abandoned reliquary
Born of a starry void from which time cannot escape
flavour.ChaoticDisposition: Life isn't what you make of it, it's already been made for you.
flavour.ChayulaBodyPart1:
Lay bare our flesh under the
searing light of the Torus Eternal.
flavour.ChayulaBodyPart10:
Unity... must have... the flesh...
must draw closer...
flavour.ChayulaBodyPart2:
Silent thoughts chitter in the dark,
lashing our minds into agonised ecstasy.
flavour.ChayulaBodyPart3:
We crawl on our faces in burning ash,
choking, eating, until our throats bleed.
flavour.ChayulaBodyPart5:
We give of our flesh so that
the Lords may thrive.
flavour.ChayulaBodyPart6:
Let the Grey Winds
take the Foulborn.
flavour.ChayulaBodyPart7:
Let the Mother's love
embrace our flesh.
flavour.ChayulaBodyPart8:
"It That Was Vruun failed...
It That Will Be Vruun... will not.
Vengeance will be ours..."
flavour.ChayulaBodyPart9:
The flesh exists for one reason, and one
reason alone... to perpetuate itself.
flavour.ChayulaNormalRing: We will seize back our wayward Dream.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquary:
The craftsman rots.
His tools rust.
But his legacy cuts through the ages.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquary2:
The words of a man, delicate like life, pass on feebly into forgotten verse,
but his creations... his craft shall be championed agelessly.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryBenevolen:
Those we idolise are not gods.
They were men, with flaws.
They made... mistakes.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryCosmic: Time stands still, and a new champion ascends.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryIgnorance:
Some wounds, we do not let heal.
Some wounds, we poke and prod,
simply to keep the feeling alive.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryMaven:
You are not the first champion to receive this gift,
and you will likely not be the last.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryNeglect:
A touch on the shoulder.
A smile on a sunny day.
An idle conversation...
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquarySearingEx:
To a being of the stars, Time is irrelevant,
and memories are but a collection of present moments.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquarySirus:
Though you might not see it, a sliver of my soul remains,
and I am trying with all my strength to get back to you.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryUberShape:
You did not slay me.
You saved me.
I forgive you.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryUberUberE: There are holes in the sky...
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryVaal:
Time is a river, forking forever into infinite unknowns.
Nothing is ever truly gone.
It is merely taking a different route to the sea.
flavour.ChestForgottenReliquaryVenarius:
It is not regret that stalks me now...
merely the child of my sins.
flavour.CitadelMapFlavour:
Their courage and heroism
became their downfall.
flavour.CleansingFireBossKeyFlavourText:
From the corona of an ancient star,
the Searing Exarch seeks to master the Atlas.
flavour.CleansingFireKeyFlavourText:
Once within the grasp of the Black Star,
there can be no escape.
flavour.CoinDesecration:
"The supposed heroes of history now rot.
I am alive, and I choose my own destiny."
flavour.CoinKnowledge:
"Power and skill can be outsmarted...
I wish for intellect beyond compare."
flavour.CoinPower:
"Knowledge and speed are useless without the
strength to wield them. I wish for power!"
flavour.CoinRestoration:
"Drain away the sands of Time,
restore that which is now mine!"
flavour.CoinSkill:
"Strong and slow, clever and weak. I fear neither.
I wish for the skill to overcome them both."
flavour.CovetedPossession: A taste of power brings a hunger for more.
flavour.CrucibleGeode:
Dark as obsidian with a red-hot core,
the geode hums with mysterious energy.
flavour.CrucibleGeodeUber: A fractured lithophysa studded with delicate crystalline formations.
flavour.CrucibleMap:
Kalandra watched as the almighty titans fell,
relegated to the innermost depths of the world,
where horrific abominations awaited them.
flavour.CurrencyHarvestBossKey:
It isn't the twisted transformative power of corruption that makes it so dangerous.
It is its ability to hide in plain sight.
flavour.CurrencyMastermindBossFragment:
Follow the strands of a web to its center,
and you'll find Death lying in wait...
flavour.CurrencyRitualBossFragment:
On the edge of existence,
he watches with ire.
flavour.Death:
The end of the old,
the beginning of the new.
A unique opportunity for transformation,
for those with the power
to grasp it.
flavour.DeepwaterAbyssCurrency:
Merrick the Wanting's dark desires forced the Brinerot to maroon him. So
he walked to the bottom of the sea, and made himself a new crew.
flavour.DeepwaterAttributeSwap:
A noble Eternal who gave up his name to join the Brinerots. He climbed
the ranks with calculated savagery like Pondium had never seen.
flavour.DeepwaterBlankCurrency_:
To appease Tsoatha, they tossed it to sea, but the storm grew ever madder.
None returned to shore. Yet the vessel sails on, and its captain is merry.
flavour.DeepwaterChartReroll:
Telesia carved the earth with her oars, and filled the seas with her tears. 
The waters, still as stone, began to dance and flow to cheer her.
flavour.DeepwaterEldritch:
Mirthful Ukatoa travelled the world to teach it the Way. He ventured south, 
and came back changed, a sombre husk filled with unearthly arcana.
flavour.DeepwaterGhostbuster:
Before his work in Atzoatl, Tzamoto travelled the world in search of
forbidden arcana. He believed spirits held many untapped secrets.
flavour.DeepwaterItemSplit:
Vaal Kishara sailed the seas, seeking her equal. None were worthy. From
each contender she took a carnal gift, and thus, the Brinerot clan was born.
flavour.DeepwaterMercenaryCurrency:
Kylian Cyaxan sold every vice known to man, and more. Wares tailored to
break man's will. Every customer returned, or died from deprivation.
flavour.DeepwaterPantheon:
Brinehook Vex inspired the Brinerot name. He fought the sea. Sailed with
gods. Drank with heroes. Wed a dozen wives, and the Leviathan, too.
flavour.DeepwaterSaboteur:
Under Weylam, the Brinerots had become soft and aimless. Lussi
"Rotmother" Roth saw her opportunity, and took it. Blood be damned.
flavour.DeepwaterTatttoo:
A thousand ships litter the eastern seabed. All Katakohi's doing. His fleet would 
board, fast as lightning. Every captive saved, every slaver butchered.
flavour.DeepwaterUpgradePiece1: Breathe life into dying embers. Turn not from their emerald hue.
flavour.DeepwaterUpgradePiece2: Life springs eternal in the darkest depths of the ocean.
flavour.DeepwaterUpgradePiece3: Restore that which was lost. Watch it burn anew.
flavour.DeepwaterUpgradePiece4: Essence of undeath, refined and distilled.
flavour.DeepwaterUpgradePiece5: Secrets from below... now yours to do with as you will.
flavour.DeepwaterVelkaAllflame: Bright as her ambition, cold as the bitter deep.
flavour.DeliriumScarab: A perfectly innocuous Scarab that does nothing at all.
flavour.DeliriumScarabOfDelusions:
What are you talking about?
The Atlas was always like this.
flavour.DeliriumScarabOfMania:
They're so loud! Why are they so loud?!
All you can do is scream!
flavour.DeliriumScarabOfNeuroses: Toothy grins shine in the dark.
flavour.DeliriumScarabOfParanoia: If it seems too good to be true...
flavour.DestinedToCrumble:
"Let us not forget the most important lesson the Vaal taught us:
Nothing is eternal."
- Siosa Foaga, Imperial Scholar
flavour.DiallasSubjugation:
A symbol of beauty and innocence
The gems corrupted her mind
Malachai corrupted her gems
All but a glimmer of
greatness lost in madness
flavour.DivinationCardAChillingWind:
All things slow under winter's 
onslaught - even life itself.
flavour.DivinationCardADabOfInk: The Poet's blood is the Empire's ink.
flavour.DivinationCardADustyMemory: In the oldest halls of my mind, at the end of a rarely used passage, lies my greatest treasure: one moment of happiness and innocence, pure and untouchable.
flavour.DivinationCardAFamiliarCall_:
The mighty huntress always called for her share,
But what we shared was a lifelong bond.
flavour.DivinationCardAFateWorseThanDeat: "It was as though my very thoughts were breaking... fracturing into tiny motes to be lost on the wind."
flavour.DivinationCardAModestRequest:
Cede all power and wealth to me and serve me in perpetuity.
A minor inconvenience I assure you.
flavour.DivinationCardANoteInTheWind:
The artist is long dead,
the lyrics are long forgotten,
yet the Song of War longs to be sung again
flavour.DivinationCardASeaOfBlue: The harvest ended, the floods began.
flavour.DivinationCardAStonePerfected: They gave the stone life. Over eons spent bathed in Corruption, that life evolved.
flavour.DivinationCardAcclimatisation:
The world is ever-changing.
Once-lush woods now lost beneath shifting sands,
Great cities now drown beneath turbulent waters.
Adapt or perish.
flavour.DivinationCardAkilsProphecy:
The hatungo know many answers to the same question, 
for time itself is a tangled web.
flavour.DivinationCardAliviasGrace: Her innocence and grace were enough to tame even the wildest of beasts.
flavour.DivinationCardAlluringBounty:
A treasure worth killing for 
is a treasure worth dying for.
flavour.DivinationCardAloneInTheDarkness:
"Sometimes, the most beautiful treasures...are the ones you cannot have." 
- Beryl, Survivor from the Azurite Mines
flavour.DivinationCardAlteredPerception: You mustn't forget: you won't be leaving this place.
flavour.DivinationCardAmbitiousObsession: The most pathetic person in the world is someone who has sight, but no vision.
flavour.DivinationCardApocalypse:
The Ezomytes,
buried beneath flaming mountains
by the First Ones.
The Vaal,
undone by a cataclysm
of their own making.
Are all empires fated to fall to hubris?
flavour.DivinationCardArroganceOfTheVaal: Discovery can lead to beauty, or it can lead to ruin.
flavour.DivinationCardAssassinsGift:
What matters are
the Marks of your life,
not its Longevity.
flavour.DivinationCardAstralProtection:
For a time, we had something stronger than eldritch evil.
We had each other.
flavour.DivinationCardAuspiciousAmbition:
"Gaze upon the mirrors of what may come and step backward into infinity." 
- Dexion, Thaumetic Aspirant
flavour.DivinationCardAvianPursuit:
Blazing through the night
Longing for infinite flight
Awaiting dawn's first light
flavour.DivinationCardAzureRage:
The mask hides his identity
but also makes it hard to read...
flavour.DivinationCardAzyransReward:
Method transcends shape and size. Do something in parallel long enough, and you will always find 
another way.
flavour.DivinationCardBaitedExpectations: The line between having not enough to do and too much to do is unusually fine.
flavour.DivinationCardBijoux: "Such fine trinkets show their true value in times of crisis." - Tangmazu
flavour.DivinationCardBoonOfJustice: Some gifts are obligations while others are simply opportunities.
flavour.DivinationCardBoundByFlame:
In battle we burn together
or not at all.
flavour.DivinationCardBrokenPromises: Experience teaches us that the cold is not the same as the absence of warmth.
flavour.DivinationCardBrokenTruce: With a single act, years of peace have been shattered. An unknown assassin brings war upon us all.
flavour.DivinationCardBrotherhoodInExile:
Seeking shelter from the night,
in the warmth of the run-down inn,
erstwhile foes put aside the fight,
to bond over whiskey and gin.
flavour.DivinationCardBrothersGift______:
Even though his flame has burned out,
he will never fade away.
flavour.DivinationCardBrothersStash:
Even though he found the stash just in time,
He would trade it all away and then some to have him back.
flavour.DivinationCardBrushPaintAndPalet: "Man may shape the world, but these? These shape the man." -Inquisitor Maligaro
flavour.DivinationCardBuriedTreasure: You can't seek riches without getting your hands dirty.
flavour.DivinationCardBurningBlood:
There's a place where up is down, 
where right is wrong, 
where pleasure is agony, 
and where the living wish only for death.
flavour.DivinationCardCameriasCut:
"There are two ways to pay, Gold and Blood. I'll take my share in both."

-Cameria the Coldblooded
flavour.DivinationCardChasingRisk: A fond memory fills me with nostalgia; some men would have felt guilt, but I felt no regret over the anguish and fear my ambitions caused.
flavour.DivinationCardCheckmate: When victory is impossible, each of us plays only to delay the end.
flavour.DivinationCardChokingGuilt: As death approached, clarity eluded him. The pain he had wrought surrounded him, dragging him into darkness.
flavour.DivinationCardCostlyCurio: "Oh no, I couldn't possibly afford this fine artefact. I'm... just looking."
flavour.DivinationCardCouncilOfCats_:
A King Loved By All,
A Shadow Awaiting Nightfall,
A Speaker Howling Away,
A Hunter Seeking Prey
flavour.DivinationCardCursedWords: If you look hard enough for hidden meaning, you will find it.
flavour.DivinationCardDamnation:
Blood and death lead
the way to hell.
flavour.DivinationCardDarkDreams_: No one ever truly understood what she meant when she said she wanted to raise a family.
flavour.DivinationCardDarkTemptation:
"Only a fool looks to the occult for power and expects to be spared from its wrath." 
- Voll, Emperor of Purity
flavour.DivinationCardDarkerHalf: When you find what you're looking for, it's never quite right. When you have what you desire, yet you still want more.
flavour.DivinationCardDazzlingDisplay: The last thing they saw was the blue light of death.
flavour.DivinationCardDeadlyJoy:
"Be fast. That is all that matters."
- Rita of the Asylum
flavour.DivinationCardDeathlyDesigns: "The Karui was correct; there is virtue in honouring my ancestors."
flavour.DivinationCardDementophobia:
I never truly understood the depths of my insanity,
until I realized the voices beckoning me towards the abyss,
were none other than my own.
flavour.DivinationCardDemigodsWager: Sometimes you need to make your own luck.
flavour.DivinationCardDesecratedVirtue:
Awoken virtuous slivers of the void,
defiled by the avaricious, 
seized by the tyrannical.
flavour.DivinationCardDesperateCrusade: Through despondent hardships, those strong of spirit shall claim the prize.
flavour.DivinationCardDisdain: No man sees all, but you'll see more than some see in a lifetime.
flavour.DivinationCardDivineBeauty_:
In a land far away lived 
a maiden most fair.
Her smile melted the coldest
of hearts, her song made
men and beast cry, 
her beauty unparalleled;
Divine.
flavour.DivinationCardDivineJustice: Many sought the Goddess' blessing. Few survived the Labyrinth to receive it.
flavour.DivinationCardDivineShard:
Sin sought to contain Divinity
so that no mortal would gain
such monstrous power ever again.
flavour.DivinationCardDoryanisEpiphany: "Virtue gems have facets beyond those that can be seen by the mortal eye. Let us look deeper..."
flavour.DivinationCardDrapedInDreams:
The suit I wear,
Is heavy and bare.
A canvas, it seems, breathing life into dreams.
flavour.DivinationCardDuality: Good and Evil can be woven together to become something greater than either.
flavour.DivinationCardDyingLight: Even the brightest eventually fade to darkness.
flavour.DivinationCardEchoesOfLove: "I gave up my body for you. I gave up my name for you. And one day I shall give up my life for you."
flavour.DivinationCardEldritchPerfection:
Embrace horror.
Bathe in its beauty.
flavour.DivinationCardEndlessNight: The sun shines not for me. I walk in darkness, never free. Time stopped when you both died in my arms.
flavour.DivinationCardEnergySword:
To my number one fan.
- Griffin, with love
flavour.DivinationCardEtchedInBlood: When you strive to write your name on the dense pages of History, someone else, inevitably, must be crossed out.
flavour.DivinationCardEternalBonds:
Separate, stories untold.
Together, memories unfold.
flavour.DivinationCardEverChanging: The Atlas is our prison, and our only defence. She is our only hope, and our certain doom.
flavour.DivinationCardFatefulMeeting:
Some people act as beacons, illuminating the path for others. I was lucky to meet one such person.

- Anton to Zhenya
flavour.DivinationCardFriendship:
"Set your life on fire. 
Seek those who
fan your flames"

-Rumi of the Vaal
flavour.DivinationCardFromBoneToAshes: For centuries, they stood vigil in secret over their sleeping goddess, even as contamination oozed out of the decadent Vaal empire.
flavour.DivinationCardGemcuttersMercy:
When you can only have one, which shall it be?
Red?
Blue?
Probably Green.
flavour.DivinationCardGiftOfAsenath: The Golden Sekhema's words could solve many a feud. Just what form that solution took was another matter.
flavour.DivinationCardGuardiansChallenge: To accept a challenge from the void is merely suicide for the unprepared.
flavour.DivinationCardHauntingShadows:
In the dead of night you may elude your shadows,
but they will always find you by dawn.
flavour.DivinationCardHistory:
The future is oft-foretold
in records of the past.
flavour.DivinationCardHome:
There are countless people,
countless stories,
and countless eras,
but there is one place that,
for a time, each of us loved
and was loved. It matters.
We matter.
flavour.DivinationCardISeeBrothers:
"Where does the light go
when it is dark?"
flavour.DivinationCardImperfectMemories: Everything is eroded by time, but sometimes the edges that fade can make a wonderful memory even more beautiful.
flavour.DivinationCardImperialLegacy: A life lost, A legacy born.
flavour.DivinationCardJudgingVoices: He was seeking sanity, but the demons were inside his head.
flavour.DivinationCardJustifiedAmbition:
"Everything I have done has been for Wraeclast. You would pledge your life to me if you saw things my way... and soon, you will."
- High Templar Venarius
flavour.DivinationCardKeepersCorruption:
With great power comes...

...Even greater power.
flavour.DivinationCardLachrymalNecrosis: Without the ability to weep, the heart hardens against both the pure and the corrupt.
flavour.DivinationCardLastStand__:
Return with your shield...
or on it.
flavour.DivinationCardLetheanTemptation: My memories tortured me without end. To escape them, I embraced nothingness, but oblivion simply brought a different kind of pain...
flavour.DivinationCardLonelyWarrior:
A true warrior fights
for those who cannot
fight for themselves.
flavour.DivinationCardLoveThroughIce:
"I know one lady for whose sake I will rip out my heart"

- Derrok, the Dreamer
flavour.DivinationCardLuckyBastion:
Discipline forged our unbreakable Rampart.
Bastion against Despair.
flavour.DivinationCardLuminousTrove:
Plenty enter, dreaming of treasure
Twenty bled, slain as they fled
Shadows loom, half left doomed
The blind cries, five lost eyes
Careless twins, a lich's new prize
One as a decoy, none pass the king
Gehennix feeds only on whispers
flavour.DivinationCardMagnumOpus: Wraeclast will unite. This shall be my great work - the minds of the people made one.
flavour.DivinationCardManWithBear: A stereotypical joke may lead to an unexpected bond.
flavour.DivinationCardMatryoshka:
I cannot contain myself,
but I can barely squeak,
so many words I'd have for you,
if I could only speak!
flavour.DivinationCardMiseryInDarkness:
He wandered the bone-filled depths hoping each corner would be his last.
Eventually, he found Light.
flavour.DivinationCardMonochrome:
"You cannot portray the world using just one colour. Together, you and I, we will paint our world into perfection." 
- Kyra, renegade thaumaturgist
flavour.DivinationCardMoreIsNeverEnough: Greed is a hunger that only grows as you feed it
flavour.DivinationCardNooksCrown:
Every skull was once a person. 
Though 'Who?' is rarely asked. 
Friends, who wear 
the crown of Nook, 
Never need to ask. 
They remember.
flavour.DivinationCardOneLastScore:
You want to know how
I haven't been caught? 
It's not just speed.
You need some luck.
flavour.DivinationCardOutfoxed:
The prize vanished. 
No trail, no struggle.
Just a single, rust-red hair.
flavour.DivinationCardParasiticPassenger: Feeding on death, they grew stronger and stronger, until they were ready to hatch...
flavour.DivinationCardPeacefulMoments: Savour these moments, for they may never return.
flavour.DivinationCardPearlsBeforeSwine:
The unknowledgable know not
what treasures lie so closely
within their feeble reach.
flavour.DivinationCardPoisonedFaith: Even our most devout beliefs are subtly shaped by our darkest desires.

Upon silent paws and masked by the reeds,

flavour.DivinationCardPrometheusArmoury: It is a mortal man's folly to seek power beyond his comprehension.
flavour.DivinationCardRebirthAndRenewal: Life has an end, then life begins again.
flavour.DivinationCardRecklessAmbition: Why settle when more is never enough.
flavour.DivinationCardRemembrance:

flavour.DivinationCardRunicLuck:
If you believe hard enough,
you'll win.
flavour.DivinationCardSambodhisVow:
He dispels dark realms
until mortal sufferings
yield to hopeful light.

No blade conquers sin;
guide a sinner to virtue,
unveil their lost sight—
your eyes, too, see in
everyone the inner child,
no matter their might.
flavour.DivinationCardSevenYearsBadLuck: If enough people believe something to be true, whether or not it is becomes irrelevant.

We live to dream of worlds we aren't in,
a false narrative that we use to fill our souls
with doubt;
The world is already beautiful,
there's no need to dream.

flavour.DivinationCardSquanderedProsperi: "Our rulers are being ridiculous, and we are suffering."
flavour.DivinationCardSuccorOfTheSinless: Blessed is the blood of the beholden disciple. The earth is anointed by his step. The damnable are sanctified by his strike.
flavour.DivinationCardTemperance:
Good things come
to those who wait;
but, greatness seeks
those who do not come.
flavour.DivinationCardTerribleSecretOfSp: They said they were here to protect us.
flavour.DivinationCardTheAcademic:
"Such dedication for so many years,
all for a couple extra letters at the front of your name..."
flavour.DivinationCardTheAdventuringSpir: Dost thou lead my men to victory, my child?
flavour.DivinationCardTheApothecary: "You seek the power of my strongest potions, but the price will be far higher than you can imagine."
flavour.DivinationCardTheArchMagesRightH: "When grasped in his hand, even an ordinary piece of wood can make the heavens tremble with fear."
flavour.DivinationCardTheAspirant:
Those Exiles that survive Wraeclast
dream not of home, but of power.
flavour.DivinationCardTheAstromancer_:
They would say that he was a dangerous man,
unbound by the sense of morality,
but what does this matter,
when his love for humanity is undeniable
and completion of his work would benefit everyone?
flavour.DivinationCardTheAwakened: Some seek to change the world. Others change the world as a consequence of what they seek.
flavour.DivinationCardTheBargain: In the pursuit of power, as in that of wealth, anything goes.
flavour.DivinationCardTheBearWoman:
For the blessed bear in the cave,
A hundred days pass in silence and darkness,
until moon begins its fourth passage,
the bear sheds her beastly fur,
and is reborn, human and whole.
flavour.DivinationCardTheBitterBlossom: The pain you feel is of no consequence, it is evolution, to be made whole within something greater.
flavour.DivinationCardTheBlessingOfMoosh: While the Labyrinth traps have claimed countless adventurers, they were not designed with felines in mind.
flavour.DivinationCardTheBones: The flesh is a prison, and we are finally free.
flavour.DivinationCardTheBrawnyBattleMag: A humble piece of wood offers the simplest solution to life's problems: just hit them really, really hard.

Vintage or crafted, Glittering and shiny
Dusty or glittering, huge or tiny
Secured within a chest 
or unearthed from your mining
Find jewellery everywhere, 
no need for divining!
So why is it so hard 
to figure out which one to wear?
This one makes me stronger, 
but does it match my hair?
flavour.DivinationCardTheCardSharp: "The house always wins... except when I do."
flavour.DivinationCardTheCatch: The largest hooks offer the greatest catch, but often the catch is the hook.
flavour.DivinationCardTheCheater: Sometimes the best way to achieve greatness is to use a shortcut.
flavour.DivinationCardTheChosen: They whose lives were given to clothe the Dark Dreamer... They were the lucky ones.
flavour.DivinationCardTheCraving: What was once a passing thought tickling the back of the mind is now a desperate, driving desire.
flavour.DivinationCardTheDamned:
Souls along a conduit of blood, 
from one vessel to the next.
flavour.DivinationCardTheDeal: In the pursuit of wealth, as in that of power, anything goes.
flavour.DivinationCardTheDemon: A man who hears voices may not necessarily be crazy.
flavour.DivinationCardTheDestination: You may be nothing to everybody, but you are everything to somebody.

 - Blonca's last words
flavour.DivinationCardTheEldritchDecay: Time dismantles all things eventually, but some wish to accelerate the process.

Yet still they followed his influence."

flavour.DivinationCardTheEternalWar: They believed, falsely, that the strongest of generals could outlast eons of corruption.

The Atlas invites us all
to a lifelong journey.
It would be unwise
to overstay our welcome.

not harder.

The fortunate find 
generosity in the divine.

that which madness could not.

Gaze upon your Reflection
Your full Potential

Holding fast when shadows fall,
Over ruins, jesters call.
Nothing breaks their twisted cheer,
Kings of chaos, friends sincere.

Ancient behemoths swam the
depths of the oceans long
before Man walked these lands.

you can see the universe

couldn't be happier.
Octavia, 2023

Consumed with the 
pursuit of perfection 
Ever deeper into the waiting dark

To complete one's final goal
is to take one's last breath.

but forces far more potent 
sleep within these stones.

Conjuring all his might, the Prodigy turned light to dark.

he ever wanted,
yet his heart yearned
for something more.

From silly pondering
comes legend,
and from legend,
horned fortune

He slumbers...

flavour.DivinationCardTheTinkerersTable: Trying to bring your vision to life is enough to drive you mad.

- Sister Cassia

but found a treasure none had foreseen.

that snow blanketed the land,
but in truth, all their chickens
had come home to roost.

by those who came after... all but one.

The work of a life.
Ambitious, and unfinished.

makes the air feel thin. 
Above, power slumbers, tempting fate. 
Greed and ambition 
draws countless in, 
For those who seek power 
can never wait.

In their fiery union,
the storm left the rivers
forever changed.

In the midst 
of unrelenting requests,
the blacksmith's forge 
conjures the unpredictable
Countless voices, countless desires – 
yielding weapons as diverse
as those who ask

Come home to me, my sweet.
Oh, how long you've been!
Lie with me in the frozen dark.
I may yet find forgiveness
Now that fear has left you.

Power is a curious thing. 
It can be contained, hidden, locked away, 
and yet it always breaks free.

When the demon Goat plays his flute,
And cloven hooves clip-clop your path,
Pray the gods will hold you mute,
And bless the fire on your hearth.

There is a story held by the ancient Vaal, in which the
beautiful seductress Arakaali strode through towns, stealing
the hearts of men, and turning to ash their lovers' desires.
- "Legends of the Vaal" by Eramir, Scholar at Theopolis
flavour.DivineVesselArakaali2:
When the cold was at its strongest, Arakaali came,
and like a farmer leading cattle to the slaughter,
she drove her victims into the outer darkness.
- "Legends of the Vaal" by Eramir, Scholar at Theopolis
flavour.DivineVesselArakaali3:
Records of Arakaali's violent reign suggest she kept her citizens
sedated with 'juices of lust' and venoms of the spider. Perhaps her
guise of seductress was in fact her way of farming those 'juices'.
- "Legends of the Vaal" by Eramir, Scholar at Theopolis
flavour.DivineVesselBrineKing1:

the Brine King stood steadfast in his hatred,
and wore it like a shell, protecting himself 
from his failure to sire a worthy heir.
flavour.DivineVesselBrineKing2:
The fish-wives of Tsoatha rejoiced loudly as
the Brine King descended into the great abyss,
making merry while his blasphemous offspring
slithered 'neath the icy waters...
flavour.DivineVesselBrineKing3:
Slumbering in the breach between worlds,
the Brine King dreamt of a day he would rise,
in triumph from the shivering depths and take
back the Kingdom he once so ruthlessly culled.

Garukhan wished once more for the skies. If she were to die,
she wanted it to be up there in the clouds. This world had never
been her home. She required greater things. She required adventure.
But die she would, here in the dirt...

The earth shakes, moon eclipses black.
Graveyards quake, crops turn to ash,
as the grieving mother weeps.
Oceans boil and wind ravages home. 
We feel famine inside our bones,
as the grieving mother, Gruthkul weeps.
flavour.DivineVesselLunaris1:
Once beneath a moonlit sky, Lunaris bathed her child in the ocean's tide.
Though the waters were frigid with icy death, the boy was sick and
couldn't be healthy until he was silent, clean and still...

And so it was, that Lunaris, in her compulsion to nurture and protect,
killed her son beneath the light of a waning moon. She stood silent, in
trial before her tribe, as her fiery sister fought in vain to defend her...
flavour.DivineVesselLunaris3:
But Lunaris refused to admit any wrongdoing. She'd saved her child, had she not?
He was safe now, buried beneath the dirt. Conviction gnarled around her fragile mind,
and in her pride she rose to seat a deathless throne.
flavour.DivineVesselRalakesh:
"Lock the gates and build the walls!" came the rallying cry,
"Let those of Ralakesh take care of those of Ralakesh!"
- The God Behind The Wall
flavour.DivineVesselRyslatha:
Ryslatha was flushed with pride as she watched her mindless spawn
mature. Sharpening their mandibles, her children slithered from the hive,
eager to devour all the creatures that frequented the ancient woods.
flavour.DivineVesselShakari:
"So it's true." Shakari thought, as she took her final breath.
"My father, Sin, wishes me dead. And he has sent his rabid dog to do it..."
flavour.DivineVesselSolaris1:
The mud is cracked and dry. The fields now burn beneath the blistering sun.
Even our children are dying in the streets! We've angered Solaris and so
we pay tribute to appease her fiery heart...
flavour.DivineVesselSolaris2:
When Solaris is angered, there must always be sacrifice. Our women
have taken to mourning, they drag themselves through ash and glass,
not wanting to give up our youth to the all-consuming flame.
flavour.DivineVesselSolaris3:
To take from the sun is to invite her wrath, and we've more than warranted her curse.
The granaries were vacant, so we lessened our tribute to the sun thinking it would
save our children, but they will die now regardless.
flavour.DivineVesselTukohama:

from Hikatomanga and his family. The Father of War's
retribution was inevitable, for it is known - man
cannot cheat the gods without consequence...
flavour.DivineVesselYugul:

Terror flourishes in our world, transcending all things. It is the bedrock on
which our great cosmos is formed. I am Yugul and I deign to understand this
mystery, to explore its depths and unlock its secrets...
flavour.DoedresMadness: "Hold your tongue before I claim it." - Doedre Darktongue

the war never ends.

flavour.DominationScarabOfEvolution: The Atlas and Wraeclast share one terrifying secret.
flavour.DominationScarabOfTerrors: Whatever the prize, fight for it.

The minds of men are but motes
on a sea of infinite madness.

Voll, newly crowned,
had many of the
Eternal Empire's signature
extravagances destroyed.

can be made predictable.

flavour.FaridunBossKey:
"Darkness lurks within us all. The void from beyond
Time ever seeks to reclaim what we have stolen. Do
you think your fate will be any different from mine?"
flavour.FatedUnique1:
Kaom guided his Karui across the sea
and spilled their blood on foreign soil.
flavour.FatedUnique10:

as wild as an unwatched flame.

Let it pierce you, let blood flow.
Make more room for the soul to grow.

flavour.FatedUnique14: What goes out must come in.
flavour.FatedUnique15: Even the mightiest tree was once just a sapling.

but the soul remains unbroken.

than I could ever wish for."

passed right beneath his chin.

The peasants overwhelmed the guards.
The nobles paid for their lives.
The nobles took her throne,
and so she fled to the woods.

flavour.FatedUnique27:
"At last, my beauty is beyond reproach."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal

It was Doedre who learned that pain is just
as much about fear as it is about injury.
flavour.FatedUnique29_:
You cannot control the storm,
but you can utilise it.
flavour.FatedUnique3: There is no wall thicker or stronger than fear.

a new world will be born.

Set the world 'fore you alight.

Your mind goes dark, your body weak.
flavour.FatedUnique36:
Embrace your burning ambition.
Embrace your frozen heart.
You will be transformed.

flavour.FatedUnique44: The breath of life is theirs to take.

like the Great Meginord of the North

Hyrri's quick thinking led to victory,

The chorus gathers to begin.
Stacatto, drone, a rest drawn long,
Another hears Death's final song.

Make a man hot, and his heart will skip a beat.
Set a man on fire, and his heart will skip all beats.
flavour.FatedUnique51:
The night dances on
Wine continues to flow
Your skin looking pale
Your soul letting go
flavour.FatedUnique52:
"Confess your sins to me. My god will not be nearly so forgiving."
- Archbishop Geofri of Phrecia Cathedral
flavour.FatedUnique53:
"Please, take whatever you want. Just don't kill me"
"But then I wouldn't have everything I want, would I?"
flavour.FatedUnique54: As death arrives, so too does instinct.
flavour.FatedUnique55:
Legend tells of a time when Solaris will
burst forth from Lunaris,
and night will be eternally banished.
flavour.FatedUnique56:
One more partner by the hand,
Let your steps entwine.
Spin together, swing as one,
And dance with death in trine.
flavour.FatedUnique57:
"Stand steadfast in the face of destruction.
The Council cannot afford to falter."
- Mauritius, the Iron Heart
flavour.FatedUnique58:
The weight of faith is great
Yet it is never borne alone.
flavour.FatedUnique59_:
Even the dead dare not
trespass into Ullr's dominion.
flavour.FatedUnique6: Nothing spreads fear faster than the unknown.
flavour.FatedUnique60:
"Though Geofri's beacon was extinguished,
his embers may yet light our way."
- Victario, The People's Poet
flavour.FatedUnique61: As you guided me, now I guide others.
flavour.FatedUnique7: The largest rock leaves the deepest mark.
flavour.FatedUnique8:
Fire spreads thick and fast.
The first spark is never the last.
flavour.FatedUnique9:
Flames to guide the Great Spirit to the site of the dead,
and smoke to carry them into the sky.
flavour.Faustus1:
"Darnaw is stupid and confident.
I am certain he will have recorded his misdeeds."
flavour.Faustus2:
"Fidium's fealty to fairness 
makes him the perfect pawn in my plan.
Our plan. Perfect pawn in OUR plan."
flavour.FearKeyFlavourText: A single harsh word can haunt us forever.
flavour.ForbiddenPower: Some things should not be used. Some power is too great a risk.
flavour.FortressMapFlavour:
Machinery is merely the shaping
of reality by the mind.
flavour.FragmentUniqueAmulet1_1: Perfect knowledge is only possible in an empty universe.
flavour.FragmentUniqueAmulet1_2:
When hunger can never be satiated, the
act of eating becomes the only solace.
flavour.FragmentUniqueAmulet1_3: The future holds infinite promise... as does she.
flavour.FragmentUniqueAmulet1_4: All that is will one day come to naught.
flavour.GemcuttersPromise: "I swore to use my position to help the people. What good is power when it just accumulates on the already-powerful?" - Erasmus, Imperial Gemcutter
flavour.GiftOfTheGemlingQueen:
Our Lady Dialla,
as a symbol of our progress,
shines greater than all the gems.
flavour.GlimmerOfHope: When you dwell in total darkness, even the faintest light may guide you out.
flavour.GraspingMailFlavourText:
Of ash and avalanche,
in storm and flesh,
we dream of unity.
The time approaches...
flavour.GraveKnowledge: The dead tell me great insights. They've had nothing but time to sit and think.
flavour.HarmonyOfSouls:
Shrieking souls locked away 
Hate splits frozen cells asunder 
The knot of corruption
undone at last
flavour.HarvestScarab: Hidden routes lead to vales of shadow and light...
flavour.HarvestScarabOfCornucopia: The taller the tree, the better the fruit.
flavour.HeistAbberathine Horns:
"As warm as living flesh, and smelling strongly of sulphite.
Morbid curiosity compels me to add it to my collection of oddities."
flavour.HeistAdiyah1:
"When hope was but a memory, the twin sister Sekhemas Solerai and Lundara arose to unite the Maraketh.
They wielded the essence of gold and silver. The Spear is one of the two weapons that forged us."
flavour.HeistAdiyah2:
"Wraeclast is harsh, and the Plains of Vastiri are unforgiving. We Maraketh can
ill afford an internal war. We must prove that Nashta is behind these attacks."
flavour.HeistAdmiralProclarsPipe:
"Admiral Proclar wreaked havoc on my smuggling routes for two full decades. Now that he's dead, 
it's a matter of thieves' honour to check whether my product was in his pipe."
flavour.HeistAlchemicalChalice:
"The chalice holds certain properties that make scientists quite possessive and irrational.
It's best if you don't ask too many questions about this one."
flavour.HeistAncientSeal:
"At first glance, this seal seems no more than an ornament. But when one
looks closer, one realizes the design is from no culture we yet know of."
flavour.HeistBloodOfInnocence:
"In the early days of his religion, Innocence told his followers to drink of his blood and
enjoy eternal life. If that power holds in his ancient ichor, I hope that it can resurrect as well."
flavour.HeistBoxofTripyxis:
"Allegedly turns water to Lethe. That makes it my competition. 
I don't like competition."
flavour.HeistCelestialStone:
"This unassuming rock reportedly fell from the sky a few centuries ago. Sounds impossible,
but the men who are guarding it obviously believe the tale, so I do, too."
flavour.HeistCrestofEzomyr:
"A symbol of my birthright and claim to my fiefdom. 
I must have it if I am to return my family to its rightful place."
flavour.HeistDekharasResolve:
"A simple ornament from the days when Keth's trade empire was the
glory of the world. Protectors at the massive toll gates wore these."
flavour.HeistEldritchBlade:
"The Eldritch Blade is one half of a pair. Together, the two are said to drive men
insane by revealing the truth of the world to them. I wish to know this truth."
flavour.HeistEmperorCaspiro:
"Caspiro was a master of presentation. He maintained peace in Wraeclast through displays
of strength that, sadly, had no meaning to the dark presence that dismembered him..."
flavour.HeistEnigmaticAssemblyA:
"I currently possess four-hundred and forty-four pieces of this ancient
and puzzling device. A few seem to be missing. This part is crucial."
flavour.HeistEnigmaticAssemblyB:
"There is no telling what this device may do when completed, but I
have made it my life's work. There must be a deeper meaning!"
flavour.HeistEnigmaticAssemblyC:
"I have spent my family's entire fortune in the pursuit of this device.
Assembling it and turning it on is all I have left."
flavour.HeistEnigmaticAssemblyD:
"My schematics are clear. Once the Enigmatic Assembly is complete, it
will be a weapon to rival the gods! It must be... it has to be..."
flavour.HeistEssenceBurner:
"Trust in scientists to create tools for better drug distillation. They don't know the
worth of the beautiful tools they have. Let's make sure it stays that way."
flavour.HeistEzMyraeTome:
"A true curiosity. Matches no known language, yet its illustrations hint at knowledge 
only rediscovered hundreds of years after the death of its unknown author."
flavour.HeistFlaskOfWelakath:
"Long ago, a traitor was promised this mythical elixir. We consider her a fool for
believing it exists, but if it does... I would certainly like to take a sip and find out."
flavour.HeistForbiddenLamp:
"The lamp is said to contain Aziza, the Fourth Servant of Water. I doubt the tale
is true, but I cannot allow one of our artifacts to fall into Kondor's hands."
flavour.HeistGianna1:
"I heard the script will send any who attempt to perform it mad,
but other than that, it is very good."
flavour.HeistGianna2:
"Make sure it'll fit a small man, or a very large child.
And check for stains! Knew a few people who'd use them for-... 
...Just check for stains."
flavour.HeistGoddessOfWater:
"The relief depicts some sort of forgotten Maraketh goddess. I have no idea what
the context is. The important thing is that you steal it before Bazira does."
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol1:
"I found the tomb in the first place, and they had the nerve to empty it without me! 
Reckon it'll make a fine trophy for my efforts."
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol10: The last shimmering face witnessed by many a sacrifice.
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol11: Silently keeps innumerable secrets whispered in moments of desperation.
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol12: At once horrid and beautiful, awkward and alluring, silly and overwhelmingly mysterious.
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol13: Dried blood remains trapped in its many deep grooves.
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol2:
"One must, as one should, admire the lasting works of those who came before.
The Vaal were the uncontested greatest architects until we,
and Matatl soared above their best."
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol3:
"I believe she was a beautiful maiden. 
Kind, virtuous and devout through-and-through.
Such a gift will set me apart from all other suitors."
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol4:
"Victims of war, the indebted, and the irredeemably shamed
were to live their lives in servitude. Some rose above their station. 
This individual, it seems, was all but deified."
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol5:
"Heard if you put a drop of blood in its mouth,
it'll whisper the secrets of immortality.
Doesn't have to be your own blood, does it?"
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol6:
"I'll give it to her and tell her
'It once held the reflection of a Queen, and now it will once more.'
Anton can cross the Vastiri on his family fruits 
if he thinks he loves her like I do."
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol7_: Once cast the reflections of royalty, now worth the sum of its parts.
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol8: Ornately adorned and heavier than is practical.
flavour.HeistGoldenIdol9: A common figure adorning Vaal ruins, but exquisitely crafted from gold.
flavour.HeistGoldenToucan:
"It is said that the Golden Ibis was forged before time itself, before writing, or even
oral history. That's nonsense, of course, but it's still very old, and therefore noteworthy."
flavour.HeistHandofArimor:
"Balabus Arimor was a little-known preacher during the days of Emperor Chitus,
who believed eternal life could be achieved through ritual sacrifice.
We shall see whether he was a prophet - or a charlatan."
flavour.HeistHeartCoil:
"There are very few devices in this world that can act as a heart for a
machine. This one is an ancient remnant of the work of Vaal engineers."
flavour.HeistHuck1:
"Lost touch with a mate of mine when
he got recruited into some secret squad.
Just want to see how he's doing."
flavour.HeistHuck2:
"Enoch deserved better. 
This is the least I can do."
flavour.HeistImpossibleCrystal:
"The world is governed by certain natural laws. Science and thaumaturgy are one
and the same. But the crystal... it shouldn't exist. It's not from here. We must have it."
flavour.HeistIncenseofKeth:
"Sap of the Aturi tree, known only to grow at the meeting point of the seven waters.
Nothing since its disappearance has smelled as wondrous."
flavour.HeistIsla1: My inventions, my babies, deserve to be in better hands!
flavour.HeistIsla2:
...the blueprints for my Extreme Warmth Beam, my Storm Wooing Rod,
the Mind Sublimator, and the Unbreakable...!
flavour.HeistKarst1:
"They were me granddaddy's. 
Could break into any house as quick and silent as a Cardinal's fart."
flavour.HeistKarst2:
"Traitorous scum took the life I could've had. 
I ain't usually the forgiving type, 
but I feel in this case that I owe him a little gift."
flavour.HeistKarst3_: "Never take credit for another man's work."
flavour.HeistLivingIce:
"Are we the only ones who understand the danger? The fools! Living ice absorbs heat
and grows. We must control it properly, lest it spread across all of Wraeclast."
flavour.HeistNenet1:
"If we can prove Jamanra existed, then the Faridun may have a chance to rejoin the
Maraketh. I, for one, would like to meet my parents. I have many questions..."
flavour.HeistNiles1:
"There is nothing quite so exquisite as a forced confession. The sufferer will
say anything to make the pain stop, and that's the point. Guilt is irrelevant."
flavour.HeistNiles2:
"It supposedly causes enormous plants to grow from almost any soil. The myth claims we
need to sacrifice a baby to make it function, but that's a bit grotesque, even for me."
flavour.HeistOghamCandelabra:
"Those Eternal bastards looted everything that wasn't bolted to the floor when we
finally drove them from our island! That candelabra belongs with us!"
flavour.HeistOrbalasFifthAdventure:
"The relief was the first ever depiction of some Maraketh girl named Orbala undertaking her
fifth great adventure. I don't particularly care about the story, I just don't want Bazira to have it."
flavour.HeistSeaPearlHeirloom:
"My accursed father owes his children this heirloom. We deserve
to know our culture, just like you full-blooded humans do."
flavour.HeistSealOfLunaris:
"I have a suspicion that the Maraketh Sekhema of legend, Lundara, is the same historical
figure as the Azmeri and Eternal goddess Lunaris. The Seal may prove that."
flavour.HeistSealOfSolaris:
"It is my belief that Solerai, from the Maraketh legend, is Solaris herself in another system of
myths. If I can prove that, I can begin piecing together a true history of the Winter of the World."
flavour.HeistStaffOfTheFirstSinEater:
"The history of the order of Sin Eaters is shrouded in secrecy and shame.
Nevertheless, history demands truth, even if it takes centuries to be revealed."
flavour.HeistSwordOfTheInverseRelic:
"By all accounts, the Sword of the Inverse Relic was found aged and rusted,
but is becoming less weathered over time. We really must study its properties."
flavour.HeistTibbs1:
"Loved her like she was my own daughter.
I just want to know she's safe."
flavour.HeistTibbs2:
"Damn near everything I've earned. 
Worth every little bit."
flavour.HeistTullina1: "Let's just hope she wasn't wearing it when she wandered into the sea!"
flavour.HeistTullina2: "It isn't fair to either of us to keep chasing this dream."
flavour.HeistTuskedHominidSkull:
"If the skull is real, and not a forgery, then it may show that my people are not the
abominations others believe us to be. The word 'human' may have a broader meaning."
flavour.HeistUrnOfFarud:
"The Faridun cannot earn burial in the sky.
They have other ways of keeping the dead."
flavour.HeistUrnOfTheOriginalAshes:
"A great fire once swept the land, and our leaders were turned to ash where they stood.
The urn contains exactly what you think it does, and serves as proof of our long lineage."
flavour.HeistVinderi1:
"Just the usual highly-illegal compounds.
Don't drop them. It's fine if you do, but don't."
flavour.HeistVinderi2:
"I wish I could say this was the first time I've forgotten to restock on this thing. 
I forget what it was, but I'm sure I'll remember by the time we need to get it.
Was it beetles? Bottles? I think it began with 'B'.
Or it had no 'B'."
flavour.HerMask:
To her beauty you submit,
lest your neck the great Queen slit.
flavour.Heterochromia:
Black and White, Silver and Gold
Let us see the world Unfold
Red and Blue, Yellow and Green
Let us remake it in colours Unseen
flavour.HiveBrainNodeFlavourText:
Countless voices murmur,
singing of the Hive...
flavour.Hope: The others succumbed to madness and depravity, but Lori fought on. Alone in the darkness, she could still see the dull light of hope's distant dawn.
flavour.HornedScarabOfAntagonism: Glory draws ever tighter its own doom.
flavour.HornedScarabOfChampions: Only the hardiest survive. Only survivors perpetuate.
flavour.HornedScarabOfCharts: The Atlas can be anything you want... and everything you want.
flavour.HornedScarabOfGlittering: Wealth flows to those that shine brightest.
flavour.HornedScarabOfOpulence: May Prospero favour you in all your endeavours.
flavour.HornedScarabOfPlenty: To the strongest, prosperity be thine.
flavour.HornedScarabOfPreservation: We must not forget those who came before.
flavour.HornedScarabOfTitans: Punctured dreams bleed into the mind.
flavour.HouseOfMirrors: What do you see in the mirror?
flavour.Hubris:
"This one? It is NOT for sale. You would sooner pry it from my lifeless hand."
- Jonfé Darontos, Ringmaker
flavour.HuntersResolve:
Primed, curved and sleek.
Decisive and final.
For malice and righteousness.
There's but one solution.
flavour.HuntersReward: To tame a beast, you first must subdue its heart.
flavour.IgnoranceKeyFlavourText: Grief can divide, greater than any gulf.
flavour.ImmortalResolve: The threads of fate are the strongest ties.
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleDefault: "Grand plans were laid for a place called Atzoatl, though fierce bickering between its Architects is said to have stifled its development." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Research Report
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Armour: "Armour crafted at Atzoatl became the envy of the known world." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Ancient Metals
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Atziri: "Evidence suggests that Atzoatl's influence grew great enough that Atziri herself moved her seat of power to within its walls." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Royal Decree cast in Bronze
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Breach: "Atzoatl played host to the Cult of the Purple Flame. I do not know what powers they worshipped, but my educated guesses leave me shaken." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Embalmed Claw
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Corrupt: "Atzoatl was a locus of Corruption, a temple dedicated to the worship of the unspeakable." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Eroded Vaal Orb
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Currenc: "In their paranoia, the Architects of Atzoatl hoarded wealth beyond any reasonable measure." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Vaal Golden Idol
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Damage: "At the height of their civilization, the Vaal took to ritual combat to solve all of their disputes. As a result, their surviving warriors were among the best in history." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Rust-coated Sword
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Explosi: "Atzoatl was a place of crude alchemy rather than art." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Urn of Unstable Powder
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Fire: "The Vaal were said to have experimented with fire at Atzoatl, though to what end is unknown." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Charred Parchment
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Gem: "Doryani himself conducted gem research at Atzoatl in its final days. What brilliant discoveries were lost with that temple?" - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Third Ciphered Tablet
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Ghost: "The Architects were certainly fond of their ghost stories. The tales almost sound as if the business was taken literally." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Carved Fable
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Hatcher: "A great many creatures were bred at Atzoatl, ostensibly due to repeated invasion by some kind of horrifying murderous entity." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Fossilized Egg Sac
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Jewelle: "Trade with lesser cultures, such as the Maraketh and the early Karui, resulted in overflowing vaults full of golden trinkets and elegant jewels." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, 'Dekhara's Resolve'
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Legion: "The Architects intended to research supposed 'Obelisks Beyond Time,' but the Vaal fell before the first obtained monolith was so much as measured." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Crystal Shard
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Lightni: "The Architects apparently sought to master lightning. They may have succeeded just before the fall." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Copper Detritus
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Map: "In its last days, the Architects of Atzoatl became increasingly obsessed with fictional lands. Wondrous lands, by their description, but fictional. Very odd." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Unidentified Angular Device
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Museum: "Much could be learned from the relics said to be kept in Atzoatl. We consider the Vaal ancient, so what did they consider ancient in turn?" - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Vaal Mural
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Nexus: "The heart of Atzoatl imbued its denizens with vigour, according to the myths." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Glowing Stone
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3PackSiz: "A great many warriors were stationed at Atzoatl, ostensibly due to repeated invasion by something referred to as 'a haunting death.'" - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Carved Interment Records
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Poison: "The Vaal had little concern for the externalities of their engineering. The toxins produced by their manufacturing may have poisoned the entirety of Atzoatl." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Desiccated Corpse of a Vaal Citizen
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Restora: "The Architects sought immortality... perhaps they reside within Atzoatl still..." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Vial of Emerald Water
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Sacrifi: "When the Vaal discovered power could be gained from sacrificing the living, Atzoatl became a death march for the lower classes." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Obsidian Sacrificial Knife
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Strongb: "Zantipi is said to have spent most of his considerable talent devising ambushes that used the promise of treasure as a lure for would-be looters." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Broken Locking Mechanism
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Tempest: "Merchant carvings of the era consistently reported that the Architects could alter the weather in manners terrifying and incomprehensible." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Trade Record Tablet
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Trap: "Expedition logs suggest quite a few explorers sought Atzoatl over the centuries. The Architects planned against this potential plundering, however, with ingenious and lethal traps." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Corroded Spring Mechanism
flavour.IncursionItemisedTempleT3Worksho: "Their engineering knowledge may have rivaled that of the modern world. The fall of the Vaal no doubt set humanity back a thousand years." - Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Ancient Gear Interlock
flavour.IncursionScarab: Uncover the secrets of the Vaal one incursion at a time.
flavour.IncursionScarabOfChampions: Only the best served in Atzoatl.
flavour.IncursionScarabOfInvasion: A gate, once opened, may swing in either direction.
flavour.IncursionScarabOfTimelines: They say if you go far enough, you will meet yourself...
flavour.IncursionVialBossAmulet: Festivities of blood. Bleeding hearts and screaming lungs.
flavour.IncursionVialBossFlask:
With great tragedy and power,
the dead are netted in anguish.
flavour.IncursionVialBossJewel:
It is not our flesh, our thoughts, or our soul that limits us;
it is the distinction between them.
flavour.IncursionVialFire:
Ancient myths of flame, frost and thunder.
Will we ever know the way forward?
flavour.IncursionVialHealing: Call to place the demon gods of the past.
flavour.IncursionVialLightning:
The ritual creates order. 
Both in the minds of men and gods. 
The ritual creates order.
flavour.IncursionVialMinion:
Your actions live but a moment;
their repercussions never die.
flavour.IncursionVialPoison: The eyes of Apep flicker open and the Poisoned One stirs.
flavour.IncursionVialTrap:
Blood, slaves and stone.
The timeless edifice of Dominance.
flavour.InfluencingScarabOfConversion: Memories resound in the Atlas, echoing forever.
flavour.InfluencingScarabOfTheElder: Beyond the light lies only the void.
flavour.InfluencingScarabOfTheShaper: A sea of stars awaits those who dare imagine.
flavour.JackInTheBox:
Turn the crank, 
close your eyes, 
and pray to the gods 
for a pleasant surprise.
flavour.KalguuranRune1:
The Sun, magnanimous on its throne, gifts
heat and light to all those it surveys.
flavour.KalguuranRune2:
Sometimes, it is the connections between, rather
than the things themselves, that matters most.
flavour.KalguuranRune3:
All living things move and change in patterns
that cannot be seen until they are gone.
flavour.KalguuranRune4__:
No energy in this world stands alone.
There is always an opposite.
flavour.KalguuranRune5: All things flow. Stillness is an illusion.
flavour.KalguuranRune6_: Plenty is a matter of perspective.
flavour.KalguuranRune7:
Though you may not know
your destination, it exists.
flavour.KalguuranRune8:
The difference between here and
there is merely a single climb.
flavour.KeybladeText: Forged from thousands of unclaimed Beta keys
flavour.Kurai1:
"A symbolic piece of history,
from a time when people of all backgrounds
united against a common enemy."
flavour.Kurai3:
"I won't be bullied.
We must get Hana back."
flavour.LabyrinthBaneOfTheLoyal:
A snake cannot survive without its head.
But neither can the head survive without the body.
flavour.LabyrinthCogsOfDisruption:
Take a cog here, place a cog there,
and the great machine grinds to a halt.
flavour.LabyrinthCubeOfAbsorption: Beware the one who seeks to contain a storm.
flavour.LabyrinthHeartOfTheGargoyle:
All living things need a heart,
even those made of stone.
No heart, no life.
flavour.LabyrinthOrbOfElementalEssence: Return Nature's gift to the source.
flavour.LabyrinthPortalShredder:
The best way to keep out an unwanted guest
Is to simply close the door.
flavour.LabyrinthRodOfDetonation: What can be built, can be destroyed.
flavour.LabyrinthSandOfEternity: That which takes an eternity does not happen.
flavour.LantadorsLostLove:
They fought the storm together as one, 
Until the longest of days was done. 
Their love grew stronger
with every breath, 
Until it was broken apart in death.
flavour.LastHope: As their civilisation crumbled, the Vaal looked to their queen. In her, they saw a way out. In them, she saw a burden she was happy to free herself from.
flavour.LeftToFate:
Many strive for greatness,
but it is challenge, unforeseen,
that forges heroes.
flavour.LegionFragmentEternal: The relentless brutality of the Eternals...
flavour.LegionFragmentKarui: The unmatched discipline of the Karui...
flavour.LegionFragmentMaraketh: The strategic heights of the Maraketh...
flavour.LegionFragmentTemplar: The bludgeoning faith of the Templars...
flavour.LegionFragmentVaal: The boundless thaumaturgy of the Vaal...
flavour.LegionScarab: What good is peace to a warrior?
flavour.LegionScarabOfOfficers: Even a battlefield has middle management.
flavour.LegionScarabOfTheSekhema_: Storms of blood-stained sand will drown the enemies of the Maraketh.
flavour.LegionScarabOfTreasures: Ancient Hoards imbued with powerful Artifacts.
flavour.LightAndTruth:
Time and change
shall naught avail,
To dim the Light
of Truth's fair grail.
flavour.LingeringRemnants:
Never dying, yet not living,
Endlessly they wander
beneath the harvest moon.
flavour.LostWorlds:
"There are worlds that lie beyond the edge of my page, the edge of my understanding. Worlds of wonder. Worlds of terror."
Aramil - Cartographer to Emperor Chitus
flavour.Loyalty:
Bound by fate,
inseparable by choice.
flavour.LuckOfTheVaal:
They can't be THAT lucky,
or they'd still be here!
flavour.LuckyConnections: Luck is a fool's game, and I know plenty of rich fools.
flavour.LuckyDeck: When the outcome is the same, does it matter if it is fortune or trickery?
flavour.LysahsRespite:
So many memories,
so much pain in
such a small token.
Drown it in blood
so you can forget.
flavour.MapWorldsAcademy:
They came for enlightenment,
but were imprisoned by madness.
flavour.MapWorldsAcidLakes:
Clear water springs forth.
A moment of purity before it too gathers filth.
flavour.MapWorldsAlleyways:
An unwashed gutter, where wretches
cut purses and throats alike.
flavour.MapWorldsAncientCity:
This was not the first
civilization to believe itself
the greatest. And it will
not be the last.
flavour.MapWorldsArachnidNest:
Man is not the only beast to
bend nature to its will.
flavour.MapWorldsArachnidTomb:
They feel your every move,
your every breath,
with a million little wires.
flavour.MapWorldsArcade:
We create so that some part
of us may remain after death.
flavour.MapWorldsArena:
The sound of a thousand calls
for blood echo for eternity.
flavour.MapWorldsAridLake:
Water vanishes; an impromptu
prison becomes a tomb.
flavour.MapWorldsArmoury:
There is no war. There is no army.
Only fear lingers.
flavour.MapWorldsArsenal:
There is no war. There is no army.
Only rage lingers.
flavour.MapWorldsAshenWood:
Desperately reaching skyward
and digging downwards.
Sustenance is an
eternal struggle.
flavour.MapWorldsAtoll:
Time turns even the vicious
volcanoes to hollow shells.
flavour.MapWorldsAtollUnique:
Whispers from
a world apart
Speak my name
beyond the tomb;
Bound within
the Maelström's heart,
Will they grant me
strength or doom?
flavour.MapWorldsBarrows:
Man burrows for only
the eternal hibernation.
flavour.MapWorldsBasilica:
Built so the prayers would echo.
A resonance no god could hear.
flavour.MapWorldsBazaar: Greed is the only god here.
flavour.MapWorldsBeach:
A paradise, forever replenished by
endless waves teeming with life.
flavour.MapWorldsBelfry:
Bells are rung in celebration, and in sorrow.
And, finally, in despair.
flavour.MapWorldsBog:
Layer upon layer of death and rot.
Disgusting.
flavour.MapWorldsBoneCrypt:
The dead ask to be remembered,
but such requests
are seldom met.
flavour.MapWorldsBoneCryptUnique:
They flew, and leapt,
and clambered over,
They crawled, and swam,
and slithered under.
Still its ancient secrets
await unclaimed
And of this hidden temple,
only legends remain.
flavour.MapWorldsBramblefall:
The faintest traces of civilisation
defiantly resist nature's scouring tendrils.
An admirable, but futile, effort.
flavour.MapWorldsBurialChambers:
Vile fiends hide beneath
the peaceful plains.
flavour.MapWorldsBurn:
Does the land reject the dead,
or do the dead reject their fate?
flavour.MapWorldsCage:
Treat a man like a wild animal,
and he will soon learn to bite.
flavour.MapWorldsCaldera:
From the heart of fire, rivers
of burning rage billow forth.
flavour.MapWorldsCanyon:
A deep wound in the land.
One that will never heal.
flavour.MapWorldsCarcass:
Life's wet, reproductive stink abates,
relenting to death's chaste ritual of decay.
flavour.MapWorldsCastleRuins:
When the castle falls,
it has failed its only purpose.
flavour.MapWorldsCells:
Life crushed together.
Left to crumble to dust.
flavour.MapWorldsCemetery: A stone forest of forgotten names.
flavour.MapWorldsCemeteryUnique:
Some dead have long
envied the living.
When given the chance,
they take from us what they can.
So we offer our suffrage.
In return, they give
only suffering.
flavour.MapWorldsChambersOfImpurity:
A constant malign presence, glowering,
hateful, wounding... the folly of belief.
flavour.MapWorldsChannel:
The stone cannot stop the torrent.
It can only divert it.
flavour.MapWorldsChateau: Beauty and brutality in such close proximity.
flavour.MapWorldsChateauUnique:
Forget kings and emperors;
He who holds the coin holds all the power.
flavour.MapWorldsChimera:
One of my captors hid a beast within his heart.
Now his true self can be seen by all.
flavour.MapWorldsCitySquare:
Countless generations have
walked these time-worn stones.
flavour.MapWorldsColdRiver:
Ice forges a fickle path,
as those beneath its veil can attest.
flavour.MapWorldsColonnade:
Small minds demand
the largest structures.
flavour.MapWorldsColosseum:
Life means as little as a passing
moment of entertainment.
Let them rot.
flavour.MapWorldsConservatory:
Ornate, elaborate, ostentatious...
and dripping with death.
flavour.MapWorldsCoralRuins:
Thrust above the waves, still teeming
with horrors from the depths.
flavour.MapWorldsCore:
Black monstrous bridges cross oily rivers,
leading nowhere. Nothing as it should be.
flavour.MapWorldsCourthouse:
Justice born of love is a surrender.
Justice born of law is a punishment.
flavour.MapWorldsCourtyard:
An elaborate, beautiful garden,
hidden from the public. Selfish.
flavour.MapWorldsCourtyardOfWasting: Hope leaves us open to the greatest of wounds.
flavour.MapWorldsCourtyardUnique:
To the east, 
it cannot be seen.
To the west, 
it cannot be touched.
To the south, 
it cannot be remembered.
And to the north, 
it cannot be contained.
flavour.MapWorldsCoves:
The dark seas swallow the careless
and spit them against sharp rocks.
flavour.MapWorldsCrimsonTemple: A sanguine supplication to death and depravity.
flavour.MapWorldsCrimsonTownship:
Rain will wash away the stains,
but the madness and memories will never fade.
flavour.MapWorldsCrystalOre_:
As the torch flickers, brilliance
emerges in boundless variance.
flavour.MapWorldsCursedCrypt:
Saints and heathens look the same
once the rot takes hold.
flavour.MapWorldsCursedCryptUnique:
For his sins
he was hunted in his sleep,
judgement wrought
of twisted nightmare.
The Coward bound
his dreams to stone,
awaiting another to walk
the path of true atonement.
flavour.MapWorldsDarkForest:
The trees grow twisted and gnarled,
without a hint of light.
A curse lingers here.
flavour.MapWorldsDefiledCathedral:
Crafted with reverence.
Defiled with ease.
flavour.MapWorldsDesert:
Heat. Dust. Wind. These are what
forge strong minds and bodies.
flavour.MapWorldsDesertSpring:
As mirage becomes reality,
hardship is briefly quenched.
flavour.MapWorldsDig:
A hollow echo of bygone times
in a land where none lived long.
flavour.MapWorldsDrySea:
Where once waves crashed with crushing force,
brittle wooden bones tell tall tales.
flavour.MapWorldsDunes:
Shifting, morphing, expanding. A reminder
of the virtues of an agile mind.
flavour.MapWorldsDungeon:
A penitentiary for those who are not penitent
is nothing more than an inn for the evil.
flavour.MapWorldsEstuary:
Where land springs from water,
life will shortly follow.
flavour.MapWorldsExcavation:
Two unexplored frontiers remain:
The skies and the soil.
flavour.MapWorldsFactory:
Repetition. Convention. Duplication.
Creation distilled to perfection.
flavour.MapWorldsFields:
They pleaded for the gods to bless their land.
Now they lie under the soil.
flavour.MapWorldsFloodedMine:
In darkness, beast and man
alike clamour to survive.
flavour.MapWorldsForkingRiver:
Great stone towers tore at the natural order
and were promptly put in their place.
flavour.MapWorldsFrozenCabins:
The fleet lay stranded in the winter wastes,
those aboard to never again see the light of day.
flavour.MapWorldsGardens:
Vibrant colours dash across the grey,
consuming Man's work.
flavour.MapWorldsGeode:
Many hands may
move a mountain.
flavour.MapWorldsGhetto:
Amongst the rabble,
brutality is the law.
flavour.MapWorldsGorge:
We must all walk the narrow, winding path.
The end is always the same.
flavour.MapWorldsGrotto:
Trapped in absolute darkness.
Despair. Panic. Terror.
flavour.MapWorldsHauntedMansion:
Forlorn and sorrowful, this once opulent
ruin conceals the sins of a fallen line.
flavour.MapWorldsHydra:
One of my captors wore many faces,
yet kept her true face hidden.
Now she cannot escape her true face.
flavour.MapWorldsIceberg:
Icy fangs seek tender hulls
to sink themselves into.
flavour.MapWorldsInfestedValley:
Should we feel disgusted at how the weak predate
the strong, or should we feel... admiration?
flavour.MapWorldsIvoryTemple:
Man and nature intertwined,
but only for the chosen few.
flavour.MapWorldsJungleValley: Verdant canopies shroud the world in darkness.
flavour.MapWorldsLaboratory:
My last waking moments looked very
much like this place... I miss it. I miss her.
flavour.MapWorldsLair:
In darkness, the alpha rises. The companionship
of beasts is fragile indeed.
flavour.MapWorldsLavaChamber:
Fiend and fortune-hunter alike turned to ash.
A sorry alliance of unending agony.
flavour.MapWorldsLavaLake:
At the heart of a peaceful, secluded valley,
an island of burning, consuming fury.
flavour.MapWorldsLeyline:
Amidst the barren wastes,
a slender strand of life blooms.
flavour.MapWorldsLighthouse:
Fire ignites the sky.
A signal to keep away.
An invitation to invade.
flavour.MapWorldsLookout:
A glorious vista once exclusive
to emperors. Not anymore.
flavour.MapWorldsMalformation:
Boils swell from the earth.
Foul malignant flesh
without purpose.
flavour.MapWorldsMarshes:
Embraced by mud. Grasped by roots.
The careless are silently swallowed.
flavour.MapWorldsMausoleum:
A vault for the dead, as if
they were valuable. Pathetic.
flavour.MapWorldsMaze:
They live trapped forever in darkness
and confusion. We are no different.
flavour.MapWorldsMazeUnique: We are ever the makers of our own undoing.
flavour.MapWorldsMesa:
Barren and sun-bleached.
Emptiness as far as
the eye can reach.
flavour.MapWorldsMineralPools:
God's jar of raw materials.
Life lying dormant,
waiting to sprout.
flavour.MapWorldsMinotaur:
One of my captors felt no emotion.
He did not hesitate to inflict pain.
Now all he feels is intense, unstoppable agony.
flavour.MapWorldsMoonTemple:
Night's promises are dark, for
even the stars must be harvested.
flavour.MapWorldsMoonTempleUnique:
In the shadow of war,
all are eclipsed.
flavour.MapWorldsMudGeyser:
Filth springs forth like blood
from a severed jugular.
flavour.MapWorldsMuseum:
Ancient artifacts and beautiful baubles.
All paid for in blood.
flavour.MapWorldsMuseumUnique:
Please take out your blades,
your whips, and your spikes.
Class is now in session.
flavour.MapWorldsNecropolis:
Even in death, we long to
be close to one another.
flavour.MapWorldsNecropolisUnique:
So the raiders danced,
leading their foe ever west,
towards certain death.
flavour.MapWorldsOrchard: The fruit that grows from bloody ground tastes sweetest.
flavour.MapWorldsOvergrownRuin:
Only fear remains unforgotten, where once
magnificent rites drew important crowds.
flavour.MapWorldsOvergrownShrine:
A once great monument,
now a forgotten memorial.
flavour.MapWorldsOvergrownShrineUnique:
Curious, she shook it then,
And tiny screams emerged.
Curiouser, she shook again,
And an eerie silence purred.
flavour.MapWorldsPalace:
Death forces even the most
determined of despots to
pass the crown.
flavour.MapWorldsPark: A brief respite in a sea of obligation and uncertainty.
flavour.MapWorldsPen:
Slaves held like cattle. A blood-soaked
revolution, just waiting to happen.
flavour.MapWorldsPeninsula:
The farmer no longer plows
or sows. Only the flattened
soil remains.
flavour.MapWorldsPhantasmagoria:
Every movement is watched,
recorded, remembered.
flavour.MapWorldsPhoenix:
One of my captors refused redemption.
He did not see value in a new life.
Now new life surrounds him.
flavour.MapWorldsPier:
Man's reach extends into
the ocean, clawing at
its infinite depths.
flavour.MapWorldsPit: Blood turns the soil to mud.
flavour.MapWorldsPlateau:
Steep cliffs divide where the trees
may grow, and where they may not.
flavour.MapWorldsPlaza: Drought took the plants, famine took the people.
flavour.MapWorldsPort:
The wealthy foolishly battle
the ocean for domain.
flavour.MapWorldsPrecinct:
Crushed together and fenced in,
to live out their lives like cattle.
flavour.MapWorldsPrimordialPool:
A dough of bad blood.
A yeast of ill will.
flavour.MapWorldsPromenade:
Even the greatest achievements
will eventually be abandoned.
flavour.MapWorldsPromenadeUnique:
The grandest and greatest
ever to fight,
Divine the champions stand tall.
But match their power,
best their might,
And even the immortal may fall.
flavour.MapWorldsRacecourse_: Rats chase their tails for the amusement of fools.
flavour.MapWorldsRamparts:
A wall is the surest sign for raiders
that there is something of value to take.
flavour.MapWorldsReef:
Each plank of rotting wood,
each dead sailor,
feeds the island and makes it grow.
flavour.MapWorldsRelicChambers:
Relics of a forbidden past.
Hidden away. Forgotten.
flavour.MapWorldsScriptorium:
Knowledge balanced atop a vast pit. Hold on,
or perish in the darkness of ignorance.
flavour.MapWorldsSepulchre:
Lives come and go.
Only bones and dust remain.
flavour.MapWorldsShapersRealm: The nexus of nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavour.MapWorldsShipyard:
The stone and lumber sleeps.
The captains are long dead.
Only the sea knows their end.
flavour.MapWorldsShore: Each life, each act, as fleeting as footprints in the sand.
flavour.MapWorldsShoreUnique:
The Treasures of the Tides
wait in agony
at the End of the World.
flavour.MapWorldsShrine: Black tiles don't stain so easily.
flavour.MapWorldsSiege: No rest, no peace, no negotiation. Only War.
flavour.MapWorldsSilo:
Grim blessings whispered in the deepest,
most secret of places.
flavour.MapWorldsSpiderForest:
Each branch, each leaf,
an extension of a web
that spans sanity.
flavour.MapWorldsSpiderLair:
Panic only hastens the venom's
passage to the heart.
flavour.MapWorldsSprings:
The water brings life,
the poison takes it away.
