flavour.MapWorldsStagnation_:
Aided by unrelenting rain,
rot devours new life at the first fumble.
flavour.MapWorldsStrand:
Nothing good washes up
on this dark shore.
flavour.MapWorldsStrandUnique:
We all began life in darkness,
we shall all end it there.
flavour.MapWorldsSulphurVents:
The creatures that prowl the wildest extremes,
nature anoints with cruel efficacy to defend her.
flavour.MapWorldsSummit:
We are swept ever upwards by our ambition,
with no thought of what awaits us at the peak.
flavour.MapWorldsSunkenCity:
From the walls, water, and ferns...
Death comes crawling on ancient steps.
flavour.MapWorldsTemple:
Immaculate white stone rises
from the abyss. Perfection.
flavour.MapWorldsTempleUnique:
Laughs of all the twisted
Echo through these
halls of gold.
In this cold forgotten void
They wander, forever uncontrolled.
flavour.MapWorldsTerrace:
A garden on a stone pedestal.
An incredible, and foolish, feat.
flavour.MapWorldsThaumaturgistsLair:
Ever does man look to emulate his creator,
only to match his indifference.
flavour.MapWorldsTheatreOfLies: Our reality is nothing but the stories we tell each other.
flavour.MapWorldsThicket:
Little light enters.
No life escapes.
flavour.MapWorldsTortureChamber:
Who is the true criminal, the one behind
bars, or the one who tortures him?
flavour.MapWorldsTortureChamberUnique:
"Here the soil is more deadly
than any swing of the axe."
- Oba of the Karui,
Conqueror of Corruption.
flavour.MapWorldsTower: We ascend to great heights to commit low acts.
flavour.MapWorldsToxicSewer:
Affluence and effluence, separated
by a few feet of soil.
flavour.MapWorldsTribunal: So much power in the hands of so few.
flavour.MapWorldsTropicalIsland:
The temptations of paradise
draw forth the good
and the bad alike.
flavour.MapWorldsUndergroundRiver:
Life, like still water, becomes trapped.
Stagnant. Foul.
flavour.MapWorldsUndergroundRiverUnique:
Howls and laughter
They hide in the day
They smell you, they watch you
They track their new prey
flavour.MapWorldsUndergroundSea:
Silent stillness. The waters are
as cold as they are black.
flavour.MapWorldsVaalPyramid:
A good slave is driven by
only two thoughts:
service and sacrifice.
flavour.MapWorldsVaalPyramidUnique:
"Should I depart this mortal coil,
so shall all of my treasures."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.MapWorldsVaalTemple:
Voices. Visions. Violence.
They will haunt these grounds for all of eternity.
flavour.MapWorldsVault:
Wealth beyond imagining,
locked beyond reach.
flavour.MapWorldsVilla:
Wealth is powerless to stop
the corroding force of time.
flavour.MapWorldsVolcano: Tremble in the might of the flames.
flavour.MapWorldsWasteland:
A white bone stripped of its fertile flesh.
Life spirals towards its end.
flavour.MapWorldsWaterways:
A river in the sky, far from that
which so desperately needs it.
flavour.MapWorldsWharf:
Reach out into the abyss,
and the abyss reaches back.
flavour.MavenKey:
It would be foolish to obey the Maven's demands.
It would also be foolish not to.
flavour.MavenKeyFragment:
Precious and perilous,
Tantalising and terrible.
flavour.MavenTrial:
For those who must not endure it,
there may be found a perverse joy 
in watching the struggle for survival.
flavour.MawrBlaidd: Rigwald believed he'd seized great power, but it was the great power that had seized Rigwald
flavour.MercilessArmament:
"Through thick and thin,
blood and bone,
a peaceful life
is one I can't condone."
- Tukohama, Father Of War
flavour.MightIsRight: The mind had much to endure before the advent of thaumaturgy.
flavour.Mitts: Those whose hands are their livelihood know the importance of keeping them safe and warm.
flavour.MysteriousScarab: They chitter, they crawl, they bite... and they swarm.
flavour.NecropolisResearch:
The Necropolis holds the darkest secrets of our religion,
lies that were never meant to be unearthed.
flavour.NoTraces: There is no mistake so great that it cannot be undone.
flavour.OfferingDedication:
Before the Goddess, nothing remains hidden.
Adversity reveals old flaws and new strengths.
flavour.OfferingGift:
The Goddess abides a kingdom beyond compare,
should you meet her challenge.
flavour.OfferingToTheGoddess:
It is time for the Goddess to give her final verdict.
Your fate rests in her even hands.
flavour.OfferingTribute:
You may appeal to the Goddess for another verdict,
but justice favours only the truly worthy.
flavour.OrbOfVeiledChaosFlavour:
"The Order tried for centuries to shield the world from chaos.
But chaos is natural. It is a tool, like any other, with which to
shape our destinies." - The Lifegiver's Manifesto
flavour.Perfection: There are countless worlds, but only those with limitless potential will be able to achieve perfection.
flavour.PrideBeforeTheFall:
As Kaom slew the last of his kin,
something deep inside him broke.
And through the cracks, corruption,
pure and black, spread forth.
flavour.PrimordialWatchstone1:
The Maven knew nothing of mercy
until she herself needed it.
flavour.PrimordialWatchstone2:
The Elder fed on all that gave life meaning
until it encountered an unbreakable bond.
flavour.PrimordialWatchstone3:
From beyond the stars, they near, hungry
and intent. Their challenge echoes with the
authority of masters beyond comprehension.
flavour.PrimordialWatchstone4:
Though the cosmos may be filled with horrors,
and countless eyes and maws set upon us with hunger,
one insignificant speck has not yet had her say.
flavour.ProphecyFragment1:
Mouth of the Masses, whose greatness spreads by our breath and touch,
who feeds the starving with the starved, the strong with the weak.
flavour.ProphecyFragment2:
Lord of the Wild, of the feral and frenzied,
of the uncivilized, the untamed, the untouched.
flavour.ProphecyFragment3:
The Infinite Mind, unbound by the tethers of sanity,
whose thirst for knowledge is all-consuming,
whose every word stands our hair on end.
flavour.ProphecyFragment4_:
She of Many Bodies, whose very flesh unites all,
whose dark whispers draw forth our souls, unfettered.
flavour.Prosperity: Accumulating wealth has its own costs.
flavour.QuestA9Ingredient1: "Blow it all down! The emperor must have his gems, no matter the cost!"
flavour.QuestA9Ingredient2:
Nobility once thought to capture the Basilisks and keep them as exotic pets.
This only served to fatten the vileness of their hearts, and with a hateful
acid that festered inside, the creatures became soured to their very bones.
flavour.QuestAllflame:
Distilled from naked ambition and unfettered obsession,
the Allflame emanates a silvern warmth like no other, 
and engulfs those moths fool enough to embrace it.
flavour.QuestAnkhOfEternity: "The amulet, it... whispers to me. Horrible things..."
flavour.QuestAvariusStaff_:
"Worry not for the heathens. They are devoid of soul.
Made vessels of wrath, they are damned by holy design."
- High Templar Avarius
flavour.QuestBestelManuscript:
"A stranger's kiss on a moonlit night.
Dost thou believe in love at first sight?"
flavour.QuestBlackFlag:
"May the lubbers feel fear in their
nethers, and may our blades follow."
 - Rot-tooth's Rallying Cry
flavour.QuestBlackVenom:
"The spider is not defined by how
it lives, but by how it kills."
 - Inquisitor Maligaro
flavour.QuestBottledStorm:
"One should not entice the storm; one cannot invite the storm, or give warrant
to its tyrant-soul. We survive only by appeasing the storm, with gifts and
offerings of adoration. We hope that, in its mercy, it shall pass us by."
- Tempestology of the Maraketh, Repudion IV
flavour.QuestBust1:
The Emperor honours Hector Titucius as Supreme Servant.
"Strength in purpose is strength in deed."
flavour.QuestBust2:
The Emperor honours Gaius Sentari as Supreme Servant.
"A man's thoughts are his shackles. A man's thoughts are his wings."
flavour.QuestBust3:
The Emperor honours Marceus Lioneye as Supreme Servant.
"The road to Glory is paved with Sacrifice."
flavour.QuestCalendar:
The King looked upon images swirling atop the ancient stone dial.
"You look peaceful" he told his bride-to-be, "So peaceful, asleep in our wedding bed."
But in phantasm, she did not slumber, and what he saw was not a place for dreams,
rather, a wooden box... about to be closed and lowered into earthy depths.
 - Maraketh Legend
flavour.QuestCombinedAmulet:
Though its power has been shared, there
is still more the Apex might unlock.
flavour.QuestDaressoGem:
"It is a cruel joke that 
Man was born with more 
Intent than Life."
- Malachai
flavour.QuestDecanter:
"Man is blinded by the mud of his corporeal self. Only
through the transformation of the material into the
spiritual can we hope to taste the full body of life."
- Malachai the Soulless
flavour.QuestDexAmulet:
While this artefact resonates with power,
it is simply a piece in a larger puzzle.
flavour.QuestDominusKey: Some sins were never meant to be remembered...
flavour.QuestDucat1GraspingDeep:
Beneath the Leviathan's shadow,
in the boundless dark,
its many limbs stretch upward...
flavour.QuestDucat2FoulKin:
Each accursed union begot stranger forms.
Elongated necks, membranes, even tails...
flavour.QuestDucat3TsoathasGift:
The Brine King had found, within all humanity,
a dark truth waiting to claw itself free...
flavour.QuestDucat4UndeadSea_:
Creatures perished in droves,
drawn to that verdant glow.
Yet their bones swam away...
flavour.QuestDucat5EucaridIsle:
Not a soul stepped foot on the isle,
for shelled monstrosities skittered about its shores...
flavour.QuestDucat6FallenStars:
Still they follow her siren's song.
Deemed unworthy, left to die, unwilling to accept fate...
flavour.QuestFirefly1: In all things living, the light burns bright.
flavour.QuestFirefly2: A passionate fire that consumes the heart.
flavour.QuestFirefly3: The Spirit, it radiates not from above.
flavour.QuestFirefly4: It is the warmth that draws you ever inward.
flavour.QuestFirefly5: Where rest the truest colours of life.
flavour.QuestFirefly6: Gold of the organ. Green of the throat. Red of the vein.
flavour.QuestFirefly7: The myriad wet rainbow of the Spirit's domain.
flavour.QuestGlyph1:
Its corrugated surface brings a strange tingle
to the fingertips. This is no mere decoration.
flavour.QuestGlyph2:
When put to the ear it whispers not of
the sea, but long dead incantations.
flavour.QuestGlyph3:
Its pleasing sheen remains even in shadow,
as if it were somehow lit from within.
flavour.QuestGoldenHand:
An open palm raised in peace,
cut down by the slaves of war.
flavour.QuestGreustNecklace:
"A boy becomes a man when he has faced the animal
in his heart and wet the forest floor with its blood."
 - Azmeri Proverb
flavour.QuestHinekorasHair:
"What we steal in life we repay in death."
 - Karui Proverb
flavour.QuestInfernalTalc:
"A Virtue Gem is a raging thunderstorm imprisoned within a single raindrop.
Infernal Talc simply lets the storm out." - Malachai the Soulless
flavour.QuestIntAmulet:
Segregated by treachery, this artefact
longs to be reunited with her sisters.
flavour.QuestKaomGem:
"Fear becomes Hatred. 
Hatred becomes Fury. 
Thus is Man transformed 
from Martyr to Maker." 
- Malachai
flavour.QuestKaruiEye:
"Weakness must be purged lest it
poison the blood of all Karui."
 - Prayer to Tukohama
flavour.QuestKisharaStar: To the wily Kishara's eye, a star brighter than the sun.
flavour.QuestKitavaKey:
Wrought from blood and gold, Innocence fashioned a weapon of tempered purity,
capable of banishing darkness, and bringing order to the chaos in men's hearts.
flavour.QuestLeftReliquaryVaultKey: The true disciple gives all that they are unto God.
flavour.QuestMalachaisEntrails:
My organs tether me to mortality
like a chain. This chain holds me
from my true potential.
flavour.QuestMalachaisHeart:
My heart forces blood through my veins.
But one who may bleed may die, and
death is no fitting end to genius.
flavour.QuestMalachaisLungs:
My lungs breathe the same air as
the foolish and the weak. May I be
yet another step removed from them.
flavour.QuestMaligaroMap:
"Certain maps can only be rendered in the most vivid of viscera."
 - Inquisitor Maligaro
flavour.QuestMedicineChest:
Doctor "Shaky Hands" Opden travelled with only the
finest medicines and antidotes... and a curiously
generous supply of opiates.
flavour.QuestMiasmeter:
"We shall peer at these cosmic wonderments as they
wake and writhe within that deep and nameless dark."
 - Vilenta, 'Miasmeter: A Thesis'
flavour.QuestMoonOrb:
"Moonlight is a wise mother. The moon which bathes us in soft,
cooling light, does so with the intent of illuminating our paths.
Moonlight is wisdom. Moonlight is life."
 - The Lunar Verses
flavour.QuestObsidianKey:
"The cool blanket of shadows preserves our treasures."
 - Inquisitor Maligaro
flavour.QuestPage1:
"The Vaal were even more steeped in gem culture than 
our Emperor and his 'Gemlings'. It's an obsession 
as old as civilisation itself."
- Icius Perandus
flavour.QuestPage2:
"A communion... but with what? By all accounts, 
it wasn't God that the Vaal were trying to reach."
- Icius Perandus
flavour.QuestPage3:
"A waking Nightmare. 
Madness of the mind? 
Or madness of the flesh?"
- Icius Perandus
flavour.QuestPage4:
"Siosa, your Slavery will cause them to overlook you. 
Your Karui Way will guide you. 
Your Humanity will shame us all."
- Icius Perandus
flavour.QuestPlum: As succulent as blood, as sweet as power.
flavour.QuestPoisonGem:
The withering glare of corruption, made
corporeal and pellucid in crystal.
flavour.QuestPoisonSpear:
Maligaro loved his tools, and took great
pains to keep them excruciatingly sharp.
flavour.QuestPotion:
Famous for her many lovers, those that did not
come willing to Atziri, came by liquid persuasion.
flavour.QuestRedBanner: When the sun sets, the plains should be red.
flavour.QuestRibbonSpool:
Machinery makes the minions.
Minions make the master.
flavour.QuestRightReliquaryVaultKey: The true disciple brings enlightenment to heretics.
flavour.QuestSekhemaFeather:
"And how shall we know a sekhema worthy of rule? 
By the anointing of the Great Roc, under whose wings we grow and soar."
 - Maraketh Coronation Ritual
flavour.QuestSewerKeys:
To enter a city's bowels is to be
privy to its best-kept secrets.
flavour.QuestSilverLocket:
From Weylam to Meredith:
I shall love thee as I love the sea.
flavour.QuestSpikeKey: A sigil of thaumaturgy graven in granite.
flavour.QuestStormSword:
Garukhan sought madness and knowledge amongst the billowing clouds of a 
blackened sky. A vulture of pride, she would not be refused, and so the
stratosphere divulged unto her eldritch secrets of its tumultuous past.
flavour.QuestStrAmulet:
A relic of a sundered relationship,
it awaits reconciliation with its kin.
flavour.QuestSunOrb:
"The sun is a devoted mother. She casts her golden blessings on
the crops of the pious and makes barren the fields of heresy.
Sunlight is belief. Sunlight is life."
 - The Solar Verses
flavour.QuestTeardrop:
"T'gnagn iia y r'ngusla ph'tu Tsoatha nga mekghul'an."
 - Indecipherable verse
flavour.QuestTemplarCourtKey:
Eyes blazing with holy flame, the Pilgrim saw
a great palace descend from the burgeoning sky,
its gates barred against the unfaithful.
flavour.QuestThaumeticSulphite:
Essence of pure thaumaturgy.
Apply with trepidation.
flavour.QuestTolmanBracelet:
A craftswoman's ode to
fresh hope, a new love.
flavour.QuestTowerKey:
God will only offer the door.
Man must choose whether to open it.
flavour.QuestTukohamasTooth:
"The belly cannot hunger for what the eyes cannot see."
 - Karui Proverb
flavour.QuestValakosJaw:
"One day you eat the fish. One day you feed the fish."
 - Karui Proverb
flavour.QuestWingsOfVastiri:
And mounting her mighty Roc, Garukhan, holy queen of the sky,
descended upon her enemies and their armies of darkness.
flavour.RainOfChaos:
Fire filled the sky that night 
Chaos reigned 
Where the shards fell 
All was destroyed 
-Jozen Kasigi, retelling an urban legend of the Cataclysm
flavour.RandomContentBetrayal:
A location revealed with
no informant to blame.
flavour.RandomContentBlueprintWing:
An invitation to join a scheme
already plotted.
flavour.RandomContentHarvestGrove:
The harvest appears unkempt,
its crops unruly.
flavour.RandomContentLogbook:
They cannot truly settle, when
adventure keeps calling.
flavour.RandomContentNamelessSeer:
The wanderer waits where
the water flows.
flavour.RandomContentPerandus:
The ghostly visage of Cadiro
glitters in gold.
flavour.RandomContentReflectingMist:
One small sliver of that
primordial lake.
flavour.RandomContentUniqueVaalSacrifice:
An empty hall, but for a
choice left by its patron.
flavour.RandomContentVaalTrader:
Outside of time, she offers
wares to challenge Order.
flavour.RandomContentVentorsStrongbox:
In the alleys of Sarn, one
can place their bets.
flavour.Rats: Whoever said 'more is always better' has obviously never met a rat.
flavour.Rebirth:
He shattered Her smile
Scattered the fragments like ash
All she did was laugh
flavour.ReliquaryVaultFlavour:
All we hold dear awaits us.
We must merely reach out.
flavour.Ring11: God blesses those who bless themselves.
flavour.Ring11x:
"Our first Prototype. Proof that it can be done.
The Templars will give us everything we need,
now... but we must keep our true goal secret."
flavour.Ring12: To truly appreciate life you must be there when it ends
flavour.Ring13:
"Shavronne held Sanity in her right
hand and Revelation in her left.
Brutus chose the left hand."
- Kadavrus, Surgeon to the Umbra
flavour.RitualScarabOfAFriendlyWisp: Trust in the Draíocht, and you shall never be alone.
flavour.RitualScarabOfCorpses: Reduced to mere Puppets; they yearn for life once more.
flavour.RitualScarabOfSelectiveness: Pick and choose which sacred tenets you prefer...
flavour.SacredGroveFlavour:
The four bloods of Wraeclast
run deep and vibrant.
flavour.SanctuaryMapFlavour:
Belief and despair battle eternal.
Truth and heresy are one.
flavour.SanctumKeyNonQuest:
Mundus noster cecidit. Daemones ubique sunt. Librum
hunc in sacrarium conicio, ut forte alius viam inveniat...
flavour.SanctumKeyQuest:
Hoc sciendo scribo ut verba mea perdant animam
meam eternam. Mihi credendum est quod novus
deus meus non sit tam divinus quam ipse petit...
flavour.ScarabAbyss1:
As the hordes of bone and blood and foul magic surge across the Vastiri Plains,
the scant survivors of our akhara agree to your alliance, ash-scarred Ahkeli.
Disorder means death. Order may mean life.
flavour.ScarabAbyss2:
Your golems and your leadership have slowed the tide of death, Clayshaper.
The relics of power you bid us find have kept the Vastiri Plains from the brink
of oblivion. The defences of the Maraketh will hold.
flavour.ScarabAbyss3:
The Winter of the World has ended at the hands of the Three Sisters. We lay this scarab
upon your ancient grave in thanks for your efforts, Honoured Founder. As you hoped,
the fate of your people will never befall another.
flavour.ScarabAbyss4:
The Abyssals creep forth by night and by storm. Their eons underground were not
a respite, but an amassing, and now they number beyond comprehension.
flavour.ScarabBeasts1:
Feuding Ezomytes slaughtered your kin, young Agnar, but we pulled you
from the flames. The Order of the Djinn is your clan now.
flavour.ScarabBeasts2:
None among us understand the beasts of this world better than you,
honoured Agnar. You will root out the mysteries of wild-artefacts.
flavour.ScarabBeasts3:
The Order was your clan in life, Agnar, Beastmaster, but the First Ones call
back their favoured son. The gift of their Visions will pass to another.
flavour.ScarabBeasts4:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBeasts4a:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBeasts4b:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBeasts4c:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBeasts4d:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBlight1:
We pulled you from the raging ocean, young Dhunan,
but we cannot return you to your home. The Order of the Djinn
offers you a place on Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBlight2:
For using the techniques of your homeland to contain
the fungal plague, honoured Dhunan, you shall lead the war
to eliminate it and end the century-cycle of infestation.
flavour.ScarabBlight3:
Be at rest, Blightmaster Dhunan, on the distant shores of
your home. A dangerous expedition, but one worthy for
he who gave his life to cleanse Wraeclast.
flavour.ScarabBlight4:
The fungal plague returns, and its roots have adapted.
The undiscovered Blightheart that Dhunan theorised
must still exist somewhere, yet none remain
with the skill to see to its destruction.
flavour.ScarabBreach1:
The Ember-dwellers sought to throw you to their volcanic god, young Omid,
but we caught you instead. The Order of the Djinn is your tribe now.
flavour.ScarabBreach2:
We task you, honoured Omid, with the investigation of this mysterious
'Xoph' and artefacts related to rifts in the boundaries of our world.
flavour.ScarabBreach3:
Omid, Master Researcher, has left a final commandment upon his death:
the world must never know.
flavour.ScarabBreach4:
The Master Researcher's final commandment has failed.
The High Templar has seen the truth of our situation,
and the world will be undone by his fear.
flavour.ScarabDextral: Flip a coin, do you wish for Tails?
flavour.ScarabDivinationCards1:
You were a casualty of callous Karui warfare, ageless Narumoa, but the Order
mended your wounds. You are bound to us now by your own code.
flavour.ScarabDivinationCards2:
Though your peers fear you, Narumoa, the elders have decided that your
second sight is ideal for handling all artefacts that seek to subvert Fate.
flavour.ScarabDivinationCards3:
Your centuries of service have been invaluable to us, Narumoa. Go now,
return to Hinekora, and join your ancient kin in the halls of the dead.
flavour.ScarabDivinationCards4:
Hinekora has sent the world another herald, but this hatungo walks another path.
We are left blinded, and subject to the vagaries of Fate.
flavour.ScarabElderRares1_:
Your visions led the Azmeri down into a world left abandoned by the Vaal.
They cast you out, young Egrin, but the Order of the Djinn accepts you.
flavour.ScarabElderRares2_:
Speaker of unclean truths, Egrin of the Dark Between Stars.
We curse you whose soul echoes the madness of the void!
flavour.ScarabElderRares3:
Egrin of the Dark Between Stars, Forger of the Sealing Blade,
let your name be redeemed by your unexpected sacrifice.
flavour.ScarabElderRares4:
We are all equally fools for our childish notions.
That dread force Decay cannot be defeated by self-sacrifice.
flavour.ScarabEvolution_: The cycle of death shapes life to its environment.
flavour.ScarabHarbinger1:
Your ancestry has been much maligned by history, young Sarina Titucius,
but to the Order of the Djinn, you are born anew.
flavour.ScarabHarbinger2:
For deciphering the language of the inscrutable ones, honoured Sarina,
we charge you with investigating their intent in our land.
flavour.ScarabHarbinger3:
For your valour beyond the Gate, Sarina Titucius, we honour you with the first
Gilded Scarab awarded while its recipient still lives. Remain vigilant.
flavour.ScarabHarbinger4:
The thousand year truce has faltered, for the inscrutable ones have imprisoned their own God.
Should they invade again, there will be no warning.
flavour.ScarabHarbingerNew1: Their troops came in numbers uncountable and from lands unknown.
flavour.ScarabHarbingerNew2: They seek to establish an unknown pattern.
flavour.ScarabHarbingerNew3: The truly noble wage war from the front.
flavour.ScarabHarbingerNew4: For those who can leverage it, war can be as much a machine of profit as it is death.
flavour.ScarabLegion1:
Your faith and our Order are not in opposition, young Eutychus. 
Let this be the start of a new era of cooperation.
flavour.ScarabLegion2:
As our hand in the Chamber, we grant you, Deacon Eutychus,
access to a domain we lack the resources to explore.
flavour.ScarabLegion3:
Given the fate of Deacon Eutychus and the men under Cardinal Sanctus Vox,
let none dare the Domain, lest they too feed that vile hunger eternal.
flavour.ScarabLegion4:
As the passage between Wraeclast and the land beyond time's reach is torn open,
we stand on the precipice of eternal war.
And no one remains to hold us back.
flavour.ScarabMaps1:
Consider yourself an orphaned Eternal no longer, young Betucia.
The Order of the Djinn is your family now.
flavour.ScarabMaps2:
For your loyalty and valour, honoured Betucia, we are proud to put
the requisition of dream-artefacts in your capable hands.
flavour.ScarabMaps3:
Betucia, Bearer of the Sealing Blade, the Order of the Djinn survives
because of your sacrifice, but will be forever wounded by your loss.
flavour.ScarabMaps4:
The Sealing Blade has been removed, and the agent of Decay
shall feed upon this world until nothing remains but dust.
flavour.ScarabMercenaries1: To the victor go the spoils.
flavour.ScarabMercenaries2: Some men must make their own way.
flavour.ScarabMercenaries3: Who goes there, bedecked in legend?
flavour.ScarabMetamorph1:
We pulled you from the piled dead, young Ixchel, while your people were going mad
with fear. The gods may have vanished, but the Order will watch over you now.
flavour.ScarabMetamorph2:
For infiltrating the Priesthood of Yaomac and returning with their sleeping form,
Ixchel, we honour you. Your next task must be to infiltrate the Temple of Chaos.
flavour.ScarabMetamorph3:
It was our error, Ixchel Godstealer, that led to your fate. Chaos is not asleep,
thus not a god, and for your eternal suffering, you have our eternal remorse.
flavour.ScarabMetamorph4:
The silent war of shadows and struggle must be set aside.
Order and Chaos must ally against the coming tide.
flavour.ScarabOfAdversaries: They stand against you with equal enmity.
flavour.ScarabOfMonstrousLineage: The bloodlines evolve faster than they can be culled.
flavour.ScarabPerandus1:
Your people no longer walk this continent, young Revna,
but the Order of the Djinn will give you a new home.
flavour.ScarabPerandus2:
As you delve into the mysteries of this world, apprentice Revna,
remember to learn from the past, not be consumed by it.
flavour.ScarabPerandus3:
We lay you to rest in the forest deep, Runesmith Revna, so that you may be
forever hidden from the stars which so terrified you in your final days.
May the secret you took to your grave be lifted from your burdens.
flavour.ScarabPerandus4:
Darkness surges in the shadows of the past. Ancient evils stir. The stars
watch, forever aloof, forever menacing. None remain who know the
secret, so we are defenseless in the face of the unknown.
flavour.ScarabSettlers3: Ore's true worth lies not in stone, but in what it becomes.
flavour.ScarabSettlers4: The ore lives and breathes; and is not happy with your efforts.
flavour.ScarabShaperRares1:
The Peak-dwellers saw you as impure, young Qianga, but the Order of
the Djinn sees you as all the stronger for your uniqueness.
flavour.ScarabShaperRares2:
Bold dreamer, Qianga of the Stars, she of the Celestial Cold! These titles
we bestow upon the one among us whose soul speaks to the ineffable.
flavour.ScarabShaperRares3:
Qianga of the Stars, Deliverer of the Sealing Blade to the Watchers, go now, and
let your half-dreamt life be troubled by nightmares of achromic hunger no more.
flavour.ScarabShaperRares4:
The Watchers have gone silent, yet they scream still.
Something lurks among the stars of our dreams, knocking at the door,
whispering with the voices of long lost friends...
flavour.ScarabSinistral: Flip a coin, do you wish for Heads?
flavour.ScarabStrongbox1:
Your outlaw camp abandoned you when their surprise attack failed, young Rindwik.
Now that you know we exist, we cannot let you go. You have two choices.
flavour.ScarabStrongbox2:
Your people were renegades, Rindwik, but you have proven your loyalty.
You will lead the martial defence of our expeditions.
flavour.ScarabStrongbox3:
Master Warrior Rindwik fell to one opponent alone: old age.
Only the greatest soldiers can say as much.
flavour.ScarabStrongbox4:
In the absence of a strong martial presence, the renegades rise once more.
Their poisons threaten to cloud the land.
flavour.ScarabSulphite1:
As the first Brinerot to join the Order, you have much to prove,
young Raethan. We are confident you will succeed.
flavour.ScarabSulphite2:
For harnessing and controlling the power of lightning, you, Raethan,
are now charged with researching this new energy.
flavour.ScarabSulphite3:
Let him not be called Raethan the Betrayer. His discovery was too important
to keep locked away. Now, for good or ill, it is in civilisation's hands.
flavour.ScarabSulphite4:
Madness marches in machine form.
Harnessed lightning, grim faces, and cold ambition abounds.
Civilisation will be its own undoing.
flavour.ScarabTorment1:
Young Tsarsk, you were a broken and forgotten child lying glassy-eyed
in a flesh-pit in Trarthus, but the Order found and cleansed you.
flavour.ScarabTorment2:
Your tortured soul long kept you isolated from your peers, Tsarsk, but has attracted
new kindred in kind. You are tasked with appeasing these anguished spirits.
flavour.ScarabTorment3:
Though you were swallowed by your own darkness, you saved countless others
from eternal misery, young Tsarsk. You were not nothing, as you feared.
flavour.ScarabTorment4:
Without a speaker of the dead, the countless anguished spirits only grow in number.
They have no voice, and no hope. The sun darkens with each passing year.
flavour.ScarabUniques1:
The Maraketh left you to die alone in the desert, young Sumei, but we
saw the potential in you. The Order of the Djinn is your akhara now.
flavour.ScarabUniques2:
As the best of our lorekeepers, honoured Sumei, it is now your task
to investigate the mysterious duplication of artefacts of power.
flavour.ScarabUniques3:
Go to your rest now, Sumei, Master Lorekeeper. The Order shall keep
contained the terrible secret that burdened your final years.
flavour.ScarabUniques4:
The books were burned, and the scribes set themselves aflame.
What secret so terrible could they have discovered?
Though centuries have passed, we must investigate this for ourselves.
flavour.ScarabUnity: The great cacophony of life roars to a crescendo.
flavour.ScarabWisps: The Draíocht connects everything that lives.
flavour.ScarabofStability: Astonishing! A means to sustain the connection...
flavour.ScholarOfTheSeas: I've never come upon a ship I could not command. I have however met sailors that were not willing to be led.
flavour.ScourgeScarab: The silent wall and the raging storm oppose the endless swarm.
flavour.ScourgeScarabOfTheInvasion: The fated hour is almost nigh.
flavour.SentinelController:
For aeons, ancient constructs have lain dormant,
but now their designs are under your control.
flavour.ShaperAtlasNodeFlavour:
You must let me go, my daughter...
I am but a ghost, now. A memory...
flavour.ShaperFragment1:
Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavour.ShaperFragment2:
Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavour.ShaperFragment3:
Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavour.ShaperFragment4:
Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
flavour.ShaperKey:
I spent my life shining a light on truth...
but some things should remain in darkness,
locked away for all eternity.
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment10_1:
"...It wasn't long before we were met by the Shade itself.
The very essence of the Elder, demanding of me in visions to
tell it why I had returned. But before I could answer,
Venarius stepped forward and greeted the phantom..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment10_2:
"...Before we knew it, we stood at the base of that blasphemous effigy.
"Pull the sword from my chest." The Elder imposed, and Venarius didn't hesitate.
The earth shook in the face of the Elder's reunion with its body. The true scope of the
Elder befell the High Templar and his men, and as it began to feed, I began to run..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment10_3:
"...I fear this to be the end. Not just the end for me, but the end of all things. 
The Elder has been freed. Soon it will feast on me... on the rest of the world.
It was too late for me. The Elder had to be stopped. I knew of the shaping powers.
Only I could have a hope at defeating the Elder..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment1_1:
"...A golden machine was found broken in the ruins of Wraeclast. 
Believing it to contain some dark infernal secret, 
High Templar Venarius asked that I restore it 
and weaponize whatever powers it might contain..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment2_1:
"...Though the device seemed to be mostly functioning, 
something important appeared to be missing...
...I worked tirelessly in search of answers, until finally, 
at the base of that cruel device, I fell into a deep, deep sleep..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment3_1:
"...I awoke in the most beautiful of places, and as I wandered this strange new land, 
I felt a growing sense of realization that I was not alone. 
A Shade, a whisper of embodied smoke, spoke to me through thoughts and pictures.
I found myself enthusiastically volunteering information in detail of Oriath..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment4_1:
"...The Shade knew of the device - a doorway between my world
and the dreamlands. It offered to help me rebuild the missing part, 
to create a conduit between this beautiful land and Oriath. 
All that the Shade asked of me was to return the favour..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment5_1:
"...Every night, I found myself asleep at the foot of the strange device, 
awoken to the reality of another world within my own.
The Shade taught me how to shape and build things from my imagination,
how to transport such phantasmagorical treasures back into the world of man..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment6_1:
"...The missing part of the great device had finally been formed.
The Shade requested its one favour. I was shown images of the past,
the Shade as King of the dreamlands, the hateful Watchers of Decay...
It led me deep into a cave, to a statue pierced by a sword..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment7_1:
"Pull the blade from my chest. Free me!" the Shade imposed.
But doubt entered my mind, and the Shade flew into a fury!
I felt my mind torn asunder as images of murder and mutilation were forced upon me. 
I fled in a panic, cursing myself for ever trusting such a strange creature so blindly..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment8_1:
"...Months have now passed since the Shade revealed its true nature.
Each morning, I lock myself inside my study, searching for some knowledge 
that might save us. I have found at last, some information on the Watchers of Decay. 
The truth is so unutterable that I hesitate, even now, to write it down..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment8_2:
"...They called it the Elder. A creature of malignant madness... it cannot be killed.
The Watchers built the device to lock tight its kingdom, bringing with them the
blade - 'Starforge'. A weapon to give the Elder eternal rest. But the Shade...
I must find a way to put a stop to it before it finds a path to freedom..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment9_1:
"...I've spent every waking hour since, trying to find a way to end this unholy Elder.
Within my secret study, I've begun work on a device of my own, tinkering and shaping.
When I'm finished, this Elder will never bother our world again.
The creature cannot be killed, but maybe... it can be exiled..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment9_2:
"...Lack of progress on the device has given the High Templar cause for suspicion.
Clapped in irons, I was lead off to the Theopolis prisons for my insubordination.
I must find my way from these chains at all costs. The Elder is coming for us.
Only I can save us from this blasphemy that will soon befall Oriath..."
flavour.ShaperMemoryFragment9_3:
"...Venarius, that bastard... he marched me through the streets.
His men beat me within an inch of death... I... I told him everything. 
He demanded that I take all of us into the dreamlands, to meet with the Elder.
Using the device, we stepped through, setting foot in the Atlas of Worlds..."
flavour.ShardOfFate:
Their whims left unknown,
Their life left for others.
flavour.SirusAtlasNodeFlavour:
What remains when all
else is stripped away?
flavour.SirusFragment1:
He sought to be the best,
but lost his family.
flavour.SirusFragment2:
He sought God,
but lost himself.
flavour.SirusFragment3:
He sought a kingdom,
but lost his people.
flavour.SirusFragment4:
She sought to bring salvation,
but lost her compassion.
flavour.SkillGemPactOfBeidat:
Wield the gifts of Beidat, luminary of the pale unseeing,
whose honeyed words bore tunnels through pliant minds.
flavour.SkillGemPactOfGhorr:
Offer yourself to Ghorr, the gluttonous, the cage of
flesh trapping souls in the cycle of consumption.
flavour.SkillGemPactOfKtash:
Unleash the fury of K'Tash, incarnation of hate.
Endless bodies burn beneath the flames of his pursuit.
flavour.SkillGemPactOfLycia:
Call upon Lycia, conduit of the Scourge. She forfeit
her soul for the power to condemn lies told by bones.
flavour.StruckByLightning:
'Lightning never strikes the same place twice'
is really just wishful thinking.
flavour.SulphiteScarab: Delve into darkness in search of the truth...
flavour.SulphiteScarabOfFumes: When the land itself is sick, even the very ground rots and spills forth.
flavour.SulphiteScarabOfGreed: There is no such thing as 'enough'.
flavour.SupportGemAbyssalWell:
Velka reached out her hand. One touch and she
folded, screaming, clawing desperately at her back
as the crustaceous gift burst itself from her spine.
flavour.SupportGemAnnihilation:
Those citizens of Oriath touched by the
roving storms died most horrible deaths.
flavour.SupportGemBloodsoakedBanner:
"The history of Wraeclast is marked by bloody conflicts. The rise
and fall of empires. Man slaughtered man, never suspecting the
madness lurking under the surface might not have been innate."
flavour.SupportGemBonespire: In its madness, Xesht desperately seeks communion.
flavour.SupportGemCastOnWardBreak:
"Prove yourself! Are you a knave, or a knight?
I shall know by the strength of your blows!"
flavour.SupportGemCompanionship:
The Black Sekhema was a formidable fighter
alongside her dekhara, but she was unstoppable
when she fought atop her trusted mount, Shiyo.
flavour.SupportGemCongregation:
"I have a recurring nightmare... I run...
I scream... but only the dead hear me..."
flavour.SupportGemCooldownRecovery:
"The science is... incomprehensible at best. Nearest I can tell, the Arcana exhibits
a blast of wrath once it has been fully charged, and when directed at the Elder
will force it to take on the form it held before it entered our dimension."
flavour.SupportGemCrystalfall:
The ancient golem of bone climbs ever upward. 
Its body is an engine. Its eyes are fuel.
flavour.SupportGemCullTheWeak:
"Beidat is the lesser of three evils. The other two desire only
to consume us, but under him, there is a chance to survive...
a chance to serve... if you can prove yourself useful."
flavour.SupportGemDivineSentinel:
"The world will never know our sacrifice, but
we will stand and fight for as long as it takes!"
flavour.SupportGemEclipse:
"Although we are two bodies, we are of one mind, one heart, drifting
through the cosmos, in search of purpose. The moment we cross paths,
both fleeting and eternal, our eyes are opened to our potential."
flavour.SupportGemEdify:
"You were the best of us, Sirus. Fighting alongside
you made me better. I will always miss you."
flavour.SupportGemEldritchBlasphemy:
Even trapped in stone, the Elder's shadow lingered
in their hearts and coiled around their dreams.
flavour.SupportGemFissure:
"Oh yes, K'Tash understands you. It has a keen swarm-mind
somewhere within its multitudes. It hears your pleas, but
ignores them... because it hates you with a burning fury."
flavour.SupportGemFoulgrasp:
"Words without thought drive us
to claw and scrabble in the dirt,
seeking respite found only in pain."
flavour.SupportGemFrostmage:
Her understanding of the Atlas was not innate. The
more committed she became to understanding it,
the more the knowledge weighed on her.
flavour.SupportGemGluttony:
Champions of the Tangle are driven to seek
sustenance for their master; should they fall
behind, they would soon be consumed as well.
flavour.SupportGemGreaterAncestralCall:
"I believe the Halls of the Dead are secretly a
training ground. One day, we will be called
forth to stand and fight against a great tide."
flavour.SupportGemGreaterChain_:
"We are all connected. Each of us burns with the same fire.
Queen Hyrri knew that... she chooses to battle still, somewhere
beyond Hinekora's sight. There must be a very good reason."
flavour.SupportGemGreaterDevour_:
A High Templar's fear consumed her entire life,
so she cast aside her own, to do what must be done.
flavour.SupportGemGreaterFork:
Lioneye earned his moniker by killing
three men with a single arrow.
flavour.SupportGemGreaterKineticInstabil:
"Accusations fly. Sinner! Heretic! I am but an initiate, and my patron urges
silence. We will keep our heads down while one High Templar supplants
another. It's all about power, my patron whispers, and we have none..."
flavour.SupportGemGreaterMultistrike:
Zana watched in awe as her father spoke. With each word,
he seemed to grow larger and more frightening, drawing
increasingly fervorous responses from his rapt audience.
flavour.SupportGemGreaterSpellCascade:
The echoes of lost loved ones surrounded her,
maddeningly close, but forever out of reach.
flavour.SupportGemGreaterSpellEcho:
She gazed into the mirror...
and the mirror gazed back.
flavour.SupportGemGreaterUnleash:
"True power grows with patience. You must nurture it.
You learn what it needs. You provide. You wait. Only
then, when it is ripe, does it yield its fruits."
flavour.SupportGemHarrowingThrong:
Catarina envisioned a Wraeclast of disparate societies united.
That diversity would empower the Syndicate - and the increased
number of dispensible bodies was a convenient coincidence.
flavour.SupportGemHexpass:
"Your wards and your charms are meaningless
to one who knows your true name."
flavour.SupportGemHextoad:
"A warlock like myself knows that even the most abominable
plagues are part of the cycle of life and death. From that ruination,
new life will emerge, and that life will kill, and so on..."
flavour.SupportGemHiveborn:
"We spill forth, cleaving our flesh
to theirs, until we become one."
flavour.SupportGemInvention:
"The direct approach failed. So be it. In my crusade
to protect Wraeclast, I must take... a longer view."
flavour.SupportGemInvertTheRules:
"She fled from the prison of her birth, drawn by the breaking
of that great Silence. At that moment, the universe was changed,
and walls that were once impenetrable became brittle.
A fortress became a shell, and she alone escaped."
flavour.SupportGemLethalDose:
"They cast me into a pit of vipers, and
that is where I found my true self."
flavour.SupportGemMachinations_:
"My master enjoys the strange, and the unexpected.
I'm sure you can think of a few ways to entertain them."
flavour.SupportGemMagnetism:
The dominance of the Templars left an indelible mark.
Zana would ever after stand guarded in their presence.
flavour.SupportGemMinionPact:
Catarina envisioned a Wraeclast of disparate societies united.
That diversity would empower the Syndicate - and the increased
number of dispensible bodies was a convenient coincidence.
flavour.SupportGemOverheat:
No walls can stand against its gaze. No fortress,
no cave, no mountain. Better to die fighting.
flavour.SupportGemOverloadedIntensity: "I didn't design it to overload... let's call it a happy little accident!"
flavour.SupportGemPacifism:
"My people refused to take part in the ills of Wraeclast.
They were called primitives by some, and cowards by
others... but they are gone, and we still remain."
flavour.SupportGemPyre_:
A vast pillar of hands embraces a charred sky.
Within burns a beam of purest heat.
flavour.SupportGemScornfulHerald_:
Her bitterness blinded her to the true price of immortality.
Let Wraeclast burn and be devoured, she told herself...
and only herself, for centuries without end.
flavour.SupportGemTransfusion:
Let the eternal scream within
flow from your weeping blood.
flavour.SupportGemUnholyTrinity:
It was a delicate balancing act for Malachai to ensure the loyalty
of his three students - each as ambitious as they were depraved.
flavour.SupportGemVaalSacrifice:
Under Atziri, sacrifice was a ruthless and efficient science.
Her people were willing to give everything... and they did.
flavour.SupportGemVaalTemptation:
"If Chaos offers you a deal, challenger,
think deeply before you accept."
flavour.SupportGemVoidShockwave:
The Elder's influence yet lingers
in the darkest corners of Wraeclast.
flavour.SupportGemVoidstorm:
"Not even stopping to look behind, I dove through the shimmering window...
With not a minute to waste, I took a nearby tool and jammed it into the infernal
device, where it hummed, ominously entrenched in my laboratory floor."
flavour.SupportGemWard:
Uhtred was remembered as a traitor, but it was he that unearthed
the only way out. The survivors found themselves in an unfamiliar
forest.  Strangely, a third were not present, including Uhtred himself.
flavour.Talisman1_1:
"I know where we found our belief in
the First Ones. I see it every time I walk
the untouched forests and hills. The
primordial world is still here. With us."
flavour.Talisman1_10:
"Lysanda and her Knights brought the
settling clans to what would become
Ezomyr... but there was one beast against
which even they could not stand."
flavour.Talisman1_11:
"A great headless monstrosity with arms like
teeth stalked the lands they hoped to settle.
No other weapon would find purchase. They
surrounded it with fire, burning it for days."
flavour.Talisman1_12:
"With the headless beast incinerated, the
settlers rejoiced, and began building homes.
They would soon find that this hostile land
had more insidious ways of rejecting them."
flavour.Talisman1_2:
"We held our trust in the First Ones long
before we learned runes. Long before we
were shown the ways of cities and roads."
flavour.Talisman1_3:
"This land was always harsh and brutal,
ever seeking ways to kill and maim us.
We had to grow and change to survive,
but each clan had its own ideas how..."
flavour.Talisman1_4:
"A great rift formed, between clans,
between families. Those that remained
resolved to endure times of struggle,
if it meant we could keep our ways."
flavour.Talisman1_5:
"Those that departed sought the way of
cities and roads. Theirs would be a path
fraught with danger and hardship, as they
set out to find and build a new home."
flavour.Talisman1_6:
"When they set out to find and build
Ezomyr, they encountered creatures of
deadly variety and intent. Many died,
for none yet knew how to fight back."
flavour.Talisman1_7:
"Lysanda of Myr was but a girl on that exodus.
Ezomyr almost met its end before it began...
but she could not hear that deadly lure. She
took the Siren's head with her bare hands."
flavour.Talisman1_8:
"It turned out, Lysanda made for an excellent
vanguard - a light, evasive girl who could scout
and lead the way. The people came to see her
as their guide, their hope, and then... their leader."
flavour.Talisman1_9:
"Those that swore loyalty to Lysanda, that
forged ahead with her to clear the way.
became known as the first Knights...
armoured, battered, and courageous."
flavour.Talisman2_1:
"The clans had travelled to their new home
united, and they did love Lysanda, but some
men must go their own way. Those that braved
the inland sea settled the Isles of Skothe."
flavour.Talisman2_2:
"The journey was over, the land was being
secured, and the foundations for the first city
had been laid. Winter hit them with horrible
fury, sent not by nature, but by a curse."
flavour.Talisman2_3:
"Against the Winter Curse, only the forges of
runesmiths could stand. The people huddled,
shoulder to shoulder, while those within were
pressed against the fires, screaming in agony."
flavour.Talisman2_4:
"And still the Winter Curse raged in through
every window and every door. The fathers
and mothers of those within let themselves
freeze solid, sealing the gaps with their lives."
flavour.Talisman2_5:
"The night refused to end, and the Winter Curse
howled. The people wailed, and Lysanda raged.
It was then that the sky tore open, unleashing
a saviour fury... at the behest of the Druids."
flavour.Talisman2_6:
"The Druids emerged from the forests to greet
and warn the new settlers. This was an ancient
land full of mysteries and dangers. Lysanda sent
her best men to study and learn with them."
flavour.Talisman2_7:
"As the Ezomytes of Myr prospered, they
needed more and spreading lands. Queen
Lysanda led the ongoing campaign to
slaughter every last creature of darkness."
flavour.Talisman2_8:
"Each new valley, each new grove, held new
dangers. Many Knights paid the price. Lysanda
had never been known for her beauty, but she
bore a new scar each season, earned gladly."
flavour.Talisman3_1:
"Romance never interested Queen Lysanda,
but her advisors insisted heirs were needed.
To spite them, she took the Hag's only son as
her Consort - a quiet, pale, and strange man."
flavour.Talisman3_2:
"Queen Lysanda's spiteful choice of Consort
spited only herself. Alasdair was unlike any
man she had ever met. It was not long before
the trumpets sounded for the Royal Wedding."
flavour.Talisman3_3:
"The Royal Wedding of Lysanda of Myr
lasted for a full month. The hunts were
vigorous, and the meat and drink flowed
freely for all. There was much rejoicing."
flavour.Talisman3_4:
"But there were some who could not forget
the horrors of the Winter Curse, and of the
Hag that had sent it. Alasdair dropped his
wine goblet, and fell to the ground, choking."
flavour.Talisman3_5:
"There followed a time of fear and fire.
None would speak against their fellows.
None would say who had poisoned him.
Lysanda's justice was swift and brutal."
flavour.Talisman3_6:
"In the years that followed, Queen Lysanda
poured herself into the long and brutal task
of securing the lands of the Ezomytes of Myr.
Every fell beast, every creature, had to die."
flavour.Talisman3_7:
"The Blue Knight stood against the swarm,
icy and unassailable. His identity was not
known, and he never removed his helmet.
Glimpses were caught of piercing blue eyes."
flavour.Talisman4:
The wolf greeted the king,
In the light of the harvest moon.
The wolf offered the strength of the wild,
And the king paid for it in blood.
flavour.Talisman5_1:
"With the Winter Curse held at bay, Lysanda
and her Knights pursued the fell power that
had sent it... a Hag who made her lair in a
Tower that was ancient beyond ancient."
flavour.Talisman5_10:
"Ezomyr grew on a foundation of
choice. Its climate was chosen. Its
animals were chosen. For once,
Wraeclast was not harsh, but kind."
flavour.Talisman5_11:
"The sea calmed, and contact was
renewed with the Isles of Skothe.
It was said that Craiceann had
given a blessing to the people."
flavour.Talisman5_12:
"The Spiders that had been driven
back by the Blue Knight now sought
peace and cooperation. It was said
that Fenumus had commanded it."
flavour.Talisman5_13:
"The skies were clear and blue, yet
brought rains when needed. It was
said that the people had proven
themselves to Saqawal and his flocks."
flavour.Talisman5_14:
"Forty-six years into her reign, Lysanda
slew the last deadly creature. She smiled,
took a wineskin, and rode off into the forest.
One last hunt, it was said. Farrul would stalk
by her side, in this life... and the next."
flavour.Talisman5_15:
"There are some stories that may never
be known, never be heard. But to history,
I say, let it be known the the Ezomytes
of Myr persevered... and built a home."
flavour.Talisman5_2:
"They bound the Hag of the Winter Curse
and set her alight, to no avail. Her cackle
was gleeful and wicked. Even if they slew
her, she boasted, she had many daughters..."
flavour.Talisman5_3:
"Lysanda roared, and hacked the Hag apart
limb by limb, not stopping until the deed
was done. Her daughters, however, were
spared... and tasked with service and duty."
flavour.Talisman5_4:
"With the Hag's daughters easing the climate,
an age of plenty and bounty began. Lysanda
revived the Phaaryl tradition of the hunt,
so the people never forgot their roots."
flavour.Talisman5_5:
"The first city was completed, and others sprouted.
The clans came together to declare Lysanda of Myr
the Queen. Henceforth, they became known as the
Ezomytes of Myr, and their numbers swelled."
flavour.Talisman5_6:
"There began an eternal summer, as the
daughters of the Hag perfected their mastery
of the Tower. The forests became as gardens.
The hungry had only to pick a fruit and eat."
flavour.Talisman5_7:
"Twenty-two years into Lysanda's reign, the
Spiders swarmed from out of the dark. Her
Knights were ill-equipped for this foe, and
the people fled in droves, seeking safety."
flavour.Talisman5_8:
"As deadly and dangerous creatures were
culled, the Queen chose to leave those
that were docile or beauteous. Tide pools
became known as places of wonder."
flavour.Talisman5_9:
"Decades into Lysanda's reign, the
lands of the Ezomytes of Myr slowly
became known as Ezo De Myr, and
then simply Ezomyr. And so it was."
flavour.TangleBossKeyFlavourText:
From the heart of the Tangle, the Eater of Worlds
reaches out for control of the Atlas.
flavour.TangleKeyFlavourText:
The Infinite Hunger awaits in a cosmic stomach where
whole civilisations are digested - but do not die.
flavour.TemporaryTutorialSupport: This gem is only temporary, and only for the tutorial.
flavour.TestUniqueRing1:
"When one stares into the depth of the flavour text
file, one will gain no knowledge, only an addiction
to speculation." - Maligaro, Grand Trolllord
flavour.TheAdmirer: Lucian lost himself in ancient scrolls and found in those scrolls a love whose power bridged a millennium.
flavour.TheAesthete:
"Some see our mortal flesh as a limitation. I see it as an opportunity for vast, miraculous improvements."
- Shavronne of Umbra
flavour.TheArenaChampion: The fight is the easy part. It's the years of training that'll kill you.
flavour.TheArmyOfBlood:
I gave my mind without a fight, 
The twelfth hour I lost control. 
The day is gone but there is light, 
eyes that glow like red-hot coal.
flavour.TheArtist: "Paint, metal, flesh... A true artist does not limit himself." - Malachai the Soulless
flavour.TheAvenger:
Justice comes swift 
Equal to the crime 
Revenge is a gift 
Life for a life 
Eye for an eye
flavour.TheBattleBorn: "No man can best me, no demon can fell me. For I vanquish all with my axe!"
flavour.TheBeast: To know the monster, you must become the monster.
flavour.TheBetrayal: It's sad times we live in when a friendship has a price people are willing to pay.
flavour.TheBlazingFire: Lethal, untouchable, keen, aflame. Just what I was looking for.
flavour.TheBody: They say it is the head that leads, but all must flow through the body at some point.
flavour.TheBreach: Ever get the feeling you're being watched...?
flavour.TheBrittleEmperor:
"When Voll spared Malachai, accepting his aid in pursuit of Purity, the strongest faith was infected by Corruption and made brittle as glass."
- Victario, the People's Poet
flavour.TheCacophony: Nothing can be heard above the din or seen amongst the turmoil. The senses are shattered. All is left to fate.
flavour.TheCalling: Blood flows not just through veins, but through worlds.
flavour.TheCarrionCrow:
From death, life. 
From life, death. 
The wheel turns, 
and the corbies wheel overhead.
flavour.TheCartographer:
My son, you lost your way before you arrived.
To never lose you again,
I make a path in my heart.
flavour.TheCataclysm: The mighty warriors traded in blows, the nimble archers in arrows, yet it was the brazen thaumaturgists who would bring catastrophe to all.
flavour.TheCatalyst: Simple actions can lead the world to an early grave.
flavour.TheCelestialJusticar: Wrapped in the glory of the heavens, she comes to mete out justice for the fallen.
flavour.TheCelestialStone: Stare into its depths too long, and you may lose yourself entirely.
flavour.TheChainsThatBind: Scarier than any criminal is an innocent man in chains, for when he breaks free, his revenge will be justified.
flavour.TheComingStorm: No man may hope to turn back the storm. You can only hope you do not attract its ire.
flavour.TheConduit: The path to godhood is guided by the hand of sacrifice.
flavour.TheCursedKing:
The First Ones
may be blasphemy,
but they are
powerful blasphemy.
flavour.TheDapperProdigy: "Many believe murder is a grisly, grim, and grotesque crime. Then there are those who simply make art of it."
flavour.TheDarkMage:
With staff in hand
and wrath in heart,
your soul and corpse
shall surely part.
flavour.TheDarkestDream: A dream from which you cannot awake is nothing other than a nightmare.
flavour.TheDeceiver: Beware the combatant who shows no confidence, yet still enters the ring, for they are surely hiding something.
flavour.TheDemoness: Wherever she went, death was sure to follow.
flavour.TheDevastator: Only a fool tries to contain unlimited power.
flavour.TheDoctor: "They said I needed my head examined, but I'd rather just take yours." - Klopek the Cannibal
flavour.TheDoppelganger: Upon seeing her face, I am terrified—the moon shows me my own form!
flavour.TheDragon:
Scaly beast of the skies,
watching with his golden eyes.
Shadow that blocks out the sun,
it's too late for you to run.
flavour.TheDragonsHeart: They say when a dragon dies, the flesh smoulders and burns until all that remains is the still, white-hot, heart.
flavour.TheDreamer:
A dark note drips 
from the dreamer's lips, 
A honeyed melody. 
We stand, we fall 
on his beck and call, 
for in his dream we're free.
flavour.TheDreamland: All dreams vanish when the dreamers wake.
flavour.TheDrunkenAristocrat: The finer the brew, the harder it is to remember drinking it.
flavour.TheEncroachingDarkness: No matter where your dreams take you, Nightmare follows close behind.
flavour.TheEndlessDarkness: Gaze towards the stars, but beware what gazes back.
flavour.TheEndurance:
Crimson rubies, drops of vigour,
flowing through my veins,
flesh like coal, try to crush me,
diamond is what remains.
flavour.TheEnlightended:
Weaving the six,
a serpent stands tall.
Wearing a crown,
the thousand petals call.
flavour.TheEthereal:
"Long ago, people looked to the stars, believing they influenced us. Soon, it will be us who influence the stars."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturge
flavour.TheExplorer: A map is only useful if you know where you stand.
flavour.TheEyeOfTheDragon:
Some powers are far too great even for the
gods of old.
flavour.TheFathomlessDepths: Fall into endless night; a voyage into an ocean of oblivion.
flavour.TheFeast: Shame what happened to my husband. He had such good taste.
flavour.TheFiend:
Your era is now,
your power unwavered, 
soon we will see
who the gods truly favoured.
flavour.TheFletcher: Let these fine arrows pack a punch.
flavour.TheFlorasGift:
Sturdy and strong,
grown from the stream.
The Flora that live here,
A combatant's dream.
flavour.TheFormlessSea:
Formless might,
Wild beauty tamed,
The brine of gods,
The seas restrained.
flavour.TheForsaken: You gave us life and love, more than you could spare. Now you're gone, and we are stranded, alone, cold and without purpose.
flavour.TheFox:
"Masters of wit, strength and cunning. To survive the harsh winters, you must be like the fox."
- Ezomyte Proverb
flavour.TheGambler: "I don't believe in karma. If it were real, I would never win."
flavour.TheGarishPower: Maligaro may have valued function over form, but that did not mute his flair for the dramatic.
flavour.TheGemcutter: In the hands of a master craftsman, a worthless pebble can adorn the crown of a king.
flavour.TheGentleman: "Axes and mauls are so uncivilised. A good clean cut to the neck with a sharp blade, that's the Sarn way!"
flavour.TheGladiator:
The thumb turns down
and the crowd roars, 
they want death 
and the blood is yours.
flavour.TheHaleHeart: Though the years weakened his mind, his body remained deadly as ever.
flavour.TheHarvester:
Taste not of their
forbidden fruit.
Theirs is a harvest of
the darkest kind,
twisted, rotten and
damned for eternity.
flavour.TheHermit: The hermit's only friend is the greenery he can find.
flavour.TheHoarder: "More! I want more!" - Faendris, the Insatiable
flavour.TheHunger:
"How many lives have you consumed?" 
"How many times have you blinked?"
flavour.TheImmortal:
"Greetings! Just because you think I'm greedy doesn't mean I'm not willing to share. You'll just have to kill me first."
-Grandmaster Dy'Ness
flavour.TheIncantation: When there is no other choice, even the meekest whisper can bring about the greatest storm.
flavour.TheInnocent: His brother would not atone, so he took his brother's life, and with it, his sins.
flavour.TheInoculated: Chaos spread, wreaking havoc and death. They said none would be spared, and yet here I stand.
flavour.TheInsatiable: A lust for souls. The urge to kill just to satisfy its thirst. An unbearable burden that would make even the purest heart blacken over time.
flavour.TheInventor:
Jump right in, 
But beware 
Of things broken 
Or beyond compare.
flavour.TheIronBard:
Fourfold the refrain, fortissimo cheer.
One hundred rent twain, naught left for a bier.
The song rattles on, though hollow a bit.
See the hope is gone, no prize shall ye get.
flavour.TheJester:
Summoned for the King's desire,
soon applause came from the court.
However insanity was his only sire,
so the King's reign was cut short.
flavour.TheJewellersBoon: The jeweller's true talent is the capacity to see a jewel's beauty before they draw it out.
flavour.TheKingsBlade:
"To know for what you fight. To get up again when you've been struck down. To outmanoeuvre someone faster, trick someone smarter, crush someone stronger. That's what it takes to claim the crown."
- Daresso, the King of Swords
flavour.TheKingsHeart: 500 times Kaom's axe fell, 500 times Kaom's Heart splintered. Finally, all that remained was a terrible, heartless Fury.
flavour.TheLastOneStanding: The strongest emerge from suffering. The toughest bear the most scars. The sole survivor claims the greatest of rewards.
flavour.TheLich: When the dead raise and master their own, the land is truly lost.
flavour.TheLion: The Eternals lauded his valour. The Karui relished his defeat. Yet the final thoughts of Marceus Lioneye were naught but lament for his pride.
flavour.TheLordInBlack:
Thy knee shall bend
in shifting dark,
thy blade shall serve his vigil.
Thy oath shall bind thee
to his mark,
thy flesh shall bear his sigil.
flavour.TheLover: "I wanted to give you three things. I've given you my eternal love. I've sung to you my most beautiful song. I'd have given you the moon last, but it couldn't be found. I hope you'll accept this instead."
flavour.TheLunarisPriestess:
Embrace the Light,
Await the Morrow,
No more Spite,
And no more Sorrow.
flavour.TheMaster: In a world filled with chaos, he could always seek comfort in the hands of his master.
flavour.TheMayor:
A ruler is only as powerful as he is wealthy. 
Control the coin, control the empire.
flavour.TheMercenary: Loyalty can be bought. Just make sure you know who the buyer is.
flavour.TheMetalsmithsGift_: A month's work, a year's wages, a foolish shortcut through a Rhoa's nest, and a grieving bride-to-be, who never received her betrothed's great gift.
flavour.TheOath: An oath once made is an oath never broken. Do not delay in keeping it, for I take no pleasure in fools.
flavour.TheObscured: Our world, dangerous as it is, is far safer than what lies just beyond our sight.
flavour.TheOffering: Eternal beauty has a cost, one which Shavronne was happy to pay with the lives of others.
flavour.TheOneWithAll:
Embrace death to honour the lost,
no fear in life no matter the cost. 
With one of all we are, 
and all of one we trust, 
throughout past, present and future... be just.
flavour.TheOpulecent: Wealth can, in fact, buy happiness.
flavour.ThePackLeader: Become the leader you were born to be.
flavour.ThePact: "On this day I mark the first of many agreements that I will have with this land and its people."
flavour.ThePenitent: First, I gave my wealth, and we went hungry. Next, I gave my land, and we were homeless. Then, I gave my family, and I was alone. Last, I gave my eyes, and all I could dream was mine.
flavour.ThePoet:
God had forsaken the land 
And Victario wept.
Corruption consumed the land 
And Victario's tears turned to blood.
flavour.ThePorcupine: The first quill separates the quick learners from the dead.
flavour.ThePriceOfProtection:
To protect her mansion, she would cut a deal with anyone. Anything. 

Something answered.
flavour.TheProfessor: The academic route to knowledge is wide and well-trodden; but it is the untaught one who scales the mountain.
flavour.ThePuzzle: As countless fractures weaken the divide, nightmares seep through from the other side.
flavour.TheQueen:
The power of the world, 
lies upon your hands.
flavour.TheRabidRhoa:
"Experiment 22A: Rhoas, when deprived of water, secrete a most delightfully potent toxin."
- Maligaro
flavour.TheRealm: If you wish to rush into strange places, be prepared to face strange things.
flavour.TheRisk: "There is no right or wrong choice, no best or worst. There are only choices and their consequences."
flavour.TheRiteOfElements:
A mind as quick as lightning, 
fists as hard as stone, 
a heart that burns with fury, 
and eyes that chill to the bone.
flavour.TheRoadToPower: A beacon on the horizon; a guiding light, a call for help, or a warning to turn back.
flavour.TheRuthlessCeinture:
In combat, a warrior must first be resourceful,
and second, decisive.
flavour.TheSaintsTreasure: Publicly, he lived a pious and chaste life of poverty. Privately, tithes and tributes made him and his lascivious company very comfortable indeed.
flavour.TheSamuraisEye: At night, when the seas are calm, and the skies dark, he can see it. The formless fiend that took his eye, and fractured his mind.
flavour.TheScarredMeadow: The earth offers nourishment, growth and healing. Unless, of course, the sky has other plans.
flavour.TheScavenger: Take small pieces of things and then assemble them together
flavour.TheScholar: It is with the smallest of words that we find the largest of truths.
flavour.TheSephirot: If the path to divinity were simple, we'd all be gods.
flavour.TheSigil:
Three men travel
through the gate;
they carry a protective ward.
A faction conspires
against their fate,
but magic unravels the sword.
flavour.TheSiren:
At the beck and call
of The Siren's hand,
winter ravages
the trembling land,
and the weight of ice that binds
will break the strongest of minds.
flavour.TheSoul: "Most people only have one. I'm a bit of a hoarder."
flavour.TheSparkAndTheFlame: When sky meets ground the flames can be found, but who has the will to tame them.
flavour.TheSpoiledPrince: A boy who grows up with everything learns to appreciate nothing.
flavour.TheStandoff: Sometimes your greatest enemy is the only one keeping you breathing.
flavour.TheStormcaller:
If you beckon the
Lord of Lightning,
do not be surprised
when you are struck.
flavour.TheSummoner: To own a piece of the Nightmare, you must first belong to the Nightmare.
flavour.TheSun: Each night, the light dies, and each morning she is born anew, embracing the land in her golden wings.
flavour.TheSurgeon:
"He might be lacking in vision, but his virtuosity is undeniable."
- Malachai, on Maligaro
flavour.TheSurveyor: Exploring lands made of flesh and sorrow, we'll reap and plunder like there's no tomorrow.
flavour.TheSurvivalist:
A lucky number 
For us all 
To help us through 
The perils told.
flavour.TheSwordKingsSalute:
Many were slain by the sword king 
Their blood decorating his ring 
Those who retreated were slaughtered 
Those who fought bravely were honoured
flavour.TheThaumaturgist:
"Mastery of thaumaturgy is like any other pursuit; it requires dedication and sacrifice. Sometimes several sacrifices."
- Shavronne of Umbra
flavour.TheTower: A tower built of the strongest stone is not eternal; a towering intellect is not enlightened.
flavour.TheTraitor:
Sometimes an apprentice becomes a master through countless hours of hard work and practice.
Sometimes it happens by force.
flavour.TheTrial: You cannot journey to new lands until you have the courage to leave the safety of home.
flavour.TheTwilightMoon: The day is dying, the night is born, the air grows cool, the sky is torn.
flavour.TheTyrant:
"Fear controls the masses."
- Laszlo, the Scourge
flavour.TheUndaunted:
"Fate was always my nemesis... 
But it didn't stop me then, and it won't stop me now."
- Kjetilbrann, The Undaunted
flavour.TheUndisputed: To create something truly spectacular, you must risk total failure.
flavour.TheUnion:
On the 21st of Eterni, 
two become one, 
their light outshines 
the setting sun.
flavour.TheValkyrie:
The villain strikes,
the world is torn.
A war begins, a hero is born,
The nemesis sets the sky alight.
A hero's sacrifice
sets everything right.
- Drake's Epitaph
flavour.TheValleyOfSteelBoxes:
"The most valuable treasures should be hidden in plain sight." 
- Ina, Keeper of Goods
flavour.TheVast:
Can you hear the siren's calls,
Just beyond the sea?
A voice which hearts
of men enthralls,
I too am hooked to thee.
flavour.TheVisionary: Lioneye looked to the heights of glorious victory. And thus he missed the defeat right under his nose.
flavour.TheVoid: Reach into the Void and claim your prize.
flavour.TheWarden: Brutus' first innovation as Lord Incarcerator was a weighted chain around every neck so that his prisoners would forever bow to him.
flavour.TheWarlord:
To cure the Goddess,
and break the chains of corruption,
you must shatter the world.
flavour.TheWatcher:
Strange eyes on top of spines 
Gaze beyond the veil of time 
Deep down below the mines 
A dream of crimson and of grime
flavour.TheWeb:
A weapon, a shelter, a prison.
The web's purpose changes
with the spider's needs.
A lesson we should
take to heart.
flavour.TheWiltedRose: Though the path to divinity is fraught with peril, hope may bloom from within.
flavour.TheWind: Weaving through the cracks, searching for weaknesses, silent, indiscriminate, leaving sorrow in its wake.
flavour.TheWitch:
A wanderer in the wild strives 
Against countless foes he survives 
A fool pursues a quest contrived 
By the gift of the witch, alive.
flavour.TheWolf: The largest beasts cannot be overpowered. The Greatwolf teaches us to use guile, not strength, to probe for the soft flesh and strike deep.
flavour.TheWolfsShadow: "If I fall, we will fall together with my fangs in your throat."
flavour.TheWolvenKingsBite: A wolf does not bite his mate as he does his prey, yet both begin with bared teeth. Know who you are, and you will know the meaning of the bite.
flavour.TheWolverine: Claw them from the bottom, you'll be glad that you have got 'em, claw them from the top, you'll never want to stop.
flavour.TheWorldEater: Its body knows no limits. Its appetite knows no bounds.
flavour.TheWrath: "Daughter of catastrophe, mother of pain. Amongst the filth of Wraeclast, she wanders, and her wrath follows." - Quintoon the Returned
flavour.TheWretched: Necromancers, believe me, are more terrifying than their thralls.
flavour.ThiefsTrinketSculptureFlavour: Rubbing the eel's head is said to bring smugglers good fortune.
flavour.ThreeFacesInTheDark: For every threat you spy in the shadows, there are two others you don't.
flavour.ThreeVoices: The village elders had a curious rule: If you hear three voices scream for aid, flee as fast as you can.
flavour.ThunderousSkies: Many that have wielded the power of lightning have said that death by electrocution looks like the victim is more alive than ever before.
flavour.TimeLostRelic: Time cannot wash away that which cannot be forgotten.
flavour.TitanicScarab: What power lies in a name?
flavour.TitanicScarabOfTreasures: Greed is a trap of the mind.
flavour.TormentScarab: Their crimes in life haunt you in death.
flavour.TormentScarabOfPeculiarty: Now there's a blood-curdling wail I haven't heard before!
flavour.TormentScarabOfRelease_: If it could end, it wouldn't really be damnation.
flavour.TormentScarabofRares: The strong are never truly alone.
flavour.Tranquillity: Beware the sudden calm, for it is a sure sign of a storm on the horizon.
flavour.TreasureHunter:
"Don't worry, I know what I'm doing."
- Toggo's Last Words
flavour.TrialMasterFragment1:
They took pride in all that they built, considering each new
temple a testament to the gods... and then, to themselves.
flavour.TrialMasterFragment2:
Delving into the mysteries of existence, they deciphered
the secret laws of nature... and then, harnessed them.
flavour.TrialMasterFragment3:
Not content to live in harmony with the world, they strove
to understand it, to improve it... and then, to master it.
flavour.TrialMasterFragment4:
They collaborated with each other and with nearby peoples,
at first sharing, teaching... and then, dominating.
flavour.TulNormalRing: We lie eternal, eyes open, yet still.
flavour.TurnTheOtherCheek:
"Only after one forsakes rage, can true power be found."
- Sekhema Asenath
flavour.UberBenevolenceVaultKey:
The cold light of today can never compete
with the shining golden aura of yesteryear.
flavour.UberBossKeyAnger: A loved one's harsh words eventually become our own.
flavour.UberBossKeyBenevolence: Adoration can blind us to the truth of human flaws.
flavour.UberBossKeyCortex:
When memories become twisted by a corrupted mind,
 history is rewritten, time after time.
flavour.UberBossKeyEater:
At the core of the mass, a fierce hunger seethes,
 as the Tangle's champion devours a myriad of worlds...
flavour.UberBossKeyExarch_:
Constellations are systematically incinerated 
in the wake of an ever-expanding archive of minds.
flavour.UberBossKeyMaven_: You must rise from mere amusement to respected equal.
flavour.UberBossKeyShaper:
A single act of love and defiance
 may cascade destruction across the cosmos.
flavour.UberBossKeySirus:
Agony born of ennui. 
Hate born of love.
flavour.UberBossKeyUberElder:
A void where only terror and emptiness exists; 
those who attempt to struggle only hasten the assimilation
flavour.UberEaterOfWorldsKey:
That which could not be digested
remains lost within, the buried remnants
of whole cultures, of entire worlds.
flavour.UberElderFragment1: Beauty is in the eye of the creator.
flavour.UberElderFragment4: What is not cannot cause harm.
flavour.UberIgnoranceVaultKey:
Surrounded by comfort and kindness
all we see are the enemies of the past.
flavour.UberMavenKey:
Champions of her collection may take what
they wish, so long as they use it to entertain her...
flavour.UberNeglectVaultKey:
Time sweeps us further and further away
from the moments in which they lived.
flavour.UberSearingExarchKey:
Minds are not the only thing
the Cleansing Fire keeps eternal...
flavour.UberShaperKey:
Step into the inner sanctum of the minds of old
Enter a realm untouched even by starlight
Through transcendence, bend reality to your will.
flavour.UberSirusKey:
There is a place, a state of being,
where all that you love forgets you.
flavour.UberVenariusKey:
I have already lost more
than you shall ever possess.
flavour.UltimatumScarab: A challenge may be requested at any time.
flavour.UltimatumScarabOfBribing: A trial is only as incorruptible as its judge.
flavour.UltimatumScarabOfCatalysing: Most regret finding out how the powder is made.
flavour.UltimatumScarabOfDueling: Victory is meaningless, failure will be mocked.
flavour.UltimatumScarabOfInscription: There is always a wager to be made... if you can afford it.
flavour.Unique340Reliquary:
Though flesh may decay, and bones turn to dust, the spirit fades not.
Floundering eternal in pools of tranquil dark.
flavour.UniqueAmulet1:
You are slow, foolish and ignorant.
I am not.
flavour.UniqueAmulet10:
The world is but a piece of parchment, blank and symmetric. 
We label each side: one Good, one Evil; one Black, one White. 
The divine truth, however, is that both are one and the same. 
-Jaetai, Vaal Advisor
flavour.UniqueAmulet10x:

the type Delta test subject actually survived the entire testing regimen."
flavour.UniqueAmulet16: Forge your Perseverance on the Anvil of Faith.
flavour.UniqueAmulet17:
"Marylene stroked the medallion at her breast 
before every duel and every cast of the die." 
- Victario, the People's Poet
flavour.UniqueAmulet2:
The maidens of court swoon to see
the challengers crushed at your feet.
flavour.UniqueAmulet20:
As you have lived, so you shall die 
forever trying to keep up with me. 
Your blood on these hands of mine
forever makes me the public enemy.
flavour.UniqueAmulet21: The first light to grow in the primordial darkness.
flavour.UniqueAmulet22:
A shimmering symbol of Purity, clear as water,
but I know better than most how quickly
Purity can succumb to Corruption.
How quickly water turns to blood.
- Victario, the People's Poet

'My reach knows no bounds.
All that is pure is destined to rot.
All that lives is destined to serve.'
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
flavour.UniqueAmulet24:
Shackled fires dance about;
Might within from force without.
flavour.UniqueAmulet25:
Combat is simple.
Keep your blood in.
Take theirs out.
flavour.UniqueAmulet26:
When slaughtered flesh falls silent,
the soul may yet scream on.
flavour.UniqueAmulet27:
"I offer to you an eternal oath 
that binds your heart to mine;
a bond that not even death will break.
Will you accept?"
- Daresso, to his beloved
flavour.UniqueAmulet28:
Those who dwell in the deep freeze
enjoy a special kind of madness.
flavour.UniqueAmulet29:
Those who dwell in the deep freeze
enjoy a special kind of madness.
flavour.UniqueAmulet29x:

before he was found. Prototype #14 somehow kept him from dying."
flavour.UniqueAmulet3: The breath of life is yours to give.
flavour.UniqueAmulet30: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod
flavour.UniqueAmulet31: Remember the past, anticipate the future.
flavour.UniqueAmulet31x:

weren't the future. They were the past! Our 'unforeseen
consequences' have already been happening!"
- Researcher Graven
flavour.UniqueAmulet32: Many things come to one who has nothing.
flavour.UniqueAmulet33:
Each death witnessed is a valuable lesson, 
and what use is knowledge if it is not put into practice?
flavour.UniqueAmulet35:

and no eye met His. So He called down the cleansing flames
and let black smoke sweep the Sinners away."
- Book of Innocence

Friendship worth its weight in gold,
a treasure every day.
I thought together we'd grow old,
until fate pulled you away.
flavour.UniqueAmulet37:
His is our heart.
To its beat we all are driven.
flavour.UniqueAmulet38:
We are his blood.
Through us he carries his burning message.
flavour.UniqueAmulet39:
We wait, still as the dead,
to join the great avalanche.
