And when you are no longer useful, you will
discover how much you truly mean.

flavour.UniqueRing86:
I never knew fear until she was ripped away.
My promises were hollow ever after.
flavour.UniqueRing87:
In truth, your terror is cold
You mask it with heat and ire
But they know.
They know.
flavour.UniqueRing88:
It is not a wound caused by an enemy that bites us twice.

flavour.UniqueRing9:
By its light, Lori led her young charges to safety 
and bound up their wounds. 
Her sword arm was iron, yet her heart gentle 
and proof against hate.
flavour.UniqueRing90:
"Worry not, my friend, that I tour in fineries.

As long as I maintain my Vigilance,
nothing can harm the Empire... or me."
- Emperor Chitus, to Ondar
flavour.UniqueRing91:
Madness crawls under the skin,
bursting forth from the flesh.
flavour.UniqueRing92:
They seek that which lies before them, shining
Yours is a special curse, nipping at your heels
Driving you on long past agony and despair
flavour.UniqueRing93:
The old wound lurks deep within,
never healing, never relenting,
making every smile half-hearted.
flavour.UniqueRing94a:
They hide in deep places, and hidden places,
but stillness will find them... and bury them.
flavour.UniqueRing94b:
They dance and scream under the Broken Sun

flavour.UniqueRing94c:
They whisper in the dark, building towers of
mindless thought that seek a hollow truth.
flavour.UniqueRing94d:
They move and coil, gripped by painful ecstasy,

flavour.UniqueRing94e:
They dream no longer, strive no longer,

continuing to dream, and know not why.
flavour.UniqueRing95:
All gates are closed.
All dreams are silenced.
What could have been...
flavour.UniqueRing96_:

true, why hasn't he sold the damn thing already?

"I designed this to protect you,
whatever you may face. And when
this is all over... let's talk."
flavour.UniqueRing98:

a reverence for the Brine King burning in her heart.

flavour.UniqueRingDemigods1:
The victor stands tall with hand held high,
unwavering, unblinking, unstoppable.
flavour.UniqueRingVictors:
The road to victory is paved
with the bones of the defeated.
flavour.UniqueScepter17: Breathe deep, and give yourself over to eternity.
flavour.UniqueSceptre1:
Knowledge brings power, and with power you can
grab truth by the throat and shape it as you wish.
flavour.UniqueSceptre10:
"All are welcome in Hinekora's eternal home."

flavour.UniqueSceptre11:
Thousands gazed upon the doors of the great labyrinth,
at an Eternal Champion in steel and gold, 
The first to challenge its treacherous traps. 
To mark the occasion, Izaro had the Champion's remains gilded.
flavour.UniqueSceptre12:
When God forged the rules of reality,
he stated that some forces cannot co-exist.
He then made man with an unequivocal
desire to disobey.
flavour.UniqueSceptre13:
In time, all becomes nothing.
We just expedite the process.
flavour.UniqueSceptre14:
Fight not the cold
Forsake hope
Be still.
flavour.UniqueSceptre14x:
"Attempt #2520: Been slaving away at this one for longer than I can remember.
Convinced this assignment is retribution from my superior..."
flavour.UniqueSceptre16_: The worst of Axiom were imprisoned by more than iron.
flavour.UniqueSceptre17:
After the fires swept down from the sky and swallowed the city,
all that lingered, as if locked in time,
was a memory of that which was gone, a whisper of deeds undone.
flavour.UniqueSceptre18:
When the world spins out of control,
the safest place to be is in the centre.
flavour.UniqueSceptre19:
There the weary multitude of man-kind 
shall turn in their masses into the wide fire, 
where the destroying flame embraces the living, 
some will go up, some down, filled with misery.
flavour.UniqueSceptre19x:
"Lord of Bone, Lord of Flesh, yet all that we can
master turns to ash." 
- Researcher Arn
flavour.UniqueSceptre2:
Left in her tomb by the lynch mob, 
the flame inside still blazed bright after her death, 
and so did hers.
flavour.UniqueSceptre20: The greatest of guardians make the greatest of sacrifices.
flavour.UniqueSceptre21:
The vastness of the cosmos holds energies beyond comprehension,
should one have the fortitude to grasp them.
flavour.UniqueSceptre21x:
"We could rival the gods with this power, if only we had the mitigating mechanisms
to make it work. A jewel, a talisman, an armour... or the Font..."
flavour.UniqueSceptre22: A secret few among the Templars grant absolution by bearing the guilt of others.
flavour.UniqueSceptre23: Lead the army of the damned from the front.
flavour.UniqueSceptre24: Their three serpentine heads found unity in balance.
flavour.UniqueSceptre25: What we give to others, we also give to ourselves.
flavour.UniqueSceptre25x:
"And so it begins. Someone,
somewhere, is trying again...
seems mankind never learns."
flavour.UniqueSceptre26:
Over the course of a lifetime, Cadigan the First
conquered every city-state on Middengard one by one,
continually leveraging the power of each against the next.
flavour.UniqueSceptre27:
A future of untold power and doom opened
before Zarokh in that moment. He realised
there was not one Time, but many...
flavour.UniqueSceptre3: With death as my ally, all the world is within my grasp.
flavour.UniqueSceptre4:
"We Ezomytes made promises that this 
Eternal God would have us break." 
- Thane Rigwald
flavour.UniqueSceptre5:
Beneath the blue,
The stillness permits
The drowned dead
To regret their choices.
flavour.UniqueSceptre6:
My Iron heart will beat when yours is rust. 
I take your Strength, your power, your lust. 
By Iron Will alone I set my mind in motion.
Through endless storms of fervent devotion.
flavour.UniqueSceptre7:
The result of the catalytic reaction would be either immortality for all,
or death for all. It was a risk Doryani was willing to take.
flavour.UniqueSceptre8:
Feed on the light of the living,
Bring darkness to all I see,
Until we are one in shadow.
flavour.UniqueSceptre9:
"A sprinkle of liquid encouragement is often required 
to garnish the perfect confession." 
- Brutus, Warden of Axiom
flavour.UniqueSentinel1:
Destruction incarnate leaves a bitter aftertaste
as one soul is imbued with remnants of another,
and the earth is salted by rivers of blood.
flavour.UniqueSentinel11:
Mechanisms gone awry, circuitry in flux.
This experiment became something truly perverse.
flavour.UniqueSentinel12: Torture something enough, and you just might force a reaction.
flavour.UniqueSentinel2:
Alone among the powers of artifice, there is one against
which the horrors of Wraeclast have never adapted.
flavour.UniqueSentinel3_: She stands grim, wreathed in flame, awaiting the crusader's call.
flavour.UniqueSentinel3b:
Knowing the human body to harbour infinite potential,
she endowed her subjects with the most potent forces at her disposal,
striving invariably for improvement.
flavour.UniqueSentinel3c: Some artists wait a lifetime for inspiration. He waited for five.
flavour.UniqueSentinel3d: Even after she harvested their tongues, they were still able to scream.
flavour.UniqueSentinel3e:
This grotesque conglomerate is truly an abomination to behold.
You feel a strange sense of déjà vu when you gaze upon its hideous visage...
flavour.UniqueSentinel3f:
A fiery horror from a distant plane of existence,
it feasts upon the charred corpses subsumed by lava pits.
Don't fall in...
flavour.UniqueSentinel3h:
He feeds on the nightmares of the Atlas' denizens.
If you fall asleep in the Atlas, he'll be waiting...
flavour.UniqueSentinel4:
In the wake of tyranny,
The battlefields have been left barren.
flavour.UniqueSentinel6: Under clouds of black beset by crimson lightning, we sailed stormy seas of poison and disease. Only one light shone in that darkness; only one Flame to keep hope alive.
flavour.UniqueSentinel7: A life without risk is no life at all.
flavour.UniqueSentinel8: On judgement day, only those who are worthy will survive.
flavour.UniqueSentinel9:
Otherworldly incantations echo across the battlefield,
And the warrior readies his blade.
flavour.UniqueShieldDemigods: The light of victory burns eternally.
flavour.UniqueShieldDex1: Cold, miserable and alone... but alive.
flavour.UniqueShieldDex2:
"With piety and justice."
- Perandus family motto
flavour.UniqueShieldDex3:
"As long as I see death in my mirror, so will Wraeclast."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.UniqueShieldDex4: An eye for an eye. A curse for a curse.
flavour.UniqueShieldDex5:
Crimson burn'd the star of sadness,
All was woe that seem'd but gladness.
flavour.UniqueShieldDex6:
The horrors we've encountered are nothing
compared to the horrors we haven't.
flavour.UniqueShieldDex7: Embrace the snow or be buried.
flavour.UniqueShieldDex8:
Light as a board,
Stiff as a feather.
flavour.UniqueShieldDex8x:
"For personal defence, Prototype #444 is fantastic. It is one hundred percent
effective seventy five percent of the time... once." 
- Lead Researcher Ksaret
flavour.UniqueShieldDex9: Not even the storm knows when lightning will strike.
flavour.UniqueShieldDexInt1:
One wrong step triggers destruction. 
Agony slowly dominates the will to live.
flavour.UniqueShieldDexInt2:
"Look around you. What do you see? 
Corruption, perversion, sin?
No. It is progress. 
You simply lack the means to see it." 
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavour.UniqueShieldDexInt3:
Izaro's insistence on using lava
resulted in some surprising material discoveries.
flavour.UniqueShieldDexInt5:
"Great minds wish to reveal all the secrets of time and space.
But it does not matter. Creation, the act of Matter Metamorphosis, 
is the only secret worth discovering." 
- Zeel, Vaal Tinkerer
flavour.UniqueShieldDexInt6:
Something within the machine never stops moving,
but Oriathan scholars dare not open it to find out why.
flavour.UniqueShieldDexInt7: The lightning fears not the flame.
flavour.UniqueShieldDexInt8: Horrific experiments with corrupted flesh require careful management.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt1:
The Vaal emptied their slaves of beating hearts,
and left a mountain of twitching dead.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt10: Without night, there can be no day.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt11:
The heart grows slow,
the spirit grows strong.

This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Awakening
flavour.UniqueShieldInt12: Give him your body, and your burdens will follow.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt13:
The empire is both the tree and the fruit.
It provides safe harbour as ideas grow within,
and when the time is right, the apple is picked. 
The idea, and our ideals, take root.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt14:
Though we live and act as individuals,
in truth, we are tethered together. 
The barriers that divide us need not be broken 
for our spirits to become entangled.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt15: Fear not the fury of the storm.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt16:
You shall be weighed and measured. You shall be judged...
and perhaps you shall be found worthy.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt17:
He raised the greatest army Trarthus had ever seen... against
Bardiya's orders, they ravaged and pillaged without mercy.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt18:
"This infernal imp wasn't willing to part with its piece of the Allflame.
It's taught me ways to stoke the flame. To burn unnaturally fierce.
The imp may have the Allflame, but I have the imp."
- Velka, the Tide Witch
flavour.UniqueShieldInt2:
You carried me through life,
The least I can do is carry you through death.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt3:
The last thing Arimagius heard was the
jester's mocking bells in the distance.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt4:
Open your eyes and you will see the cracks in your enemy's walls.
Open your mind and you will see the cracks in your enemy's plans.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt5: The lords of the sea bow to no one.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt6:
Those who are skilled in combat do not become angered.
Those who are skilled at winning do not become afraid. 
Thus the wise win before they fight, 
while the ignorant fight to win.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt7:
Thaumaturgy has no limit.
It is our fragile reality that imposes boundaries.
flavour.UniqueShieldInt8:
She looked upon her reflection
and trembled, and shook,
until she was not what she saw.
flavour.UniqueShieldStr1:
Marceus' unblemished shield is a testament
to his arrogance... and his fate.
flavour.UniqueShieldStr10:
Tukohama couldn't lose a fight in his fortress,
So he carried his fortress to the fight.
flavour.UniqueShieldStr10x:
"As one of our few creations that did not cost any fatalities,
Prototype #10 bore unexpectedly positive results."
flavour.UniqueShieldStr11:
"It's not Karui, Azmeri or even Vaal in origin,
but one thing is certain. It is very, very old."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 46
flavour.UniqueShieldStr12:
Lunaris crossed silently, shining and full, 
Softly night left her, alone and forlorn.
Solaris rose to meet her, feeling her pull.
'Neath the midday sun, the night was reborn.
flavour.UniqueShieldStr13:
"The newcomers warn of doom and death beyond mortal ken.
I ask, why should we fear the fire when we serve the Lord of Light?"
- Maxarius, the first High Templar
flavour.UniqueShieldStr14:
The priests found the Great Shield the night it fell to Middengard,
but it was the smiths who delved into the secrets it held.
flavour.UniqueShieldStr15:
"A tale-woman passed through here not long ago.
Taught us a thing or two. We're not going to execute
you for what you've done... no. You've a debt to repay."
flavour.UniqueShieldStr2:
A mighty bulwark, curved and strong
A dauntless wall, against the throng
All lance and arrow, knocked aside
For rout of foe, for turn of tide.
flavour.UniqueShieldStr3:
Fire dances with those who doubt
Licks the skin and flesh from the fearful
Where there is no fear
There is no flame
flavour.UniqueShieldStr5:
The problem with working fresh trolltimber:
by the time you've carved out one end, 
the other has sprouted fresh roots!
flavour.UniqueShieldStr6: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod
flavour.UniqueShieldStr7: A true predator does not chase; It waits.
flavour.UniqueShieldStr8:
We are within her reach,
and when the time is right,
she will reach into us.
flavour.UniqueShieldStr9:
Our hearts cry out
but are silenced by our flesh
and so we give up our flesh.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrDex1:
By tourney's end, Daresso bled and shivered.
Yet even accursed treachery failed to steal the champion's victory.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrDex10:
On the Kraken's Rot, there was no whipping.
No lashes. Only barnacle-scraping duty.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrDex16:
We isolate ourselves to hide our long-held pain.
We lash out, when all we want is an end to loneliness.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrDex3:
The thicker the shell,
the greater the beast that hunts it.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrDex4:
Silent, silent night,
Quench the holy light.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrDex6:
Never let the audience know your true form. Misdirect them,
beguile them. Strike when they least expect it.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrDex7:
Judge not the weak, for
they empower the strong.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrDex8: Every clash leaves one more scar.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrDex9:
The Wildwood was a gift, meant as a haven
against the Winter of the World.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrInt1: A swift mind solves problems before they occur.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrInt11:
Eternal soldiers fight for glory or death.
The Solaris Vanguard know only glory.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrInt12:
An Emperor must conquer his own darkness
before he can act as a beacon of light.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrInt13:
Chitus' success stemmed from his cunning, taking calculated
risks so that greater dangers could be averted.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrInt15:
The Banished Architect sought to employ all the
darkest secrets of the Vaal... at the same time.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrInt2: When blood is paid, the weak think twice.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrInt4:
Born from the marriage of ice and sky,
the aurora evokes both awe and power.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrInt5:
My bearer shall be guarded by flame,
for I am the phoenix, forever radiant in glory.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrInt6:
"Let the evil ones deliver their fiery darts.
This time I've put my faith in steel."
 - Commander Santoni of the Damned Brotherhood
flavour.UniqueShieldStrInt7:
What is below is like what is above,
and what is above is like what is below,
to accomplish the miracles of one thing.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrInt8: Be not blinded by the light.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrInt9: A man's life is the greatest gift he can give.
flavour.UniqueShieldStrInt9x:
"Close to the original, and perhaps even more useful. However,
close is not what we are looking for. Keep trying." 
- Administrator Qotra
flavour.UniqueStaff1:
Burn to cinders, scar and maim,
Rule a world, bathed in flame.
flavour.UniqueStaff10: That which was broken may yet break.
flavour.UniqueStaff11:
The best way to gain the element of surprise,
is to let your enemy learn your plans,
and execute them - twice.
flavour.UniqueStaff12:
Guard your darkest thoughts well, for they are
the cracks through which the Nightmare crawls.
flavour.UniqueStaff13:
"God's creations always begin and end
with flames and ice.
We should count ourselves lucky when we see neither."
- Archbishop Geofri
flavour.UniqueStaff14:
When the storm comes,
the safest place to be is the centre.
flavour.UniqueStaff15:
"They spent a lifetime in the service of God, 
only to spend eternity in the service of me." 
- Kadavrus, Surgeon to the Umbra
flavour.UniqueStaff16:
"Since one with knowledge of machines
might be able to bring the labyrinth to a standstill, 
Izaro had us place many boobytrapped decoys.
But I know which switch brings the monster down."
- Xirgil, Trapbuilder's final words.
flavour.UniqueStaff17:
"The world is not simply black and white,
it is not divided into good and evil.
But black and white, good and evil, do exist,
and we must know how to recognize them."
- Archbishop Geofri
flavour.UniqueStaff17x:
"Lab Two suffered significant structural damage in the process of creating
Prototype #77. It is, however, the closest we've come to perfection."
flavour.UniqueStaff18:
You have been found guilty.
Let the fires cleanse you of your sins.
flavour.UniqueStaff2:
Shed by the winged beast of night,
A scaly frost-encrusted thorn.
All who feel its wintry light
Shiver in pain at the frozen dawn.
flavour.UniqueStaff21:
"Creation is the act of making the intangible tangible.
To work backwards, to make the tangible intangible,
is to step into the mind of a god."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
flavour.UniqueStaff22:
Blurred is the boundary
between creator and destroyer.
flavour.UniqueStaff23: Death is but the start of your servitude.
flavour.UniqueStaff24:
There was never a simpler time.
Just simpler motivations.
flavour.UniqueStaff25: The pyre is never wasted on just one heretic.
flavour.UniqueStaff27:
To stand at the confluence of the elements,
the master must achieve perfect balance.
flavour.UniqueStaff28: Bow before her... or suffer the most gruelling death imaginable.
flavour.UniqueStaff3:
Forged to rule the waves and tide
Destined to serve the monkey's paw
Strong as a tower of iron
Deft as the needle doubt
flavour.UniqueStaff30:
There is no force more destructive in the heavens
than the scintillating light of utter clarity.
flavour.UniqueStaff31:
Life... Death...
The whim of the cosmos.
flavour.UniqueStaff32:
For their mortal allies, the last Titans forged a mighty staff,
one that could safely hold the first unearthed virtue gem.
flavour.UniqueStaff33:
Nothingness is loathe to relinquish its grip.
Every moment is a struggle to exist.
flavour.UniqueStaff35:
We shared a memory of your mother,
a memory of roses, of autumn.
One day, I will be but a memory as well,
but I will never leave your side.
flavour.UniqueStaff36:
"I have risked everything. My position, my ambition, my
very life. There has to be a way to save our people. If we
must, let us tear apart the very foundations of reality!"
flavour.UniqueStaff37:
Before they 'saved' their beloved leader, the Afarud
tested their ritual on a dying man... but they made
a fatal mistake. They did not bind him to an object.
flavour.UniqueStaff38:
The experienced sailor knows the true mystery of the sea:
why, on every continent, in every lagoon, does there skitter
a crab of new size and colour? Not related, not lost spawn,
but a clawed snapper all of its own make and temperament...
flavour.UniqueStaff4:
You've no reason for fear when you're a root in a fen
- Old Ezomyte saying.
flavour.UniqueStaff4x:
"Attempt #306: The power I can sense in this ancient branch
still eludes me. Perhaps if I attach some string and a hook..."
flavour.UniqueStaff5:
The whispers of the dead
Carry wisdom for the living,
If you are willing to give your life
To listen.
flavour.UniqueStaff6_:
"To shake a hand is to double your power."
- Jaetai, Queen's Advisor
flavour.UniqueStaff7:
The right to rule demands mental acuity,
a strong arm,
And a tenacious sense of justice.
flavour.UniqueStaff8: One for each corner of the great Vinktar Square.
flavour.UniqueStaff9: Touch not the thorn, for only blood and pain await.
flavour.UniqueStaff9x:
"Physical forces and flames seem to share some innate bond.
What logic lies beneath the veil of reality?"
flavour.UniqueStrDexHelmet1:
We wander to pass time.
We travel to fulfill.
flavour.UniqueStrHelmet2:
Hrimnor's presence was as cold as ice,
but his heart burned for vengeance.
flavour.UniqueTalisman1:
In the light of Solaris, the shadows cower and hide.
But every night they gather and grow,
and all but the strong and the stupid
seek shelter from their grasp until daybreak.
flavour.UniqueTalisman2:
Long ago, the ocean was a puddle where a golden fish dwelt,
who lit the ocean from within and kept the water fresh.
When the sky burned, the fish dived deep,
never to return, and the waters turned sour.
flavour.UniqueTalisman3:
Just as the rat cowers before the dog
and the dog cowers before Man,
so too should we cower before the First Ones
and pray we never learn of what comes next.
flavour.UniqueTalisman4:
I once thought the First Ones were just
stories made to scare children.
But I've seen what they can do. I've felt it.
And now I must live with that terrible knowledge.
flavour.UniqueTalisman5:
I am but a vessel for a greater force.
It acts through me. Speaks through me.
Decides what lives and dies through me.
And will change the world through me.
flavour.UniqueTincture1:
Life and death dance ever closer,
waiting only for the right moment.
flavour.UniqueTincture2_:
The liquid within boils and fumes,
ready to erupt at any provocation.
flavour.UniqueTincture3: New life will follow, but first come the flames.
flavour.UniqueTincture4_: The struggle for balance never ends.
flavour.UniqueTincture5: A virulent brew of death and decay.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAce2:
Accept your fate, or lie, pretend.
Death collects you in the end.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe1:
One by one, Kaom slaughtered the weakest tribe
leaders until the others leapt to join his cause.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe10: When a craving cannot be sated, any source will do.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe11:
We feel the Mother's love
and beg to return to her womb.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe12:
At last she holds us,
and so we turn to dust.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe13:
Hinekora bound Kitava to a rock 
that Kitava could not lift with all his might.
Kitava vowed that when he broke free, 
he would devour every soul in Hinekora's domain.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe14:
"The Karui savages claim the weapon was forged by their fire god.
I'm rather inclined to believe them."
- Fairgraves, Renowned Explorer
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe15:
A sharp and heavy beat,
discorded, out of tune,
when you hear it on the wind,
you know death will follow soon.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe16:
War is a thriving infection.
It numbs the heart and eats away at the soul
until only emptiness remains.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe17: What began in the stars was settled in blood, beneath an uncaring sky.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe18:
"Not all the Abyssals serve the Lich Lords.
Some serve themselves, living off stolen
flesh and bone from those they... eat."
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe3:
Swinging through the air, it sings
of sundered, severed, missing things.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe4:
To cease the flow of blood is to 
choke the rain in the very clouds.
Both life and land feel the thirst.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe5:
Bargg Wurmkin once severed the heads 
of seven men in a single cleave.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe6: Fire and Anarchy are the most reliable agents of change.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe6x:
"The remarkable imbalance of Prototype #848 leads to uncommon
power or speed when striking."
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe7:
"I do not believe in disguising my disappointment."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe8:
Let it grow and gather inside them,
Let it flow through their veins.
Don't waste a drop.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe8x:
"Why is Prototype #67 never in the vault it should be?
Either we're keeping faulty logs, or..." 
- Researcher Graven
flavour.UniqueTwoHandAxe9:
A King and his people are linked together
like a soul and a beating heart.
Both can be severed by a same edge, 
then forged anew.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace1:
"The crack of bone, the spray of blood.
Is there sweeter music?"
- Hrimnor of the Ezomytes.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace10:
"Though ingenious instruments have been found,
it seems surgery before thaumaturgy
was not so delicate."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 3546
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace10x: "The best place for this prototype would be in the hands of our enemies."
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace11: The mind may have no limits, but the skull sure does.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace12:
The sea strikes the rock relentlessly.
Whether in one day or in ten thousand years,
eventually the rock will crumble,
and the Brine King's domain will grow.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace13:
Strike with the might of a falling oak,
and know that you never stand alone.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace15:
"Sacred water has no power of its own, and yet
holds the greatest strength of all... it can carry
what we give it. What we sacrifice for each other."
- Rashi, Grand Daiyata of the Sel Khari
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace16:
"All men must drink. Deny us water,
and we shall have blood instead."
- Rukh, of the Afarud
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace2:
"One quick tap is all the persuasion you'll need."
- Archbishop Geofri of Phrecia Cathedral
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace3:
Lumbering as a sea lion, clumsy as a berry-drunk pigeon. That was Erqi. 
It mattered little. When Erqi's maul fell true, so did its target.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace4: Cursed is the star whence it came.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace5: The faithful may continue to serve, even after death.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace6: Command like a king and nothing will stand in your way.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace6x:
"Prototype #599 offers an incredible defensive power, but at a cost.
What underlying physics are at play here, I wonder?"
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace7:
"The finest prosperity grows from the direst
carnage. Such is the nature of progress."
- Doryani of the Vaal
flavour.UniqueTwoHandMace8:
His flesh had long turned to dust,
but his vengeance lived on
in every scrap of iron he touched.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword1:
"Today, clansmen, my sword is my voice!"
- Rigwald, at the Battle of Glarryn
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword10:
The cuts on my hands are a small price to pay
for the opportunity to drive my steel
beyond the flesh and into the demon's soul.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword11:
Faintly gleaming in the moonlit night,
Kondo's Pride was primed to fight.
Driven by an inner fire,
bloodlust, spite and ill desire.
He swiftly moved to strike them all,
wreaking havoc like a steel squall.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword12: The end is written into the beginning.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword13:
A weapon born of nothingness,
can only create more nothingness.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword14: Witness the emergence of a new cosmic power.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword15: In the shifting reflections of the sea, the truth of the soul can be seen.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword16:
Green-cloaked travelers emerged from the mists, planted a tree,
and named it Lorrata. Its strongest root became a weapon...
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword17_:
"He speaks, he leads, he stands tall...
yet, what has he truly done, save
spill our blood in pursuit of power?"
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword18:
"This blade, which once tasted the green ichor of Kulemak himself, is now
anathema to all life. Piece by piece, we shall steal back what we are owed..."
- Sak, of the Afarud
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword19:
"To the Children of Winter, the Sun was but a myth. While Lundara held Kulemak
impaled, Solerai struck - not at him, but upwards. Her blade pierced the heavens,
and searing light embraced her golden armour. The Sun was real, and it was her."
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword2:
Stoic visage, icy heart.
Life of sorrow, lived apart.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword3:
His final sensation was of the executioner's blade.
It was not cold, instead warm and reassuring,
murmuring a promise of better times ahead.
Smiling, he returned death's embrace.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword4:
The nobles wanted to take her throne.
She let the peasants take their wealth.
The peasants wanted to take her wealth.
She let the soldiers take their heads.
The soldiers wanted to take her head.
She sat on her throne and wept.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword5:
Heavy as guilt.
Beautiful as temptation.
Painful as betrayal.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword6:
Give yourself to the flames and your name
will burn in the minds of men forever.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword6x:
"Ice and flame antagonized in the essence of a prototype.
What once burned now chills the soul." 
- Researcher Arn
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword7:
Soon, the pleas for mercy were muted.
Only one voice remained.
Laughing.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword8:
So the seed of hate was born,
Evil forged and Hope forsworn.
flavour.UniqueTwoHandSword9:
Take your partners by the hand,
Keep your steps in time.
Swing together, spin apart,
And dance with death sublime.
flavour.UniqueVaalReliquary:
Ambition followed progress,
Vanity followed passion,
Hubris followed intellect...
And silence followed all.
flavour.UniqueVaalSideAreaArchitects:
They met in secret to plan aspirations beyond all others.
Their grand dreams slowly turned into endless nightmares.
flavour.UniqueVaalSideAreaAtziri:
In every possibility, in every world that might have been,
Queen Atziri's mark on history was the one thing that never changed.
flavour.UniqueVaalSideAreaEndless:
Those citizens of the Vaal Empire that thought they survived the
Cataclysm soon realised that they had, in fact, done no such thing.
flavour.UniqueWand1:
Cast into darkness
And trapped for a thousand years,
The lonely moon weeps
flavour.UniqueWand10:
The Goat King drank the smoke and ate the flames
as his ruin spread across the land.
flavour.UniqueWand11:
We forge order from the world around us
Wielding anarchy and destruction as our tools of genesis.
flavour.UniqueWand12:
You can never truly tame the tempest.
You can barely even leash it.
flavour.UniqueWand13:
Every decade, Lunaris devours Solaris
Each time, Solaris emerges from Lunaris, born anew.
flavour.UniqueWand14:
"We do not command fire.
Ngamahu lends it, and Hinekora returns it."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
flavour.UniqueWand15:
We remember the stillness.
Then the great fall.
The pain of separation.
We return once more.
flavour.UniqueWand16:
We fracture and splinter.
We pierce our sides.
But in the great freeze we are forged anew.
flavour.UniqueWand16x:
"Are we mad for attempting to build an engine out of this?
Looping cycles, power and pain..." 
- Researcher Arn
flavour.UniqueWand17: Without light, there can be no shadow.
flavour.UniqueWand18: In every piece of prose, lies a tiny spark of magic.
flavour.UniqueWand19:
All at once, a calmness would encompass them,
and all at once, it would be torn away,
unveiling forms no sound mind could grasp.
flavour.UniqueWand2:
A chilling hush, a scraping sound
Of things no more entombed in ground.
A shambling horde is on its way
To crush the very light of day.
flavour.UniqueWand20: Crush your enemies with your essence, so that you may drink of theirs.
flavour.UniqueWand21: In a time of darkness, know that the Draíocht will bring you light.
flavour.UniqueWand22:
"Waging war is a simple matter of geometry and death."
- Trinian, Intellectus Prime
flavour.UniqueWand23:
Beyond the edge of existence, there
shines violet, naught but pain...
one lantern carries a single flame.
flavour.UniqueWand2x:
"Simply incredible. I caught an escaping test subject myself with
swarms of burning skulls. Delightful!" 
- Researcher Olesya
flavour.UniqueWand3:
"The trick is to give nothingness,
and to receive everything in return."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
flavour.UniqueWand4:
From the smallest seeds
To the tallest redwoods,
Life endures in Wraeclast.
flavour.UniqueWand5: And the thunder rumbled on and on.
flavour.UniqueWand6:
"Stone still, amidst the reeds,
breath fogging in the iron cold air. 
he sits, he waits, he watches. 
A piscatorial vigil, sat by the river, 
his cathedral, his patience his unanswered prayer."
- Jojoba Mansell, bard, angler, adventurer
flavour.UniqueWand7:
Apep's poison entraps, encircles,
and engulfs the leaking mind of Man.
flavour.UniqueWand8: If it's worth doing once, it's worth doing twice.
flavour.UniqueWand9x:
"Energy redirected is energy imbalanced.
Prototype #78 serves as a prime example."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone1:
Those who could flee did so.
The rest fought bravely,
and died horrifically.
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11a:
"The village was locked within its walls,
protected from those who could do them harm,
protected from those who could save them."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11b:
"Believing them to have discovered new lands,
they planted their flag in the dirt and called it their own.
A gesture not taken with a great deal of pleasure
by those who already dwelt there."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11c:
"The first explorers took to the hills to discover the lay of the land,
and watched with wonder as the land undulated, crashed and twisted."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11d:
"Atop the highest peaks, the sunlight pierced but did not warm.
The air choked and did not nourish.
And those that made the trek realised the folly of their desire for greatness."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11e:
"Where once a mountain stood there was now but fields and dust.
One by one, the stones were moved and placed with intention,
the consequences borne by the destination and the origin."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11f:
"The Shade walked the land with no end in sight,
no purpose in mind,
but the one it invented to pass the time."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11g:
"There were seasons in this strange new place, but not of sun and snow.
Seasons of stone that rose and fell like waves.
Seasons of structure and growth and madness and chaos.
Seasons of birth and decay that seemed untethered to cause."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone11h:
"For a time, it was thought this place could seed an empire
greater than any in history.
The lands could be tamed, and commanded, they thought.
But control, like all things in that place, was an illusion."
flavour.UniqueWatchstone2:
They came, full of vim and vigour, to take what was not theirs.
They crashed and clamoured like waves against rocks,
and were swept back out to sea.
flavour.UniqueWatchstone3:
The King's Eye returned from the west.
Fertile pastures lay just beyond sight.
Just a little farther, he said.
It was always just a little farther.
flavour.UniqueWatchstone4: Nothing is more alluring than mystery.
flavour.UniqueWatchstone5:
There exists in every man and woman
a desire to push boundaries, to break new ground,
to make great discoveries,
no matter the personal cost.
flavour.UniqueWatchstone6:
Conflict begets only suffering.
For some, that is by design.
flavour.UniqueWatchstone7_:
Does the belly swell, or the belt shrink?
To those caught between, there is no difference,
and something must soon give.
flavour.UtzaalArena:
In the outskirts of a lost city,
face the ultimate challenge...
flavour.UulNetolNormalRing: Our flesh longs to move as one.
flavour.ValdoMapFlavour:
Some dreams are too broken to fix.
Let broken realities lie dormant.
flavour.ValdoPuzzleBox:
I can find no method of destroying the dangerous contents within... 
 perhaps, someday, you will find a way.
flavour.VaultsResearch: The treasures within are tainted by a black spirit.
flavour.ViniasToken: You can change your name, but you cannot change your history.
flavour.VisceraCauldronFlavourText: Flesh can be as clay to the properly motivated artist.
flavour.VolatilePower: Unlimited power is apt to corrupt the minds of those who possess it.
flavour.Watchstone:
The memories and emotions of countless victims of the Elder,
locked in stone for eternity.
flavour.WatchstoneMaven: Only the souls trapped within can bear witness to the Maven's dark proclivities, and they dare not speak up.
flavour.WealthAndPower: The greatness of a man is not in how much wealth or power he acquires, but in his integrity and his ability to positively affect those around him.
flavour.Whakano1:
"When you stop viewing someone as a fellow human being,
there's little you won't do to forward your agenda.
That is what we're dealing with."
flavour.Whakano2:
"Selfishness and hate fuel these kidnappings. 
It's time we find who is leading them."
flavour.XophNormalRing: The embers of the Red Pyre yet glow.
flavour.ZigguratMapFlavour:
She who gazes into the
Abyss must take care...
gem_descriptions.Absolution: Damages enemies in an area, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the corpse will be consumed to summon a Sentinel of Absolution for a secondary duration, or to refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them.
gem_descriptions.AbsolutionAltX: Damages enemies in an area, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the corpse will be consumed to summon a Sentinel of Absolution for a secondary duration, or to refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them.
gem_descriptions.Affliction: Permanently Afflicts any of your damageable minions in a targeted area, causing them to take physical damage over time, at an accelerating rate. Each such minion causes you to regenerate life at a rate based on the current damage of it's Affliction debuff. Afflicted Minions explode if their life is lowered to a fifth of maximum.
gem_descriptions.AlchemistsMark: Curses a single enemy, granting flask charges when you hit them and creating Burning Ground under them if your hit Ignites them, and Caustic Ground if it Poisons them. Damage modifiers do not apply to these ground effects. You can only have one Mark at a time.
gem_descriptions.Ambush: Teleports you to a nearby enemy, applying a buff to you for a short duration and blinding the enemy for a secondary duration. Performing a melee attack with a One-Handed Weapon removes the buff to exert that attack.
gem_descriptions.AncestralCry: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent strike attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that  grants elemental resistances.
gem_descriptions.AncestralProtector: Summons an Ancestor Totem which attacks enemies with melee strikes while you're near it. Being near it grants you more attack speed. Requires a Melee Weapon or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.AncestralProtectorRoyal: Summons an Ancestor Totem which attacks enemies with melee strikes while you're near it. Being near it grants you more attack speed. Requires a Melee Weapon or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.AncestralWarchief: Summons an Ancestor Totem which attacks enemies with a powerful slam while you're near it. Being near it grants you more melee damage. Requires a Melee Weapon or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.AncestralWarchiefRoyale: Summons an Ancestor Totem which attacks enemies with a powerful slam while you're near it. Being near it grants you more melee damage. Requires a Melee Weapon or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.Anger: Casts an aura that adds fire damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.
gem_descriptions.AnimateGuardian: Animates a melee weapon or armour, attaching it to an invisible Guardian that fights by your side. Animating multiple items attaches them to the same Guardian. You cannot animate unidentified items. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. If your Guardian dies you cannot summon an Animated Guardian again in that area.
gem_descriptions.AnimateGuardianAltX: Animates a melee weapon or armour, attaching it to an invisible Guardian that fights by your side using Smite of Divine Judgement, ignoring weapon restrictions. Animating multiple items attaches them to the same Guardian. You cannot animate unidentified items. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. If your Guardian dies you cannot summon an Animated Guardian again in that area.
gem_descriptions.AnimateGuardiansWeapon: Animates a copy of your Animated Guardian's main-hand weapon to fight by your side.
gem_descriptions.AnimateWeapon: Animates a Melee Weapon Item or Lingering Blade to fight by your side. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines.
gem_descriptions.AnimateWeaponAltX: Animates a copy of your main hand Melee Weapon to fight by your side. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps or Mines.
gem_descriptions.AnimateWeaponAltY: Animates a Ranged Weapon Item or Lingering Blade to fight by your side. You cannot animate unidentified Weapons. Will not animate weapons with 6 sockets. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines.
gem_descriptions.AnimosityUniqueSkill: While active, this skill inflicts the Weeping Black debuff on impaled enemies you hit with bow attacks. Weeping Black deals physical damage over time, and can stack up to five times. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.
gem_descriptions.ApproachingFlames: Become touched by the flames of the Cleansing Fire.
gem_descriptions.Arc: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.
gem_descriptions.ArcAltX: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and splits to simultaneously hit several other enemies.
gem_descriptions.ArcAltY: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy, but this secondary arc cannot chain further.
gem_descriptions.ArcaneCloak: Spends a portion of your mana to grant a buff that takes some of the damage from hits for you until depleted. The buff grants added lightning damage based on the amount of mana spent by this skill. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
gem_descriptions.ArcaneWake: Create a slipstream at your location.
gem_descriptions.ArcticArmour: Conjures an icy barrier that chills enemies when they hit you. You drop chilled ground while moving, and take less Fire and Physical damage while stationary.
gem_descriptions.ArmageddonBrand: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.
gem_descriptions.ArmageddonBrandAltX: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It activates once, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky, then is destroyed.
gem_descriptions.ArmageddonBrandAltY: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.
gem_descriptions.ArtilleryBallista: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in a line, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.
gem_descriptions.ArtilleryBallistaAltX: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in two perpendicular lines, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.
gem_descriptions.ArtilleryBallistaAltY: Summons a ballista totem that propels a number of fiery arrows into the air, each targeting a specific enemy. Arrows deal area damage to enemies around it on landing. Requires a Bow.
gem_descriptions.ArtilleryBallistaRoyale: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in a line, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.
gem_descriptions.AshwakerSummonRagingSpi: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.
gem_descriptions.AspectOfArakaali: While active, you inflict Wither on hit, and Wither you inflict will be reflected back to you. Additionally, for each stack of Wither on you, your Life recovery rate is increased.
gem_descriptions.AspectOfLunaris: While active, taking Physical or Elemental Damage will grant you either Lunar Protection or Lunar Resistance, respectively. Aspect of Lunaris lessens incoming Physical Damage for each Lunar Protection on you, and lessens incoming Elemental Damage for each Lunar Resistance on you. These buffs can both stack up to eight times.
gem_descriptions.AspectOfSolaris: While active, inflicts Fire Exposure on enemies within its radius. Additionally, periodically applies a Sunscald debuff to enemies within its radius, with each Sunscald debuff increasing the effect of exposure on affected enemies. Sunscald can stack up to five times.
gem_descriptions.AspectOfTheAvian: While active, grants the Avian's Might and Avian's Flight buffs in sequence. Avian's Might grants you and your minions a chance to deal Double Damage with hits for a duration. Avian's Flight grants you and your minions increased Movement Speed for a secondary duration.
gem_descriptions.AspectOfTheBrineKing: While active, inflicts Chill on enemies within it's radius, while also increasing the strength of Chill you inflict and causing Damage you deal to Chilled enemies to penetrate some of their Cold Resistance.
gem_descriptions.AspectOfTheCat: While active, grants the Cat's Stealth and Cat's Agility buffs in sequence. Cat's Stealth increases your critical strike chance, makes you harder to see, and gives you a chance to avoid damage for a short duration. Cat's Agility increases your attack and cast speed for a longer secondary duration.
gem_descriptions.AspectOfTheCrab: While active, periodically adds Crab Barriers to you, and grants additional Physical Damage reduction for each Crab Barrier you have. All Crab Barriers are lost when you take physical damage from a hit.
gem_descriptions.AspectOfTheSpider: While active, periodically applies a Spider's Web debuff to nearby Enemies, and Hinders them. Each Spider's Web on an Enemy increases the Damage they take. Hinder reduces their movement speed.
gem_descriptions.AssassinsMark: Curses a single enemy, making them more vulnerable to Critical Strikes. Killing the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and a power charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.
gem_descriptions.AssassinsMarkRoyale: Curses a single enemy, making them more vulnerable to Critical Strikes. Killing the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and a power charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.
gem_descriptions.AssassinsMarkTriggered: Curses a single enemy, making them more vulnerable to Critical Strikes. Killing the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and a power charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.
gem_descriptions.AtziriUniqueStaffFlameb: Creates markers at your location and a targeted location, which grow over time based on cast speed, then explode, dealing fire damage. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.
gem_descriptions.AtziriUniqueStaffStormC: Creates a number of markers around the targeted location, which will explode after a duration, dealing lightning damage. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.
gem_descriptions.Autoexertion: Reserves mana based on the supported warcries to cause those warcries to be repeatedly triggered.
gem_descriptions.Automation: While this skill is active, supported spells will be repeatedly triggered.
gem_descriptions.AvengingFlame: Launches a fiery projectile high into the air, to drop on a target and deal area damage where it lands.
gem_descriptions.Backstab: A dagger skill that deals a critical strike and additional damage to an enemy if the attack is made from behind the enemy. Has high mana cost and cooldown
gem_descriptions.BallLightning: Fires a slow-moving projectile that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.
gem_descriptions.BallLightningAltX: Fires a single projectile which moves in a spiral while damaging each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.
gem_descriptions.BallLightningAltY: Creates a ball of lightning at a location that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning. Cannot be supported by Spell Echo or used by Totems.
gem_descriptions.BallLightningRoyale: Fires a slow-moving projectile that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.
gem_descriptions.Bane: Applies a debuff to enemies in an area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
gem_descriptions.BaneAltX: Applies a debuff to enemies in a small area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
gem_descriptions.BarnacleSnap: Creates a giant barnacle that continually snaps at enemies, dealing off-hand area damage augmented by the defences of the shield. Increases and reductions to attack speed affect the rate at which damage occurs.
gem_descriptions.Barrage: After a short preparation time, you fire individual projectiles repeatedly with a Bow or Wand. These projectiles have a small randomised spread. This skill cannot be Triggered.
gem_descriptions.BarrageAltX: After a short preparation time, you fire projectiles repeatedly with a Bow or Wand. These projectiles have a small randomised spread. This skill cannot be Triggered.
gem_descriptions.BattlemagesCry: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that boosts critical strike chance.
gem_descriptions.BearTrap: Throws a trap that damages and immobilises a single enemy for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. After the immobilise expires, a debuff remains on the enemy for a duration, lowering their movement speed by an amount which lessens over time. The affected enemy will take increased damage from traps and mines until the debuff expires. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.
gem_descriptions.BearTrapAltX: Throws a trap that damages and impales a single enemy, and immobilises them for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.
gem_descriptions.BearTrapRoyale: Throws a trap that damages and immobilises a single enemy for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. After the immobilise expires, a debuff remains on the enemy for a duration, lowering their movement speed by an amount which lessens over time. The affected enemy will take increased damage from traps and mines until the debuff expires. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.
gem_descriptions.Berserk: Consumes Rage at an accelerating rate to increase the effects of Rage.
gem_descriptions.BitingBraidNova: When hit, release a nova of venomous bile that deals spell chaos damage. This nova poisons and hinders on hit.
gem_descriptions.BladeBlast: Deals spell damage in a targeted area. Each time this spell deals damage,  it will detonate any of your Lingering Blades it touches, dealing damage again in an area around them. Up to 50 Blades can be detonated this way.
gem_descriptions.BladeBlastAltX: Deals spell damage in an area around you. If you have Blade Vortex blades orbiting you, it will detonate each of them in turn, dealing damage again in an area around you for each one.
gem_descriptions.BladeBlastAltY: Deals spell damage in an area around you. Your equipped daggers add to this damage.
gem_descriptions.BladeBlastRoyale: Deals spell damage in a targeted area. Each time this spell deals damage,  it will detonate any of your Lingering Blades it touches, dealing damage again in an area around them. Up to 50 Blades can be detonated this way.
gem_descriptions.BladeFlurry: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The damage is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.
gem_descriptions.BladeFlurryAltX: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The critical strike chance is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.
gem_descriptions.BladeFlurryRoyale: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The damage is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.
gem_descriptions.BladeTrap: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw or One Handed Sword around it in circles, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through.
gem_descriptions.BladeTrapAltX: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Two Handed Sword around it in circles for a duration, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through
gem_descriptions.BladeTrapAltY: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw, One Handed Sword or One Handed Axe around it in a circle, each damaging enemies it spins through.
gem_descriptions.BladeVortex: This spell creates ethereal blades which orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius. As more blades are added, the damage becomes greater and more frequent.
gem_descriptions.BladeVortexAltX: This spell creates a swarm of ethereal blades which briefly orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius.
gem_descriptions.BladeVortexRoyale: This spell creates ethereal blades which orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius. As more blades are added, the damage becomes greater and more frequent.
gem_descriptions.Bladefall: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.
gem_descriptions.BladefallAltX: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys, each wider and more damaging than the last. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.
gem_descriptions.BladefallAltY: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.
gem_descriptions.BladefallAltZ: Once activated, continuously spends mana to cause volleys of ethereal weapons rain from the sky around you, dealing damage to enemies they impact. Each Blade will target a separate enemy in the volley area if possible. Each enemy can only be hit once by each volley, even if multiple blades land near them. This skill cannot be triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
gem_descriptions.BladefallRoyale: Ethereal weapons rain from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in a sequence of volleys. Enemies can be hit multiple times where these overlap.
gem_descriptions.Bladestorm: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a bladestorm matching your stance. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.
gem_descriptions.BladestormAltX: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a random bladestorm. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe.
gem_descriptions.BladestormRoyale: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a bladestorm matching your stance. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.
gem_descriptions.BlastRain: Fires arrows up in the air, to rain down in an area. Each arrow deals area damage around where it lands, and they will all overlap on the targeted location.
gem_descriptions.BlastRainAltX: Fires a single arrow up in the air, to rain down at a targeted location. The arrow deals area damage around where it lands, as well as releasing a wave of fire which will apply a burning debuff to enemies. The impact of the arrow will also inflict this debuff.
gem_descriptions.BlastRainRoyale: Fires arrows up in the air, to rain down in an area. Each arrow deals area damage around where it lands, and they will all overlap on the targeted location.
gem_descriptions.BlazingSalvo: Fires projectiles which fly in an arc, dealing area damage on impact with either enemies or the ground near where you target. Targeting farther away causes the projectiles to spread out and land over a wider area.
gem_descriptions.BlazingSalvoRoyale: Fires projectiles which fly in an arc, dealing area damage on impact with either enemies or the ground near where you target. Targeting farther away causes the projectiles to spread out and land over a wider area.
gem_descriptions.Blight: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.
gem_descriptions.BlightAltX: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration. The damaging debuff is spread by Contagion.
gem_descriptions.BlightAltY: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a longer secondary duration, slowing their movement and reducing their life regeneration rate. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.
gem_descriptions.BlightRoyale: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.
gem_descriptions.BlindingAura: Casts an aura that blinds enemies in a radius.
gem_descriptions.BlinkArrow: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.
gem_descriptions.BlinkArrowAltX: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.
gem_descriptions.BlinkArrowAltY: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.
gem_descriptions.BlinkArrowRoyale: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.
gem_descriptions.BlinkArrowTriggered: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.
gem_descriptions.BloodAndSand: Casts a buff that grants different bonuses to melee skills depending on your stance. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.
gem_descriptions.BloodAndSandRoyale: Casts a buff that grants different bonuses to melee skills depending on your stance. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.
gem_descriptions.BloodOffering: Consumes a corpse, and sacrifices a portion of your life, granting your minions life regeneration based on the life sacrificed, and a bonus to damage. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration and life regeneration for each corpse consumed.
gem_descriptions.BloodRage: Adds a buff that deals Physical Damage over time, while increasing Attack Speed and Life Leech. Killing an enemy while this buff is active refreshes the buff duration, and can grant a Frenzy Charge.
gem_descriptions.BloodSacramentUnique: Channel this skill to reserve more and more of your life, building up power in a marker on the ground under you. Release to deal physical damage in an area based on how much life you reserved. Cannot be cast by Totems.
gem_descriptions.BloodSandTriggered: Casts a buff that grants different bonuses to attack skills depending on your stance. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.
gem_descriptions.BloodShrineUniqueTrigge: A toad spawns from the corpse of the slain enemy, leaps towards enemies and explodes, dealing forty percent of the slain enemy's Life as Chaos Damage. This skill's damage is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected.
gem_descriptions.Bodyswap: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or corpse, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise corpses over enemies. If targeting a corpse, the corpse will also explode, dealing damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.
gem_descriptions.BodyswapAltX: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or damageable minion, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise minions over enemies. If targeting a minion, the minion will also be destroyed in an explosion which deals damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.
gem_descriptions.BodyswapTriggered: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or corpse, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise corpses over enemies. If targeting a corpse, the corpse will also explode, dealing damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.
gem_descriptions.BoneArmour: Applies a buff to you and each of your minions, which will take some of the damage from enemy hits before being depleted. The buff also grants immunity to bleeding. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
gem_descriptions.BoneCorpsesTriggered: Spawns Bone Archer corpses around the targeted location.
gem_descriptions.BoneNova: Bones erupt around enemies you hit, dealing physical damage.
gem_descriptions.BoneOffering: Consumes a corpse, granting all of your minions the power to block both attacks and spells. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.
gem_descriptions.BoneOfferingTriggeredUn: Consumes a corpse, granting all of your minions the power to block both attacks and spells. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.
gem_descriptions.Boneshatter: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike that also hurts you. Successive uses will raise the damage dealt both to enemies and you. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.
gem_descriptions.BoneshatterAltX: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike that also hurts you. Successive uses will raise the damage dealt both to enemies and you. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.
gem_descriptions.BoneshatterAltY: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.
gem_descriptions.BrandRecall: Recall your brands to you, detaching them from enemies and increasing attachment range until they next attach to an enemy. Spends a portion of each recalled brand's cost to cause it to activate.
gem_descriptions.BrandSupport: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, triggering linked spells. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.
gem_descriptions.Brandsurge: Overcharges your brands near the targeted area, causing them to accelerate how quickly they activate and expire. Deals damage in an area around each overcharged brand when it expires.
gem_descriptions.BreachHandTrap: Throws out a trap which creates a rift, attracting a malefic hand from another realm. When the trap is triggered, the hand tears the bottom of the breach out, shattering reality to deal spell damage in an area.
gem_descriptions.BurningArrow: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.
gem_descriptions.BurningArrowAltX: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.
gem_descriptions.BurningArrowRoyale: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.
gem_descriptions.CallMercenary: Recalls any Mercenary accompanying you to your location. Recalled Mercenaries are healed for a portion of their maximum health.
gem_descriptions.CallOfSteel: Calls impale debuffs from enemies, alive or dead, in a large area around you to gain steel shards. Deals reflected damage in a smaller area around each such enemy based on the impales removed from them. Continues to grant shards over time until you reach maximum or spend them.
gem_descriptions.CatsStealthTriggeredInt: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants movement speed.
gem_descriptions.CausticArrow: Fires an arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact, and spreads caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.
gem_descriptions.CausticArrowAltX: Fires a poisonous arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact.
gem_descriptions.CausticArrowRoyale: Fires an arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact, and spreads caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.
gem_descriptions.CeaselessFleshUnique: Once per second, raise a nearby corpse as a shambling undead. This minion will follow you and attack your enemies with melee strikes, but quickly falls apart. These minions have significantly increased attack speed while on low life.
gem_descriptions.ChainHook: When used at range, throws out a chain, pulling you to the enemy hit dealing damage in an area behind them. When close to the enemy, just causes the area damage directly. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe.
gem_descriptions.ChainHookAltX: Cast your fishing rod towards a number of enemies in front of you. Non-unique enemies far away from you are pulled towards you.
gem_descriptions.ChainHookAltY: Throws chains ahead of you, attaching them to targets hit. Enemies chained to you will grant rage when hit. When chains are broken, they snap and deal attack damage in an area around the target they were attached to. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe.
gem_descriptions.ChainHookRoyale: When used at range, throws out a chain, pulling you to the enemy hit dealing damage in an area behind them. When close to the enemy, just causes the area damage directly. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe.
gem_descriptions.ChargedDash: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to teleport to the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.
gem_descriptions.ChargedDashAltX: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to release the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.
gem_descriptions.ChargedDashRoyale: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to teleport to the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.
gem_descriptions.Clarity: Casts an aura that grants mana regeneration to you and your allies.
gem_descriptions.ClarityRoyale: Casts an aura that grants mana regeneration to you and your allies.
gem_descriptions.Cleave: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Only works with Axes and Swords.
gem_descriptions.CleaveAltX: The character swings both their weapons in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Requires dual wielding both an Axe and a Sword.
gem_descriptions.CleaveRoyale: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Only works with Axes and Swords.
gem_descriptions.CobraLash: Fires a poisonous projectile based on your weapon that will chain between enemies. Requires a Dagger or Claw.
gem_descriptions.CobraLashRoyale: Fires a poisonous projectile based on your weapon that will chain between enemies. Requires a Dagger or Claw.
gem_descriptions.ColdAegis: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes cold damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking cold damage from hits, or if depleted.
gem_descriptions.ColdSnap: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. Also creates an expanding area which is filled with chilled ground, and deals cold damage over time to enemies. Enemies that die while in the area have a chance to grant Frenzy Charges. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.
gem_descriptions.ColdSnapAltX: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.
gem_descriptions.ColdSnapRoyale: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. Also creates an expanding area which is filled with chilled ground, and deals cold damage over time to enemies. Enemies that die while in the area have a chance to grant Frenzy Charges. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.
gem_descriptions.Combust: Deals attack damage in an area.
gem_descriptions.Conductivity: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their lightning resistance and giving them a chance to be shocked when hit.
gem_descriptions.Conflagration: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing area damage on impact and leaving the arrows stuck in the ground for a duration. If you move close to a stuck arrow, it will explode, dealing area damage and applying a fire damage over time debuff, as well as causing other stuck arrows in range to also explode.
gem_descriptions.ConsecratedPath: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.ConsecratedPathAltX: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.Contagion: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies.
gem_descriptions.ContagionAltX: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies, but each time it spreads, it only deals three quarters as much damage as before.
gem_descriptions.ContagionAltY: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy is hit while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies.
gem_descriptions.ConversionTrap: Throws a trap that, when triggered by an enemy, converts that enemy to your side for a short duration. Does not affect unique monsters or players.
gem_descriptions.Convocation: Recalls all minions that are following you to your location, and grants them a temporary life regeneration effect.
gem_descriptions.ConvocationOld: Recalls all minions that are following you to your location, and grants them a temporary life regeneration effect.
gem_descriptions.CorpseWalk: Spawns corpses around you while you move, based on monsters in the current area. If you are using the Raise Spectre skill there is a chance to spawn spectral corpses matching your most recently raised Spectres. Spectral corpses cannot be interacted with except by Minion skills.
gem_descriptions.CorruptingFever: Draws out your own blood to power a buff for a duration, letting this skill inflict the Corrupting Blood debuff on enemies you hit, dealing physical damage over time for a short secondary duration. The buff's duration will be refreshed if you spend enough life before it expires.
gem_descriptions.CracklingLance: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides.
gem_descriptions.CracklingLanceAltX: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides.
gem_descriptions.CracklingLanceAltY: Release a concentrated beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you.
gem_descriptions.CreateFungalGroundOnKil: Creates a patch of Fungal Ground at the targeted location.
gem_descriptions.CreepingFrost: Fire an icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.
gem_descriptions.CreepingFrostAltX: Fire a single icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep rapidly across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.
gem_descriptions.CreepingFrostRoyale: Fire an icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.
gem_descriptions.Cremation: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.
gem_descriptions.CremationAltX: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area and detonate nearby corpses for a duration. Corpse explosions are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.
gem_descriptions.CremationAltY: Creates a volcanic geyser at a location, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration.
gem_descriptions.CremationRoyale: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.
gem_descriptions.CrushingFist: Retaliate against a blocked hit by calling forth a huge armoured fist to slam into the ground in front of you as you do the same, dealing weapon damage in an area.
gem_descriptions.Cyclone: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.
gem_descriptions.CycloneAltX: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.
gem_descriptions.CycloneRoyale: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.
gem_descriptions.DamageInfusion: Moves damage from nearby enemies to the target enemy. They are healed for the amount of damage moved.
gem_descriptions.DarkPact: This spell removes some life from one of your Skeleton minions near you or the targeted location to deal chaos damage in an area around it. This effect will chain to your other nearby skeletons. If you have no skeletons near you or the targeted location, it will sacrifice your own life to deal damage instead.
