gem_descriptions.DarkPactAltX: This spell deals chaos damage in an area around you. Casting this spell will cause you to gain Ruin. If this spell inflicts your seventh Ruin, it will sacrifice a large portion of your life to deal extra chaos damage based on the amount sacrificed, and remove all Ruin from you.
gem_descriptions.DarkPactRoyale: This spell removes some life from one of your Skeleton minions near you or the targeted location to deal chaos damage in an area around it. This effect will chain to your other nearby skeletons. If you have no skeletons near you or the targeted location, it will sacrifice your own life to deal damage instead.
gem_descriptions.DarktongueKiss: Apply a debuff to Enemies which deals Chaos Damage over Time.
gem_descriptions.Dash: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
gem_descriptions.DashArborix: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
gem_descriptions.DashRoyale: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
gem_descriptions.DeathAura: Casts an aura that deals Chaos Damage over Time to nearby Enemies. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.
gem_descriptions.DeathWalk: While you walk, this skill causes corpses near your steps to explode, dealing fire damage in an area. The explosions of the corpses are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.
gem_descriptions.DeathWish: As you channel this spell, it spreads its effect to more of your minions. When you stop channelling, each affected minion explodes, and this skill deals spell damage around them.  The explosion of the minion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.
gem_descriptions.DecoyTotem: Summons a totem that taunts nearby monsters to attack it.
gem_descriptions.DefianceBanner: You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active.
gem_descriptions.Desecrate: Desecrates the ground, spawning corpses based on monsters in the current area and dealing chaos damage over time to enemies. If you are using the Raise Spectre skill there is a chance to spawn spectral corpses matching your most recently raised Spectres. Spectral corpses cannot be interacted with except by Minion skills.
gem_descriptions.DesecrateRoyale: Desecrates the ground, spawning corpses based on monsters in the current area and dealing chaos damage over time to enemies. If you are using the Raise Spectre skill there is a chance to spawn spectral corpses matching your most recently raised Spectres. Spectral corpses cannot be interacted with except by Minion skills.
gem_descriptions.Despair: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their chaos resistance.
gem_descriptions.DespairRoyale: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their chaos resistance.
gem_descriptions.DestructiveLink: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they use your main hand critical strike chance. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
gem_descriptions.Determination: Casts an aura that grants armour to you and your allies.
gem_descriptions.DetonateDead: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected.
gem_descriptions.DetonateDeadAltX: Targets a corpse, causing it to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. Cannot target corpses that have been created by skills.
gem_descriptions.DetonateDeadAltY: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. This will continue to target other corpses in the area, with a shorter delay between each one, until it runs out of corpses or has destroyed 8 corpses. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.
gem_descriptions.DetonateDeadRoyale: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected.
gem_descriptions.DevouringTotem: Summons a totem that can consume nearby corpses. If you are hurt, it will destroy a corpse to leech life to you.
gem_descriptions.Discharge: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.
gem_descriptions.DischargeAltX: Discharge all the character's charges to deal elemental damage to all nearby monsters.
gem_descriptions.Discipline: Casts an aura that grants additional energy shield and increased energy shield recharge rate to you and your allies.
gem_descriptions.DivineBlast: Project a beam of holy light from your shield to a targeted location, causing an implosion of holy energy. This energy then lingers for a short duration, before blasting outwards in a larger and more damaging explosion.
gem_descriptions.DivineBlastAltX: Project a beam of holy light from your shield to a targeted location, causing an implosion of holy energy. This energy then lingers for a short duration as an orb, periodically releasing larger explosions. Increases and reductions to attack speed affect the rate at which explosions occur.
gem_descriptions.DivineIre: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a burst around you and a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect the beam. Maximum of 10 Stages.
gem_descriptions.DivineIreAltX: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a powerful burst around you. Maximum of 10 Stages.
gem_descriptions.DivineIreAltY: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages. Release to unleash this energy in a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect this skill. Maximum of 10 Stages.
gem_descriptions.DivineIreRoyale: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a burst around you and a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect the beam. Maximum of 10 Stages.
gem_descriptions.DivineRetribution: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a surge of divine power, causing multiple waves of lightning bursts to expand outward from a targeted location. This skill cannot be Triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
gem_descriptions.DominatingBlow: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration.
gem_descriptions.DominatingBlowAltX: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration.
gem_descriptions.DominatingBlowRoyale: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration.
gem_descriptions.DoomBlast: Deals chaos damage in an area.
gem_descriptions.DoryanisTouch: The character uses their fist to slam the ground in front of them, with less attack speed, but more damage. This attack deals Lightning Damage to enemies in a large area, with a chance to Shock them. Cannot be used while wielding a Weapon. Cannot be Evaded.
gem_descriptions.DoubleStrike: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.
gem_descriptions.DoubleStrikeAltX: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon.
gem_descriptions.DoubleStrikeAltY: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon, gaining stages which cause this skill to attack faster. All stages are lost when you move.
gem_descriptions.DreadBanner: You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active.
gem_descriptions.DualStrike: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Dual wield only. Does not work with wands.
gem_descriptions.DualStrikeAltX: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Requires dual-wielding two different melee weapon types to use.
gem_descriptions.DualStrikeRoyale: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Dual wield only. Does not work with wands.
gem_descriptions.Earthquake: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.EarthquakeAltX: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.EarthquakeRoyale: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.Earthshatter: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near any spike will cause them to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.EarthshatterAltX: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. The spikes shatter after a duration, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.EarthshatterAltY: Slam the ground, sending out a rectangular fissure that deals area damage to enemies and thrusts a large spike from the ground where it ends. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.ElementalAegis: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes elemental damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking elemental damage from hits, or if depleted.
gem_descriptions.ElementalHit: Each attack with a melee weapon will choose an element at random, and will only be able to deal damage of that element. If the attack hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them, with the radius being larger if that enemy is suffering from an ailment of the chosen element. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.
gem_descriptions.ElementalHitAltX: Fires a projectile with a wand or bow that deals fire, cold and lightning damage. If the projectile hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them.
gem_descriptions.ElementalHitRoyale: Each attack with a melee weapon will choose an element at random, and will only be able to deal damage of that element. If the attack hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them, with the radius being larger if that enemy is suffering from an ailment of the chosen element. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.
gem_descriptions.ElementalProjectiles: Fires a burst of three piercing projectiles in an arc in front of you.
gem_descriptions.ElementalWarding: Fires projectiles in all directions, converting all their physical damage to a random element, and grants a buff which makes you unaffected by curses for a duration. Removes curses on you when used.
gem_descriptions.ElementalWeakness: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their elemental resistances.
gem_descriptions.ElementalWeaknessRoyale: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their elemental resistances.
gem_descriptions.EmbraceMadness: Grants Glorious Madness. Using this skill again will remove Glorious Madness and the Touched Debuffs it inflicts, but you will be unable to Embrace Madness again until the cooldown expires.

gem_descriptions.EnchantmentOfWarOnKill2: This attack is performed repeatedly by a ghostly imitation of your weapon.
gem_descriptions.EnchantmentOfWarOnKill3: This attack is performed repeatedly by a ghostly imitation of your weapon.
gem_descriptions.EnchantmentOfWarOnKill4: This attack is performed repeatedly by a ghostly imitation of your weapon.

Unleashes an icy projectile that pulses with cold as it travels.

gem_descriptions.EnduringCry: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and granting a buff to the user and nearby allies. The user and allied players also gain endurance charges.
gem_descriptions.EnduringCryRoyale: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and granting a buff to the user and nearby allies. The user and allied players also gain endurance charges.
gem_descriptions.EnergyBlade: Grants a buff which significantly lowers your maximum Energy Shield to transform your equipped swords into swords formed from that energy. Casting the spell again removes the buff. This skill cannot be triggered or used with non-sword weapons.
gem_descriptions.Enfeeble: Curses all targets in an area, reducing their accuracy and making them deal less damage.
gem_descriptions.EnsnaringArrow: Fires an arrow that remains in the ground behind its final target, tethering that enemy to it. Ensnared enemies have less movement speed while trying to break the snare. The snare will break if they leave the area of effect.
gem_descriptions.EnsnaringArrowRoyale: Fires an arrow that remains in the ground behind its final target, tethering that enemy to it. Ensnared enemies have less movement speed while trying to break the snare. The snare will break if they leave the area of effect.
gem_descriptions.Envy: Casts an aura that adds chaos damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.
gem_descriptions.EssenceDrain: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.
gem_descriptions.EssenceDrainAltX: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You lose Life and Energy Shield equal to a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.
gem_descriptions.EssenceDrainAltY: Fires a piercing projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage.
gem_descriptions.EssenceDrainRoyale: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.
gem_descriptions.EtherealKnives: Fires an arc of knives outwards in front of the caster which deal physical damage.
gem_descriptions.EtherealKnivesAltX:
Fires an arc of knives down into the ground in front of the caster which deal physical damage.
Cannot be supported by Volley.
gem_descriptions.EtherealKnivesAltY: Fires a circle of knives outwards around the caster which deal physical damage.
gem_descriptions.EtherealKnivesRoyale: Fires an arc of knives outwards in front of the caster which deal physical damage.
gem_descriptions.Eviscerate: Retaliate against a blocked hit with an arcing slash that releases two waves of force. Enemies close in front of you can be hit by both waves. Requires a Sword or Axe and a Shield.
gem_descriptions.ExplosiveArrow: Fires an arrow which will stick into an enemy or wall, and then explode, dealing area damage around it, either after a duration or when the maximum number of arrows stuck to that target is reached. If an enemy has multiple Explosive Arrows stuck in them, the first one to explode will consume the others, adding their damage to its explosion.
gem_descriptions.ExplosiveArrowRoyale: Fires an arrow which will stick into an enemy or wall, and then explode, dealing area damage around it, either after a duration or when the maximum number of arrows stuck to that target is reached. If an enemy has multiple Explosive Arrows stuck in them, the first one to explode will consume the others, adding their damage to its explosion.
gem_descriptions.ExplosiveConcoction: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.
gem_descriptions.ExplosiveConcoctionAltX: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.
gem_descriptions.ExplosiveTrap: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first.
gem_descriptions.ExplosiveTrapAltX: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first.
gem_descriptions.ExplosiveTrapAltY: Throws a trap that creates a large explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it.
gem_descriptions.Exsanguinate: Releases several tendrils of blood from your character, targeting enemies in a narrow angle in front of you. The beams deal physical damage and inflict a physical damage over time debuff to enemies, which can stack up to 3 times. Effects which allow skills to chain can apply to these tendrils.
gem_descriptions.ExsanguinateAltX: Releases a tendril of blood from your character, which will target an enemy in front of you, then chain to other enemies. The tendril deals physical damage and inflicts a physical damage over time debuff to enemies, which can stack up to 3 times.
gem_descriptions.EyeOfWinter: Fires a single eye projectile which constantly releases shard projectiles in a spiral. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a faster spiral of extra shards.
gem_descriptions.EyeOfWinterAltX: Fires a single eye projectile which cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a fast spiral of shards. The shards will deal cold damage to enemies they impact.
gem_descriptions.EyeOfWinterAltY: Fires a single eye projectile which releases a number shard projectiles in a spiral before dissipating. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies.
gem_descriptions.FeastOfFlesh: Consume a number of corpses around you to recover life, mana and energy shield.
gem_descriptions.FieryImpactHeistMaceImp: Deals attack damage in an area.
gem_descriptions.FireAegis: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes fire damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking fire damage from hits, or if depleted.
gem_descriptions.FireBurstOnHit: A burst of flame errupts from the location of a hit, dealing fire damage.
gem_descriptions.FireTrap: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies and leaving an area of burning ground that damages enemies who walk through it.
gem_descriptions.FireTrapAltX: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.
gem_descriptions.FireTrapRoyale: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies and leaving an area of burning ground that damages enemies who walk through it.
gem_descriptions.FireWeapon: Infuse the player's current weapon with additional fire damage for a short time.
gem_descriptions.Fireball: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.
gem_descriptions.FireballRoyale: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.
gem_descriptions.Firestorm: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
gem_descriptions.FirestormAltX: A large flaming bolt falls towards the targeted area. The bolt explodes when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
gem_descriptions.FirestormAltY: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
gem_descriptions.FirestormRoyale: Flaming bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
gem_descriptions.FlameDash: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
gem_descriptions.FlameDashAltY: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground, then repeat the teleport in the other direction. Cannot be triggered, or used by a totem, trap or mine. Cannot be supported by Unleash.
gem_descriptions.FlameDashRoyale: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
gem_descriptions.FlameLink: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they deal additional fire damage based on your life. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
gem_descriptions.FlameSurge: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. Burning enemies are dealt more damage. If you hit an ignited enemy, will create burning ground under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.
gem_descriptions.FlameSurgeAltX: Strikes enemies in front of you with a surge of flame. If this ignites an enemy a large area of burning ground will be created under them. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this burning ground.
gem_descriptions.FlameWall: Create a wall of fire for a duration, which deals burning damage to everything in its area. Each enemy that enters the wall also receives a secondary burning debuff which persists for a short duration after leaving the wall. Any projectiles fired through the wall by you and allies deal added fire damage and apply the wall's secondary debuff on hit.
gem_descriptions.Flameblast: Channels to build up a large explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion.
gem_descriptions.FlameblastAltX: Channels to build up an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill or automatically at maximum stages. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion.
gem_descriptions.FlameblastAltY: Channels to concentrate an explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the damage of the explosion, but the smaller the area.
gem_descriptions.FlamethrowerTrap: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration, rotating around the trap and repeatedly dealing damage. Burning enemies are dealt more damage.
gem_descriptions.FlamethrowerTrapAltX: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration repeatedly dealing damage.
gem_descriptions.FlamethrowerTrapRoyale: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration, rotating around the trap and repeatedly dealing damage. Burning enemies are dealt more damage.
gem_descriptions.Flammability: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their fire resistance and giving them a chance to be ignited when hit.
gem_descriptions.FleshAndStone: Buffs you, and affects nearby enemies with an aura, differently depending on your stance. Both stances are more impactful against enemies closer to you. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.
gem_descriptions.FleshOffering: Consumes a corpse, which temporarily empowers your minions with swiftness. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.
gem_descriptions.FleshOfferingTriggeredU: Consumes a corpse, which temporarily empowers your minions with swiftness. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.
gem_descriptions.FlickerStrike: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.
gem_descriptions.FlickerStrikeAltX: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.
gem_descriptions.FogOfWar: Creates a Smoke Cloud in an area, which blinds enemies within it.
gem_descriptions.ForbiddenRite: Lobs an exploding projectile near the targeted location, and extra projectiles toward enemies around you. The projectiles deal chaos damage based on your life and energy shield. Casting this spell damages you.
gem_descriptions.ForbiddenRiteAltX: Lobs an exploding projectile near the targeted location, and extra projectiles toward enemies around you. The projectiles deal chaos damage based on your energy shield. Casting this spell damages you.
gem_descriptions.FreezingPulse: An icy projectile which has a chance to freeze enemies it passes through. The projectile fades quickly, reducing damage and freezing chance until it dissipates.
gem_descriptions.FreezingPulseRoyale: An icy projectile which has a chance to freeze enemies it passes through. The projectile fades quickly, reducing damage and freezing chance until it dissipates.
gem_descriptions.Frenzy: Performs an attack with a ranged weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed.
gem_descriptions.FrenzyAltX: Perform a strike with a melee weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed.
gem_descriptions.FrostBlades: Attack enemies with increased range, releasing icy blades from the first enemy hit which fly at other enemies. Requires a Melee Weapon.
gem_descriptions.FrostBladesAltX: Attack enemies with greatly increased range, creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time if it hits. Requires a Melee Weapon.
gem_descriptions.FrostBladesRoyale: Attack enemies with increased range, releasing icy blades from the first enemy hit which fly at other enemies. Requires a Melee Weapon.
gem_descriptions.FrostBolt: Fires a slow-moving projectile that pierces through enemies, dealing cold damage.
gem_descriptions.FrostBoltRoyale: Fires a slow-moving projectile that pierces through enemies, dealing cold damage.
gem_descriptions.FrostBomb: Creates a crystal that pulses with cold for a duration. Each pulse applies a debuff to nearby enemies for a secondary duration which reduces life regeneration rate, and also inflicts Cold Exposure. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.
gem_descriptions.FrostBombAltX: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing cold damage to enemies around it.
gem_descriptions.FrostBombAltY: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.
gem_descriptions.FrostBombRoyale: Creates a crystal that pulses with cold for a duration. Each pulse applies a debuff to nearby enemies for a secondary duration which reduces life regeneration rate, and also inflicts Cold Exposure. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.
gem_descriptions.FrostShield: Place a Frost Shield that drains your energy shield for one second or until you run out, gaining stages while this drain occurs. The Frost Shield takes some damage from hits in place of you and allies while in its area. Enemies in the area are Chilled. You can only have one Frost Shield active at once.
gem_descriptions.FrostWall: Creates a wall of ice which holds back enemies. Targets under the wall are damaged and pushed back.
gem_descriptions.FrostWallAltX: Creates a wall of ice which holds back enemies. Targets under the wall are damaged and pushed back, with more damage dealt the more frost walls are currently active.
gem_descriptions.Frostbite: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their cold resistance and giving them a chance to be frozen when hit.
gem_descriptions.Frostblink: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving Chilled ground in an area at both ends of the teleport. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
gem_descriptions.FrostblinkAltX: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies in an area at both ends of the teleport. Deals higher damage to chilled enemies, then removes chill from them. Cannot be supported by Unleash.
gem_descriptions.FrostblinkRoyale: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving Chilled ground in an area at both ends of the teleport. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.
gem_descriptions.FrozenLegion: This spell consumes multiple cooldown uses to summon icy Statues in a ring. Each Statue uses your Frozen Sweep attack once before vanishing. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, or Staff. This skill cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
gem_descriptions.FrozenLegionAltX: This spell consumes multiple cooldown uses to summon icy Statues in a ring. Each Statue uses your Frozen Sweep attack once before vanishing. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, or Staff. This skill cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
gem_descriptions.FrozenSweep: This attack is used by your Statues to deal damage in an area around them while stepping forward. This skill cannot repeat and can only be used by Statues from Frozen Legion.
gem_descriptions.FrozenSweepAltX: This attack is used by your Statues to deal damage in an area around them while stepping forward. This skill cannot repeat and can only be used by Statues from Frozen Legion.
gem_descriptions.GalvanicArrow: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. The arrows are fired with such force that they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.
gem_descriptions.GalvanicArrowAltX: Create a burst of lightning from your Bow, firing no arrows but damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.
gem_descriptions.GalvanicArrowAltY: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. If the arrows' flight is stopped by colliding with a target, they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone behind the target
gem_descriptions.GalvanicArrowRoyale: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. The arrows are fired with such force that they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.
gem_descriptions.GalvanicField: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning. The strength of the field depends on the magnitude of shock affecting the enemy when it is created.
gem_descriptions.GalvanicFieldAltX: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning.
gem_descriptions.GemDetonateMines: Detonates a Mine, starting a Detonation Sequence which will detonate other Mines around it.
gem_descriptions.GeneralsCry: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user, and summoning Mirage Warriors from nearby corpses. The Mirage Warriors each use a linked attack skill once before dissipating.
gem_descriptions.GeneralsCryRoyale: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user, and summoning Mirage Warriors from nearby corpses. The Mirage Warriors each use a linked attack skill once before dissipating.
gem_descriptions.GhostCannons: Manifest a row of Ghostly Cannons, each of which then fires after a short delay dealing the damage of the weapon that triggered it. For each additional projectile this skill would fire, create an additional Ghostly Cannon instead.
gem_descriptions.GlacialCascade: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area and knocking them back in the direction of the next burst.
gem_descriptions.GlacialCascadeAltX: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area.
gem_descriptions.GlacialCascadeRoyale: Icicles emerge from the ground in a series of small bursts, each damaging enemies caught in the area and knocking them back in the direction of the next burst.
gem_descriptions.GlacialHammer: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If a non-unique enemy is frozen and is on less than one third life, they will shatter when hit by Glacial Hammer. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will freeze enemies more easily. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
gem_descriptions.GlacialHammerAltX: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will be a critical strike. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
gem_descriptions.GlacialHammerRoyale: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If a non-unique enemy is frozen and is on less than one third life, they will shatter when hit by Glacial Hammer. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will freeze enemies more easily. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
gem_descriptions.GlacialShieldSwipe: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of ice in a cone in front of you.
gem_descriptions.GlimpseOfEternity: Creates an Eternity Sphere at your location, which reduces the Action Speed of enemies within it. The amount of Action Speed reduction applied by the sphere decreases to zero over its duration.
gem_descriptions.GluttonyOfElements: Casts an aura that causes taking elemental damage to heal you and nearby allies instead.
gem_descriptions.GoreShockwave: Deals attack damage in an area.
gem_descriptions.Grace: Casts an aura that grants evasion to you and your allies.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillEshJoltBuff: On Critically Striking an Enemy, this Graft will apply a stack of Jolt to you. Jolt grants more maximum Attack Damage at the cost of taking increased Damage, and can stack up to 10 times.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillEshLightningC: While Enemies are nearby, this Graft will periodically bring Lightning-Imbued Clones of you into being. These Clones will move towards the nearest Enemy, detonating and leaving behind shocked ground.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillEshLightningH: When commanded, this Graft will summon forth a field of grasping hands, each of which clutches an enervating orb of Lightning. When an Enemy is near a hand, the orb it clutches will detonate to deal Lightning Damage and Sap on Hit.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillEshLightningR: When commanded, this Graft will call down a ring of lightning bolts, dealing lightning damage and leaving behind Radiant ground.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillTulAegis: When you apply exposure to an enemy, this Graft will apply a buff which takes elemental damage from hits for you while active.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillTulIceMortar: While equipped, this Graft will periodically fling icy mortars at Enemies in range that are Chilled or Frozen.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillTulSummon: When you use an Offering skill, this Graft will summon an army of Hiveborn Breach Monsters to do your bidding. These summoned monsters have their Physical Damage converted to Cold, and have a chance to apply Brittle on Hit.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillTulTornado: When commanded, this Graft will call forth a devastating tornado which rapidly deals cold damage to Enemies within it. When you Critically Strike with an Attack while the Tornado is active, it will fire off a nova of icicle projectiles.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillTulTornadoPro: Fires a nova of projectiles which deal cold damage.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillUulNetolBoneS: When you use a Warcry, this Graft will cause spires of bone to erupt from the earth around you. When you use an Exerted Attack, these spires will explode to deal damage in an area around them, inflicting Bleeding and Impaling Enemies.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillUulNetolHandS: This Graft will periodically target Rare or Unique Enemies in range, calling forth massive hands which slam down dealing high damage and stunning.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillUulNetolImpal: While you have Rage, this Graft will periodically apply a buff to you which grants a chance to inflict an additional Impale and increased effect of Impales you inflict.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillUulNetolLowli: While you are on Low Life, this Graft will periodically apply a buff to you which grants life recovery rate, as well as an Endurance Charge.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillXophAilmentBu: While afflicted with an Elemental Ailment while this Graft is equipped, it will remove all Elemental Ailments from you and grant you Physical Damage gained as Extra of the Elemental Damage Types that match the removed Ailments.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillXophFlamePill: When you Attack with this Graft equipped, it will call forth pillars of ashen flame. These pillars deal Fire damage in an area, and cover Enemies they hit in Ash.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillXophGeyserExp: When commanded, this Graft will cause a cataclysmic eruption that leaves multiple geysers of flame in its wake. These geysers will regularly fire off fiery mortars, firing more in a burst whenever you use a warcry. Triggering warcries will not cause these bursts of mortars.
gem_descriptions.GraftSkillXophMoltenShe: When you are missing Life, this Graft will apply a Buff that takes some Damage from Hits for you before being depleted. When you are struck while the Buff is active, this skill will fire a nova of fiery projectiles which explode on impact.
gem_descriptions.GravitySphereTriggered: Creates a Gravity Sphere which Hinders enemies in an area around it, with the debuff being stronger on enemies closer to the sphere. The Gravity Sphere will consume the corpses of any enemies which die in its area. Can only have one Gravity Sphere at a time.
gem_descriptions.GroundSlam: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.GroundSlamAltX: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wide wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. Requires a Two Handed Axe, Two Handed Mace, or Staff.
gem_descriptions.GroundSlamRoyale: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.Haste: Casts an aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies.
gem_descriptions.Hatred: Casts an aura that grants extra cold damage based on physical damage to you and your allies.
gem_descriptions.HeavyStrike: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Sword or Staff.
gem_descriptions.HeavyStrikeAltY: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Staff.
gem_descriptions.HeavyStrikeRoyale: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Sword or Staff.
gem_descriptions.HeraldOfAgony: Grants a buff giving more poison damage and a chance to inflict poison. When you poison an enemy while you have this buff, you gain Virulence, and summon an Agony Crawler minion that uses projectile and area attacks. You will lose Virulence over time, at a rate which increases the more Virulence you have. The minion will die when you have no Virulence.
gem_descriptions.HeraldOfAsh: Grants a buff providing fire damage based on your physical damage. While you have this buff, if you kill an enemy, other enemies near them will be burned based on the overkill damage. The burn inflicted by this skill can only be affected by modifiers to damage over time (burning damage is damage over time).
gem_descriptions.HeraldOfIce: Grants a buff adding cold damage to spells and attacks. If you shatter an enemy, this skill will cause them to explode and deal AoE cold damage to enemies near them. This damage is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.
gem_descriptions.HeraldOfPurity: Grants a buff which lets you deal more physical damage. When you kill an enemy while you have this buff, this skill will summon a Sentinel of Purity, or refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them. The Sentinels of Purity have a single-target melee attack and an area melee attack.
gem_descriptions.HeraldOfTheBreach: Grants a buff which causes you to deal more damage for each Herald skill affecting you. While you have this buff, this skill turns the space around you into a tear in reality, releasing pulses that damage enemies around you. Inflicting Ailments causes you to gain Otherworldly Pressure, which increases the frequency of the pulses. You will lose Otherworldly Pressure over time, at a rate which increases the more of it you have. The damage inflicted by this skill is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.
gem_descriptions.HeraldOfThunder: Grants a buff which adds lightning damage to spells and attacks. If you kill a shocked enemy, this skill will create a storm, causing lightning bolts to strike enemies around you for a duration. The damage inflicted by this skill is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.
gem_descriptions.Hexblast: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy, dealing more damage if they are Hexed, then removing the Hex. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target, boosting damage and removing Hexes from those enemies in the same way.
gem_descriptions.HexblastAltX: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy, dealing more damage if they are Hexed, then removing the Hex. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target, boosting damage and removing Hexes from those enemies in the same way.
gem_descriptions.HexblastAltY: Deals chaos damage to a single enemy. If the enemy was Hexed, also deals area damage to other enemies around the target.
gem_descriptions.HolyFlameTotem: Summons a totem that channels to fire a stream of flame at nearby enemies, and creates an area of consecrated ground around the totem.
gem_descriptions.HolyFlameTotemAltX: Summons a totem that channels to fire a stream of flame at nearby enemies, and creates an area of consecrated ground around the totem.
gem_descriptions.HolyFlameTotemRoyale: Summons a totem that channels to fire a stream of flame at nearby enemies, and creates an area of consecrated ground around the totem.
gem_descriptions.HolyHammers: Slam the ground, calling down a Holy Hammer from above. On hitting an enemy, another Hammer will cascade forward, repeating if further enemies are hit, up to a cap. A Power Charge can be expended to call down additional Hammers to either side of the initial slam. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
gem_descriptions.HolyHammersAltX: Slam the ground, consuming all Power Charges and calling down a cascade of holy hammers from above in an outward spiral. Further hammers are called down for each Power Charge consumed. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
gem_descriptions.HolyStrike: Infuse your weapon with holy energy and swing. Successfully hitting an enemy will summon forth a copy of your Main Hand weapon as a Holy Armament. These Holy Armaments are undamageable minions, and will attack the enemies you target with Holy Strike. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.
gem_descriptions.Hydrosphere: Create a sphere of water, or move an existing sphere and reset its duration. The sphere continually applies a drenched debuff with a short duration to enemies in its area or those it moves through. You can hit the sphere with other skills to inflict Cold and Lightning Ailments (other than Chill). The sphere pulses when created, at regular intervals while afflicted by an Ailment, and after moving, damaging all drenched enemies in a large area.
gem_descriptions.HydrosphereRoyale: Create a sphere of water, or move an existing sphere and reset its duration. The sphere continually applies a drenched debuff with a short duration to enemies in its area or those it moves through. You can hit the sphere with other skills to inflict Cold and Lightning Ailments (other than Chill). The sphere pulses when created, at regular intervals while afflicted by an Ailment, and after moving, damaging all drenched enemies in a large area.
gem_descriptions.HydrosphereTriggered: Create a sphere of water, or move an existing sphere and reset its duration. The sphere continually applies a drenched debuff with a short duration to enemies in its area or those it moves through. You can hit the sphere with other skills to inflict Cold and Lightning Ailments (other than Chill). The sphere pulses when created, at regular intervals while afflicted by an Ailment, and after moving, damaging all drenched enemies in a large area.
gem_descriptions.IceCrash: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area around the impact in three stages of increasing size. Enemies take slightly less damage on the second and third stage, and can only be hit by one stage. Works with Swords, Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.IceCrashAltX: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area. Slams with main hand weapon deal more damage. Slams with off hand weapon have larger area of effect. Requires dual-wielding Swords, Maces, Sceptres, or Axes to use.
gem_descriptions.IceCrashRoyale: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area around the impact in three stages of increasing size. Enemies take slightly less damage on the second and third stage, and can only be hit by one stage. Works with Swords, Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.IceNova: A circle of ice expands from the caster.
gem_descriptions.IceNovaAltX: A circle of ice expands from the caster. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will expand from a number of those projectiles instead. If this skill would repeat when cast this way, it will instead expand again from the same projectiles after a short delay.
gem_descriptions.IceNovaAltY: A circle of ice expands from the caster.
gem_descriptions.IceNovaRoyale: A circle of ice expands from the caster.
gem_descriptions.IceNovaTriggered: A chilling circle of ice expands from the caster. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will expand from a number of those projectiles instead. If this skill would repeat when cast this way, it will instead expand again from the same projectiles after a short delay.
gem_descriptions.IceShot: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target.
gem_descriptions.IceShotAltX: Fires a piercing arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in two cones perpendicular to the target.
gem_descriptions.IceShotRoyale: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target.
gem_descriptions.IceSpear: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.
gem_descriptions.IceSpearAltX: Launches a shard of ice that splits on hitting terrain or enemies. After splitting, the projectiles are in second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.
gem_descriptions.IceSpearRoyale: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.
gem_descriptions.IceTrap: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.
gem_descriptions.IceTrapAltX: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions in a circle around itself when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.
gem_descriptions.IceTrapRoyale: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.
gem_descriptions.Icestorm: Icy bolts rain down over the targeted area. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies and chilling them, as well as causing patches of chilled ground. Skill damage is based on Intelligence.
gem_descriptions.IcicleBurst: This attack fires icy projectiles in a circle around enemies you hit, dealing attack damage with all physical damage converted to cold.
gem_descriptions.IcicleMine: Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.
gem_descriptions.IcicleMineAltX: Throws a mine that fires projectiles at enemies when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.
gem_descriptions.IcicleMineAltY: Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.
gem_descriptions.Ignite: Sets an enemy on fire from a distance.
gem_descriptions.IgnitionBlast: The slain enemy's corpse explodes, dealing a percentage of their Maximum Life as Fire Damage to nearby enemies.
gem_descriptions.IllusoryWarp: Teleport to a target destination. Chilled ground is spread in an area around both where the caster was and where they teleported to.
gem_descriptions.ImmortalCall: Take less Physical and Elemental Damage for a short time. Consumes up to 5 Endurance Charges to lengthen the buff and further lessen Physical Damage taken. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
gem_descriptions.Incinerate: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. When you stop channelling you release a wave of fire damage over a wide and long area that will apply a powerful Ignite.
gem_descriptions.IncinerateAltX: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. When you stop channelling you release a slow-moving wave of fire damage over a very large area that will apply a powerful Ignite.
gem_descriptions.IncinerateAltY: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you.
gem_descriptions.IncinerateRoyale: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. When you stop channelling you release a wave of fire damage over a wide and long area that will apply a powerful Ignite.
gem_descriptions.InfernalBlow: Attacks with your weapon, applying a charged debuff to enemies hit by your strike, and an uncharged debuff to any other enemies hit. Upon reaching 6 charges, expiring, or the enemy's death, the charged debuff is removed to damage that and other surrounding enemies. Enemies with either debuff explode when they die, damaging other surrounding enemies. Damage from this explosion cannot be reflected. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.InfernalBlowAltX: Attacks with your weapon, applying a charged debuff to you the first time you hit an enemy with this skill. Upon reaching 6 charges, or charges expiring, the charged debuff is removed to damage nearby enemies. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.InfernalBlowRoyale: Attacks with your weapon, applying a charged debuff to enemies hit by your strike, and an uncharged debuff to any other enemies hit. Upon reaching 6 charges, expiring, or the enemy's death, the charged debuff is removed to damage that and other surrounding enemies. Enemies with either debuff explode when they die, damaging other surrounding enemies. Damage from this explosion cannot be reflected. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.InfernalCry: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants a portion of their physical damage as extra fire damage. In addition to being taunted, enemies are inflicted with a secondary debuff causing them to explode when they die, dealing fire damage in an area.
gem_descriptions.InfernalSwarm: Fire damages and ignites those around a targeted enemy. This effect chains and repeats on other enemy targets.
gem_descriptions.IntimidatingCry: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants movement speed.
gem_descriptions.IntimidayingCryTriggere: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants movement speed.
gem_descriptions.IntuitiveLink: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, their hits can trigger your supported spells. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
gem_descriptions.JunTriggeredBloodRage: Adds a buff that deals Physical Damage over time, while increasing Attack Speed and Life Leech. Killing an enemy while this buff is active refreshes the buff duration, and can grant a Frenzy Charge.
gem_descriptions.KineticBlast: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of area explosions in a secondary radius around its point of impact, each damaging enemies.
gem_descriptions.KineticBlastAltX: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of area explosions in a secondary radius around its point of impact, each damaging enemies.
gem_descriptions.KineticBolt: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from.
gem_descriptions.KineticBoltAltX: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from. Multiple of these projectiles can hit the same target.
gem_descriptions.KineticFusillade: Wave your wand to create a hovering kinetic projectile. After a short duration, the projectile is fired at an enemy, dealing area damage on impact and chaining to further targets. Using this attack again will reset the duration for all hovering projectiles. Multiple projectiles fired in sequence will attempt to target different enemies. Cannot be directly used by traps or mines.
gem_descriptions.KineticFusilladeAltX: Wave your wand to create multiple hovering kinetic projectiles. After a short duration, the projectiles explode, dealing area damage. Using this attack again will reset the duration for all hovering projectiles. Cannot be directly used by traps or mines.
gem_descriptions.KineticRain: Swing your wand to cause a number of projectiles to rain down within a large area in front of you, directly targeting the locations of enemies in the area. The locations where each projectile will land are shown with markers before they fall. Each projectile explodes when hitting the ground, dealing area damage and triggering Kinetic Anomaly. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
gem_descriptions.KineticRainAltX: Swing your wand to cause a number of projectiles to rain down within a large area in front of you, directly targeting the locations of enemies in the area. The locations where each projectile will land are shown with markers before they fall. Each projectile explodes when hitting the ground, dealing area damage.
gem_descriptions.KineticRainKineticInsta: Gathers kinetic energy into an anomaly at the targeted location, which will explode when enemies are near it, dealing your wand's damage in an area. The anomaly will dissipate after a duration.
gem_descriptions.Lacerate: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. The slashes will have a chance to inflict bleeding in Blood Stance, or have a wider angle in Sand Stance. Can be used with Axes and Swords. You are in Blood Stance by default.
gem_descriptions.LacerateAltX: Slashes twice, releasing wide waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a Two Handed Axe or Two Handed Sword.
gem_descriptions.LacerateAltY: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a One Handed Axe or One Handed Sword.
gem_descriptions.LacerateRoyale: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. The slashes will have a chance to inflict bleeding in Blood Stance, or have a wider angle in Sand Stance. Can be used with Axes and Swords. You are in Blood Stance by default.
gem_descriptions.LancingSteel: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward, consuming your Steel Shards to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.
gem_descriptions.LancingSteelAltX: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it.
gem_descriptions.LeapSlam: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
gem_descriptions.LeapSlamAltX: Jump a short distance through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
gem_descriptions.LeapSlamRoyale: Jump through the air, damaging and knocking back enemies with your weapon where you land. Enemies you would land on are pushed out of the way. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Staff.
gem_descriptions.LightningAegis: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes lightning damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking lightning damage from hits, or if depleted.
gem_descriptions.LightningArrow: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning, which also damages a number of surrounding enemies.
gem_descriptions.LightningArrowAltX: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning. It sticks into the final target, causing them to be struck and damaged multiple times.
gem_descriptions.LightningArrowRoyale: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning, which also damages a number of surrounding enemies.
gem_descriptions.LightningBolt: A bolt of lightning strikes an area, dealing lightning damage.
gem_descriptions.LightningBoltOnHit: A bolt of lightning strikes an area, dealing lightning damage.
gem_descriptions.LightningConduit: Lightning strikes all Shocked enemies around a targeted location, then removes Shock from those enemies. Shocks cannot expire on enemies in range while casting this spell. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade or Unleash.
gem_descriptions.LightningConduitAltX: Lightning strikes a number of enemies around a targeted location. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.
gem_descriptions.LightningSpireTrap: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.
gem_descriptions.LightningSpireTrapAltX: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.
gem_descriptions.LightningSpireTrapAltY: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.
gem_descriptions.LightningSpireTrapRoyal: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.
gem_descriptions.LightningStrike: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy is released from the weapon as projectiles as you strike, flying out to hit farther-away enemies. The projectiles cannot miss if the melee attack hit a target.
gem_descriptions.LightningStrikeAltX: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy is released from the weapon as a projectile as you strike, flying out to hit farther-away enemies and chain between them. The projectile cannot miss if the melee attack hit a target.
gem_descriptions.LightningTendrils: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a semicircular area in front of you.
gem_descriptions.LightningTendrilsAltX: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a semicircular area in front of you.
gem_descriptions.LightningTendrilsAltY: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a growing semicircular area in front of you.
gem_descriptions.LightningTendrilsRoyale: While you channel this skill, it releases pulses of electrical energy, dealing lightning damage in a semicircular area in front of you.
gem_descriptions.LightningTrap: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.
gem_descriptions.LightningTrapAltX: Throws a trap that launches projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.
gem_descriptions.LightningTrapRoyale: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.
gem_descriptions.LightningWarp: Waits for a duration before teleporting to a targeted destination, with the duration based on the distance and your movement speed. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the area around both where the player was and where they teleported to. Casting again will queue up multiple teleportations to occur in sequence.
gem_descriptions.LightningWarpRoyale: Waits for a duration before teleporting to a targeted destination, with the duration based on the distance and your movement speed. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the area around both where the player was and where they teleported to. Casting again will queue up multiple teleportations to occur in sequence.
gem_descriptions.Malevolence: Casts an aura that multiplies damage over time and increases skill effect duration of you and your allies.
gem_descriptions.ManaInfusedStaff: Infuses your staff with arcane energy, lowering your mana costs and increasing your chance to block. When you block, you release an arcane wave, damaging enemies in a ring-shaped area over a duration.
gem_descriptions.Manabond: Deals lightning damage based upon your missing mana in a circular area around the targeted location, as well as in four rectangular extensions whose lengths depend upon your remaining mana.
gem_descriptions.ManifestDancingDervishe: Manifests two Dancing Dervishes to fight by your side. While a Dancing Dervish is manifested, you have Onslaught and cannot use Weapons. Cannot be supported by supports that would create other minions.
gem_descriptions.MirrorArrow: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.
gem_descriptions.MirrorArrowAltX: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.
gem_descriptions.MirrorArrowAltY: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.
gem_descriptions.MirrorArrowTriggered: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.
gem_descriptions.MoltenShell: Applies a buff that adds to your armour, and can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. When the buff expires or is depleted, the skill deals reflected damage to enemies around you based on the total damage that was taken from the buff. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.
gem_descriptions.MoltenStrike: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land.
gem_descriptions.MoltenStrikeAltX: Infuses your two-handed melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land. Every fifth time you attack with this skill it fires more, high-damage projectiles.
gem_descriptions.MoltenStrikeRoyale: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land.
gem_descriptions.NewNewBladeVortex: This spell creates ethereal blades which orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius. As more blades are added, the damage becomes greater and more frequent.
gem_descriptions.NewPunishment: Curses all targets in an area, causing them to be debilitated when they hit enemies and increasing damage they take while on low life.
gem_descriptions.NewShockNova: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage.
gem_descriptions.OilArrow: UNUSED The environmentally unsustainable child of Explosive Arrow and Flame Wall
gem_descriptions.OrbOfStorms: Creates a stationary electrical orb that strikes enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning that can then split to hit more enemies. Modifiers to cast speed will increase how frequently it does this. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.
gem_descriptions.OrbOfStormsAltX: Creates an electrical orb that will strike enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning when placed, as well as when you use a lightning skill while within its area. These beams of lightning can then split to hit more enemies. When striking enemies, this orb will teleport to a random enemy struck. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.
gem_descriptions.Pacify: Curses all targets in an area, having no effect at first, but causing them to deal no damage once 60% of the curse's duration has expired.
gem_descriptions.PactOfBeidat: Cast a pact, Empowering non-channelling spells that either fire projectiles, apply an effect to an area around a targeted location or fire chaining beams, causing them to deal more damage and have enhanced coverage. However, using this skill also burdens you with an Affliction.
gem_descriptions.PactOfGhorr: Cast a pact, Empowering your damage over time spells but burdening you with an Affliction. This skill also grants the Hunger of Ghorr buff for a duration causing Fleshrend to trigger periodically.
gem_descriptions.PactOfKtash: Cast a pact, Empowering your damaging Vaal spells but burdening you with an Affliction. Empowered Vaal spells deal more damage, have less soul gain prevention duration and regain consumed souls on use.
gem_descriptions.PactOfLycia: Cast a pact, Empowering the next channelling spells you cast yourself but burdening you with an Affliction. Empowered spells deal more damage and periodically trigger lightning bolts while channelling.
gem_descriptions.PenanceBrand: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy. When the branded enemy reaches 20 energy, a large explosion occurs and the brand is removed. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.
gem_descriptions.PenanceBrandAltX: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and causing a pulse that deals damage to the branded enemy and other nearby enemies. The pulse gains area of effect and damage for each energy on the branded enemy, up to 20. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.
gem_descriptions.PenanceBrandAltY: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and nearby enemies who do not have energy. When the brand is detached, all enemies with energy are dealt damage.
gem_descriptions.PenanceMark: Curses a single enemy, causing them to spawn multiple phantasms when hit. The phantasms will be allies of the marked enemy with the same monster level. They cast a projectile spell which deals physical damage, and are immune to curses and knockback. You can only have one Mark at a time.
gem_descriptions.Perforate: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.
gem_descriptions.PerforateAltX: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.
gem_descriptions.PerforateAltY:
Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spikes from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times.
Requires a Sword or Axe.
gem_descriptions.PestilentStrike: Attacks with your weapon, inflicting a debuff on enemies hit by the strike. If a debuffed enemy dies while poisoned, Pestilent Strike inflicts a secondary chaos damage over time debuff on enemies around them, based on the poisons on the slain enemy. This damage is not affected by your damage modifiers. Requires a Claw or Dagger.
gem_descriptions.PetrifiedBlood: Applies a buff that protects the lower half of your life, preventing some of the immediate life loss when damaged by hits and applying the loss over time instead. Your life cannot be raised above low life other than by flasks, and while above low life, skills will cost life as well as mana.
gem_descriptions.PhaseRun: Gain a buff that makes you faster, harder to detect, and grants Phasing, letting you pass through enemies. Performing any skill replaces this buff with one that boosts melee physical damage of skills you use yourself (it will not apply to your melee skills used by totems). Consumes Frenzy Charges to increase duration.
gem_descriptions.PhaseRunRoyale: Gain a buff that makes you faster, harder to detect, and grants Phasing, letting you pass through enemies. Performing any skill replaces this buff with one that boosts melee physical damage of skills you use yourself (it will not apply to your melee skills used by totems). Consumes Frenzy Charges to increase duration.
gem_descriptions.PhysicalAegis: Calls forth a protective aegis which takes physical damage from hits for you until depleted. The aegis will be restored to its full value after a short delay if you stop taking physical damage from hits, or if depleted.
gem_descriptions.PlagueBearer: Gain an Incubating buff, adding to its Plague Value as you inflict poisons. Use the skill again to begin Infecting, dealing chaos damage over time to nearby enemies until the Plague Value is depleted. Your damage modifiers don't apply to this skill's damage. Using the skill again alternates between Incubating and Infecting.
gem_descriptions.PlayerMelee: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
gem_descriptions.PlaytestAttack: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow.
gem_descriptions.PlaytestSlam: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.
gem_descriptions.PlaytestSpell: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.
gem_descriptions.PoachersMark: Curses a single enemy, lowering their physical damage reduction, and adding physical damage to all hits against them. Attacking the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and killing them will grant a frenzy charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.
gem_descriptions.PoachersMarkRoyale: Curses a single enemy, lowering their physical damage reduction, and adding physical damage to all hits against them. Attacking the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and killing them will grant a frenzy charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.
gem_descriptions.PoachersMarkTriggered: Curses a single enemy, lowering their physical damage reduction, and adding physical damage to all hits against them. Attacking the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and killing them will grant a frenzy charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.
gem_descriptions.PoisonousConcoction: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area and has a chance to poison. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.
gem_descriptions.PoisonousConcoctionAltX: Throws a single bottle that releases a burst when it hits the ground, dealing unarmed attack damage in an area with a chance to poison. The skill chains, bouncing randomly to deal damage multiple times. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.
gem_descriptions.Portal: Creates a portal to the current area's town.
gem_descriptions.PowerSiphon: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit.
gem_descriptions.PowerSiphonAltX: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit.
gem_descriptions.Precision: Casts an aura that grants accuracy and critical strike chance to you and your allies.
gem_descriptions.PrecisionRoyale: Casts an aura that grants accuracy and critical strike chance to you and your allies.
gem_descriptions.Pride: Casts an aura that causes nearby enemies to take more physical damage.
gem_descriptions.PrismaticBurst: Chooses an element at random and deals damage of that type in an area. Having higher strength makes it more likely to choose fire, higher dexterity makes it more likely to choose cold, and higher intelligence makes it more likely to choose lightning.
gem_descriptions.ProtectiveLink: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they copy your block chance and recover life when they block. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.
gem_descriptions.Puncture: Punctures enemies with your Bow, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration.
gem_descriptions.PunctureAltX: Punctures enemies, causing a bleeding debuff, which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. Puncture works with daggers, claws or swords.
